Kiswahili: Chanjo za majaribio kutokana na mbinu hizi zozote zitalazimika kupimwa kwa ajili ya usalama na ufanisi. Tarehe 16, Machi 2020, jaribio la kwanza la kliniki la chanjo lilianza na watu 4 waliojitolea huko Seattle.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korwa ekero ekero ekeene ekeroberio ekiagera goikeranwa igoro yoborendi na oborendi.Ekeombe ekenene 16 omotienyi 3 omwaka 2020, ekerori ekenene kia eikeombe ekeroreire ase abanto banene ase eintaneti ya Seattle.

Ekegusii: Oboremi bwebinyoro bwenerete korwa omoroberio bwetugo ekero emeriba egotoma korwa erio goikerania oboremi bwao na gotanga ebinto biria biria bigotoma gose ebinto binde.

Kiswahili: Plasma kutoka kwa wagonjwa waliopona na uzalishaji wa antibodi

English: HELB invites eligible university and college students to apply for loans through the online portal.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika wanafunzi wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo wanaostahili kuomba mikopo kupitia lango la mtandaoni.

English: Community mitigation strategies, which aim to slow the spread of COVID-19, are important to protect all persons from COVID-19, especially persons with underlying health conditions and other persons at risk for severe COVID-19–associated disease (https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/downloads/community-mitigation-strategy.pdf).
Kiswahili: Mikakati ya kukabiliana ya jumuiya, inayolenga kupunguza kuenea kwa COVID-19, ni muhimu kulinda watu wote dhidi ya COVID-19, hasa watu walio na hali sugu za afya na watu wengine walio hatarini ugonjwa hatari unaohusiana na COVID-19 (https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/downloads/community-mitigation-strategy.pdf).
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogokurerwa kwa COVID-19 ase abanto bonsi, buna oboronge bwokorenta oborwaria bwa COVID-19, nobwenerete korenda abande bonsi korwa COVID-19, mono abanto baria bare noborwaria obuya na abanto abange baranyare korwara oborwari bwa COVID-19 (https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/downloads/community-mitigation-strategy.pdf).

English: In response to the implementations of travel restrictions, Tedros stated that "there is no reason for measures that unnecessarily interfere with international travel and trade" and that the "WHO doesn't recommend limiting trade and movement."
Kiswahili: Kwa itikio kuhusu utekelezaji wa vikwazao vya usafiri, Tedros alisema kuwa "hakuna sababu kwa hatua ambazo zinaathiri usafiri wa kimataifa na biashara" na kuwa "WHO haipendekezi kupunguza biashara na usafiri."
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogotumia ebirengererio biogotwara ebinyoro, Tedros otageteire ng'a, "ntibikorekanu ase ebinto biria bigotwara oborendi bwoborendi na obokoreri bweserikari" na nga "Oborendi bwegechindagera (WHO) tibwenerete gokeania obokureri na okorenda."

English: Selling or buying votes is a crime punishable by law; report anyone attempting to buy your vote.
Kiswahili: Kuuza au kununua kura ni uhalifu unaoadhibiwa na sheria; ripoti mtu yeyote anayejaribu kununua kura yako.
Ekegusii: Gokinia gose gokongia ebinto biria bigotumia obokoreri bwebinto bioboronge, korwa omoroberio bwogotumia ebinto biobokoreri. Karwe igoro y'omonto oranyare gokeania ebinto biao.

English: WHEREAS on March 4, 2020, I proclaimed a State of Emergency to exist in California as a result of the threat of COVID-19;
Kiswahili: AMBAPO mnamo tarehe 4 Machi, 2020, nilitangaza Hali ya Dharura katika California kama matokeo ya tishio la COVID-19;
Ekegusii: KWA kuwa tarehe 4 Machi 2020, nilitangaza Hali ya Dharura kuwepo California kutokana na tishio la COVID-19;

English: For example, see for the ABC methodology applied to the Tristan da Cunha common cold data from 1967, where counts of I (number of infectious cases) and R (number of recovered cases) are in the tens at most.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, tazama mbinu ya ABC iliyotumika katika Tristan da Cunha data ya homa ya kawaida mwaka wa 1967, ambapo hesabu ya I (idadi ya visa vya maambukizi) na R (idadi ya watu waliopona) ilikuwa kumi na kitu kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Kwa mfano, angalia mbinu ya ABC iliyotumika kwa data ya homa ya kawaida ya Tristan da Cunha kutoka mwaka wa 1967, ambapo idadi ya I (idadi ya visa vya maambukizi) na R (namba ya visa vilivyopona) ni mengi zaidi.

English: In this case, the intermediate host becomes a natural reservoir host.
Kiswahili: Katika hali hii, mbebaji wa kati anakuwa mbebaji asilia anayehifadhi virusi.
Ekegusii: Katika kisa hiki, mwenyeji wa kati anakuwa mwenyeji asili wa hifadhi.

English: Some commentators have expressed concerns that it could allow governments to strengthen their grip on power.
Kiswahili: Watangazaji wengine wametoa maoni kuwa ingeruhusu serikali kuimarisha uongozi wao mamlakani.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi babwenerete gosoa ng'a ebikoru bionsi bikogendereria eserikari goikerania obokoreri bwabo ase obokonyi bwabo.

English: The CDC recommends covering the mouth and nose with a tissue when coughing or sneezing and recommends using the inside of the elbow if no tissue is available.
Kiswahili: CDC inapendekeza kufunika mdomo na pua kwa kutumia tishu unapokohoa au kupiga chafya na inapendekeza kutumia ndani ya kiwiko ikiwa hakuna tishu inayopatikana.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amagenderero (CDC) nkiabwenerete kobeka omoroberio bw'omoromo na omonyoro ase ekeombe ekero okoruta gose gose okobua na gokora ekero ekero ekeombe ekeene ekoruta.

English: In those most severely affected, COVID-19 may rapidly progress to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) causing respiratory failure, septic shock or multi-organ failure.
Kiswahili: Kwa watu walioathiriwa sana, COVID-19 inaweza kuongezeka kwa haraka kuwa ugonjwa sugu wa kupumua (ARDS) unaosababisha kushindwa kupumia kabisa, maambukizo ya ogani au ogani anuwai kushindwa kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Kwa wale walioathirika sana, COVID-19 inaweza kusonga haraka hadi ugonjwa wa matatizo makubwa ya kupumua (ARDS) na kusababisha matatizo ya upumuaji, mshtuko wa septic au matatizo ya viungo vingi.

English: Every effort should therefore be made to keep concentrations as low as reasonably possible and below the guideline value when resources are available.
Ekegusii: Kwa hivyo, juhudi zote zinapaswa kufanywa ili kuweka viwango vya chini iwezekanavyo na chini ya thamani ya mwongozo wakati rasilimali zinapatikana.

English: The proportion of infected people who do not display symptoms is currently unknown and being studied, with the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (KCDC) reporting that 20% of all confirmed cases remained asymptomatic during their hospital stay.
Kiswahili: Uwiano wa watu walioambukizwa amabao hawaonyeshi dalili haujulikani kwa sasa na unafanyiwa utafiti, na Vituo vya Korea vya Udhibiti na Uzuizi wa Ugonjwa (KCDC) vikiripoti kwa asilimia 20 ya watu wote waliothibitishwa waliendelea kukosa kuonyesha dalili wakiwa hospitalini.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwa abanto baria bakorire oborwaria buna batamanyete buna baranyare korwa ebimanyererio, na baria bare korwa ebiombe bioborwaria (KCDC) babwatirie ng'a 20% ya abanto bonsi babwatirwe babwatire ebinyererio buna batamanyete oborwari bwogokorerwa emeremo.

English: In uncertain times, plans can change.
Kiswahili: Katika hali nyingine, mipango inaweza kubadilika.
Ekegusii: Ase ebiro biogosegeta, ebirengererio biranyare kogendereria.

English: Where COVID-19 hazards cannot be eliminated, the most effective controls are engineering controls, followed by administrative controls, and lastly personal protective equipment.
Kiswahili: Mahali ambapo hatari za COVID-19 haziwezi kukomeshwa, udhibiti zinazofaa zaidi ni za uhandisi, zikifuatiwa na udhibiti za utawala, na mwisho vifaa vya kujikinga kibinafsi.
Ekegusii: Hapo hatari za COVID-19 haziwezi kuondolewa, udhibiti bora zaidi ni udhibiti wa uhandisi, ukifuatwa na udhibiti utawala, na hatimaye vifaa vya kujikinga binafsi.

English: To facilitate this our data set is listed with Health Data Research UK and the European Health Data Evidence Network.
Ekegusii: Goikerania eyio, ebinto bionsi biranyorigwe ase oborwaria bwogokorwa emeremo (Health Data Research UK) na European Health Data Evidence Network.

English: Avoid buying tickets with a connection in an affected area – even changing planes can make you subject to restrictions.
Kiswahili: Epuka kununua tiketi zinazounganisha safari katika eneo lililoathirika - hata kubdilisha ndege kunaweza kufanya uwekewe vikwazo.
Ekegusii: Karwe kogura chibeti chiria chiria chibwateranete ase chinsemo chiria chikoremerwa, gose gosoa ebirengererio biria bikoremerigwa.

English: As of 26 March 2020 the total number of tests performed in Germany was unknown, because only positive results are reported.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 26 Machi 2020 nambari ya jumla ya vipimo vilivyotekelezwa Ujerumani haikujulikana, kwa sababu matokeo ya walioathiriwa pekee ndiyo iliripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Kufikia 26 Machi 2020 idadi ya jumla ya vipimo vilivyofanywa Ujerumani haikujulikana, kwa sababu matokeo mazuri pekee ndiyo yaliyorekodiwa.

English: Clinical manifestations: (1) fever and/ or respiratory symptoms; (2) with imaging features of COVID-19 infection; (3) total white blood cell counts showing normal, decreased, or reduced lymphocyte count in the early onset stage.
Kiswahili: Udhihirisho wa kimatibabu: (1) joto jingi mwilini na/au dalili za pumu; (2)sifa zinazoonekana za maambukizi ya COVID-19; (3) idadi ya jumla ya seli nyeupe za damu zinazoonyesha idadi ya kawaida, iliyopungua ya seli nyeupe za damu katika awamu wa mapema.
Ekegusii: Obokoreri bwa obokoreri: (1) omochando na/gose ebimanyererio bia oboremi bw'obongo; (2) buna oborengererio bw'okwerwa kwa COVID-19 (COVID-19); (3) omoroberio omonene bw'amasingira amaya ase chingaki chiesero chionsi chiria chiokwegendereria, gokeania gokeene, gose gokeanigwa kw'amasinga amaya (Lymphocyte) ase ekerengo ekenene.

English: When schools close, nutrition is compromised.Nutrition plays a critical role in cognitive development and academic performance for children.In Washington State, around 45% of the states 1.1 million students enrolled in traditional public and charter schools qualify for subsidised school meals.
Kiswahili: Shule zinapofungwa, lishe huingiliwa.Lishe huchukua nafasi muhimu katika maendeleo kiutambuzi na matokeo ya kiakademia kwa watoto.Katika Jimbo la Washington, karibu 45% ya idadi ya milioni 1.1 ya wanafunzi walijisajili kupokea mlo unaotolewa na shule za umma za jadi na shule za kipekee.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gose chinyomba chiokwegendereria.Ekeombe ekene ekerete oboremi bwechindagera na obokoreri bwechisemi ase abana.Enyomba ya Washington, amo na 45% ya abana emirioni 1.1 baria bakorire ase chisukuru chieserikari na chinsemo chiokwerenda goetera chibesa chiesukuru.

English: Definite case will be presented on our dashboard as “cases” of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Visa halisi vitawasilishwa kwenye dashibodi yetu kama “visa” vya COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene nkiagokorwa ase ekeombe kiobobwenia (dashboard) buna "ebirengererio" bia COVID-19.

English: Thus, we can only refer to previous studies on other CoVs, especially SARS-CoV and MERS-CoV (Fig. ​(Fig.4).4).
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, tunaweza tu kurejelea tafiti za awali kuhusu CoV vingine, haswa SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV (Picha. ​(Picha ya.4).4).
Ekegusii: Kwa hivyo, tunaweza kutaja tu masomo ya awali kuhusu virusi vingine vya CoV, hasa SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV (Picha. (picha.4).4).

English: Access to safe water, basic sanitation and hygiene is essential to prevent cholera and other waterborne diseases.
Ekegusii: Ogoikera amache amache, oboremi obuya na obochenu nobwenerete gosegeta cholera na oborwaria obuya obuya ase amache.

English: The World Health Organization adopted the German recipe for manufacturing kits sent to low-income countries without the resources to develop their own.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Ulimenguni lilianza kutumia resipe ya Ujerumani ya kutengeneza vifurushi vinavyotumwa katika mataifa ya mapato ya chini yasiyo na uwezo wa kuunda vyao yenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (World Health Organization) kiabwatete omoroberio bwogotumia ebinto biogosaria ase chingaki chiogotwara ebinto biabo, na goetera ebinto biria bigotumia chingaki chiria chiria chionsi chiria chitari chibesa.

English: The primary function of ACE2 is to act as a counter balance to ACE.
Kiswahili: Kazi kuu ya ACE2 ni kufanya kazi kama kisawazishi cha ACE.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwobotambe bwa ACE2 ng'a obokoreri bwao buna oboremi bwa ACE.

English: do your relatives have the same symptoms
Kiswahili: je, jamaa zako wana dalili sawa
Ekegusii: je, watu wako wa ukoo wana dalili sawa

English: WHO recommends that all blood donations should be screened for infections prior to use.
Ekegusii: WHO inashauri kwamba michango yote ya damu inapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa ajili ya maambukizi kabla ya matumizi.

English: These findings dramatically increase the risk of virus spreading.
Kiswahili: Matokeo haya yanaongeza pakubwa hatari ya kuenea kwa virusi.
Ekegusii: Ebionchorerio ebi bikorenta omoroberio bwokoruta ebinyoro.

English: The lipid bilayer envelope, membrane proteins, and nucleocapsid protect the virus when it is outside the host cell.
Kiswahili: Mfuniko wa tabaka mbili za lipidi, protini za utandao, na nucleocapsid hulinda virusi wakati viko nje ya seli mama.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekero ekeombe keria ekorokereria ekero ekoremereria ekenyoro, ebinto biria biria bigokonya ebinyoro (lipid bilayer envelope), ebinto biobotuki (membrane proteins) na nucleocapsid (nucleocapside) nigo bikorenda ekero egokonya ekero nigo ekoreemereria ekeombe ekerengete.

English: They should only be used as directed by a physician to treat a bacterial infection.
Ekegusii: Ni lazima zitumikane tu kama ilivyoagizwa na daktari ili kutibu maambukizi ya bakteria.

English: Recombinant human ACE2 (rhACE2) is surmised to be a novel therapy for acute lung injury, and appeared to improve pulmonary hemodynamics and oxygen saturation in piglets with a lipopolysaccharide-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Kiswahili: ACE2 iliyounganishwa ya binadamu (rhACE2) imechukuliwa kuwa matibabu mapya ya majeraha makali ya mapafu, na ilionekana kuboresha mzunguko wa damu mwilini na ukolevu wa oksijeni katika nguruwe wadogo walio na ugonjwa uliosababishwa wa shida kali ya mfumo wa kupumua wa lipopolysaccharide.
Ekegusii: ACE2 ya binadamu iliyochanganywa upya (rhACE2) inadhaniwa kuwa tiba mpya ya majeraha makali ya mapafu, na ilionekana kuboresha hemoidinamiki za mapafu na ujazo wa oksijeni kwa nguruwe wenye ugonjwa wa matatizo makubwa ya kupumua yanayosababishwa na lipopolysaccharide.

English: These mRNAs are translated by the host's ribosomes into the structural proteins and a number of accessory proteins.
Kiswahili: Chembe hizi za mRNS zinabadilishwa na ribosome za mwenye virusi kuwa protini za kimuundo na idadi fulani ya protini za ufikiaji.
Ekegusii: Ebinyoro bia mRNA biria bigotenenwa ase ebinyoro biria biogokonya omonyene goikerania obokoreri bwechindagera na ebinyoreri biobokoreri.

English: The RCGP RSC successfully conducted a pilot collecting serological samples from adults and linking them to a patient’s medical records during the 2018-2019 influenza season.
Kiswahili: The RCGP RSC ilifanikiwa kuendesha jaribio la kukusanya sampuli za kiserolojia kutoka kwa watu wazima na kuzihusisha na kwenye rekodi za kimatibabu za wagonjwa wakati wa mkurupuko wa homa ya mafua msimu wa 2018-2019.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oborwaria (RCGP RSC) nkiagendererete obotuki bwogoteka emeroberio yobochori bwa abasae na goikerania ase ebirengererio bia abarwaire ase omwaka 2018-2019.

English: Almost half (47.7%) of the infected individuals were over 50 years old, very few were under 20, and only 14 infected individuals were under the age of 10.
Kiswahili: Takribani nusu (47.7%) ya watu walioambukizwa walikuwa na zaidi ya miaka 50, wachache walikuwa chini ya miaka 20 na watu 14 pekee ndio walikuwa na umri wa chini ya miaka 10.
Ekegusii: Karibu nusu (47.7%) ya watu walioambukizwa walikuwa na umri wa zaidi ya miaka 50, wachache sana walikuwa chini ya miaka 20, na watu 14 pekee waliambukizana walikuwa na miaka chini ya 10.

English: A study in Singapore found that an uncovered cough can lead to droplets travelling up to 4.5 meters (15 feet).
Kiswahili: Utafiti huko Singapoo ulionyesha kuwa kukohoa bila kujifunika kunaweza kusababisha matone kwenda hadi mita 4.5 (futi 15).
Ekegusii: Oboronge ase Singapore bwokoririe ng'a omoroberio omotoke ogotamigwa nigo ogotwara ebinto biria bigotwara emita 4.5 (mita 15).

English: People with gonorrhoea should notify current and recent sexual partner(s) to help prevent the spread of the disease.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria baranyare oborwaria bw'obongo nabo bagotumeka na baria bakonyare gokora emeroberio yobokoreri (s) erio gokonya gotanga oborwaire bw'oborwaria obwo.

English: b'Angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) is an enzyme attached to the outer surface (cell membranes) of cells in the lungs, arteries, heart, kidney, and intestines.
Kiswahili: Kimeng'enya 2 cha kugeuza b'Angiotensin (ACE2) ni kimeng'enya kilichoambatishwa kwa sehemu ya nje (utandao wa seli) ya seli katika mapafu, mishipa, moyo, figo na utumbo.
Ekegusii: Enzyme ya b'Angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) ni enzyme iliyounganishwa kwenye uso wa nje (membrane za seli) za seli kwenye mapafu, mishipa, moyo, figo, na matumbo.

English: It is very important for health authorities to adjust the effective quarantine time based on the most accurate incubation period, thus preventing infected but symptomless people from transmitting the virus to others.
Kiswahili: Ni muhimu kwa mamlaka ya afya kurekebisha muda faafu wa karantini kulingana na kipindi sawa zaidi cha kuatamia, hivyo kuzuia watu walioambukizwa wasioonyesha dalili kusambaza virusi kwa wengine.
Ekegusii: Ni muhimu sana kwa mamlaka za afya kurekebisha muda bora wa karantini kulingana na kipindi sahihi zaidi cha kuzaliwa, na hivyo kuzuia watu walioambukizwa lakini wasio na dalili kusambaza virusi kwa wengine.

English: To ensure high-quality fruit and prevent postharvest decay, it is important to harvest fruit without causing mechanical damage such as cuts, scratches, or bruises, which can serve as entry points for pathogens.
Ekegusii: Goikerania ebinto biria biranyare oboremi obuya na gotanga ebinto bikoremwa nyuma yogosarigwa, nigo goika kobua ebinto ebio goetera obokonyi bwoboremi buna okoremwa, okobwateka, gose okobwata ebinto biogosarigwa.

English: As a consequence, numerous airlines have cancelled flights due to lower demand, including British Airways, China Eastern Airlines, and Qantas, while British regional airline Flybe collapsed.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na hivyo, mashirika mengi ya ndege yamekatisha safari za ndege kutokana na hitaji la chini, ikiwa ni pamoja na British Airways, China Eastern Airlines na Qantas, huku shirika la kikanda la Uingereza la Flybe likianguka.
Ekegusii: Ase okogenderera, ebinyoro biria bigotwara ebinyorokererio bigosegeta oborendi bwabo, buna British Airways, China Eastern Airlines, na Qantas, buna ekeombe keria ekenene kia British, Flybe, nkorwara.

English: Due to overlap with other infections such as adenovirus, imaging without confirmation by PCR is of limited specificity in identifying COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na kulandana na maambukizi mengine kama vile adenovirus, kutoa taswira bila kuthibitisha kwa njia ya PCR ina upungufu wa masuala mahususi katika kutambua COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Kwa sababu ya kuunganishwa na maambukizi mengine kama vile adenovirus, picha bila uthibitishaji wa PCR ni ya kipekee sana katika kutambua COVID-19.

English: Many people use work as a way of channeling their stress with the world around us.
Kiswahili: Watu wengi wanatumia kazi kama njia ya kushughulikia dhiki yao na ulimwengu wetu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bagotumia omoroberio buna enchera yokorwania oboremi bwabo ase enchera eyemo.

English: When rinsing, water on the forearms must be prevented from running back to the hands.
Kiswahili: Wakati unasuuza, lazima yaliyo kwenye kigasha cha mkono yazuiliwe kutiririka nyuma na kurudi tena kwa mkono.
Ekegusii: Ekero okonyora, amache ase ebirengererio biria bigokonyora amache goikerania amache.

English: This is probably because SARS died down 17 years ago and no new case has been reported since.
Kiswahili: Hii pengine ni kwa sababu SARS ilikufa miaka 17 iliyopita na hakuna maambukizi mapya ambayo yameripotiwa tangu wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ebi nigo biranyare korwa ng'a ekero ekero SARS yabeire ase omwaka 17 oratire na gochia gochia korwa emeremo eyio gochia ekero eyio.

English: Clearly define the meeting, have an agenda, and send reading materials in advance.
Kiswahili: Fafanua mkutano kwa wazi, kuwa na ajenda, na utume mapema nyenzo za kusoma.
Ekegusii: Manyia igoro yobokoreri bwebinyoro, kora omoroberio, na orokia ebinto biogosoma kera.

Kiswahili: kama katikati ya kifua
Ekegusii: kama katikati ya kifua

English: Partial data from Italy found that the number of excess deaths during the pandemic exceeded the official COVID death tally by a factor of 4-5x.
Kiswahili: Data ya kiasi fulani tu kutoka Italia ilipata kuwa nambari ya vifo ya ziada katika janga kubwa ilizidisha takwimu rasmi ya vifo vya COVID kwa kipengele cha 4-5x.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete igoro ya Italia kiabwatete ng'a enamba y'abanto baria bakorire oborwaire ase omoroberio bw'obobongo goikerania enamba eyemo y'abana baria babwatirwe na COVID goetera 4-5x.

English: This review attempts to summarize the research progress in the new and swiftly developing subject area.
Kiswahili: Ukaguzi huu unajaribu kutoa muhtasari wa maendeleo ya utafiti katika eneo mada mpya inayokua kwa haraka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekerengo ekiagendererete gokong'ia oboronge bwogokonya omoroberio bweserikari ase enchera eyemo eyemo yobokoreri.

English: In patients with severe cases, the level of D-dimer, a fibrin degradation product present in the blood, was elevated, and lymphocyte count was progressively reduced.

English: However, out of an abundance of caution, we employed an antiviral cleaning crew to disinfect all surfaces in the San Francisco office.

English: The highest risk for men is in their 50s, with the gap between men and women closing only at 90.
Kiswahili: Hatari kubwa ni kwa wanaume wenye umri wa miaka 50 na zaidi, na pengo kati ya wanaume na wanawake likikaribiana katika umri wa miaka 90 tu.

Kiswahili: Utengenezaji wa chanjo au dawa ya kingavirusi ya COVID 19 huanza kwa kulinganisha dhana ya kemikali na mbinu inayowezekana ya kinga ya chanjo za baadaye au shughuli za kingavirusi katika vivo.
Ekegusii: Okorosia omoroberio bwokoruta COVID-19 gose omochando omonene ogotwara oborwaria bwogotwara ebirengererio bigotoma ase okorwania oboremi bwechimiya goetera obokoreri bwa obokoruta oborwari bwogotarwa oboroberio bwogokorwa oborwororo bwobobokoreri bwebirengererio ebio.

Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa kwa abanto na abamenyi bemegondo igoro yechibesa chiogokonya ebinyoro (Echibesa Chiobokoreri Chiedichitari) ase omoroberio omonene, omwaka 2020

English: The front and back of both hands and between and the ends of all fingers are rubbed for approximately 30 seconds until the liquid, foam or gel is dry.

English: Protect data privacy and data security: Assess data security when uploading data or educational resources to web spaces, as well as when sharing them with other organisations or individuals.
Kiswahili: Linda ufaragha wa data na usalama wa data: Tathmini usalama wa data unapopakua data au rasilimali ya elimu katika jukwaa za mtandaoni, vilevile unapozisambaza na mashirika mengine au watu binafsi.
Ekegusii: Renda amang'ana ao ao ao na oborendi bwebinto biao: Renga omoroberio bwoborendi bwao ekero okonyora ebinto biobochenu gose ebinto biria bigokorerwa chisemi ase ebinyoro biao, amo na korwa obokoreri bwao ase ebiombe biao gose abanto bonsi.

English: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) is a novel virus, first isolated from three people with pneumonia connected to the cluster of acute respiratory illness cases in Wuhan.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa sugu wa mapafu yaliyofungana ya virusi ya korona 2 (SARS-CoV-2) ni virusi geni, ilipatikana kwanza kutoka watu watatu waliokuwa na mchochota wa pafu waliohusiana na visa vya magonjwa sugu ya kupumua Wuhan.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya korona vya ugonjwa mbaya wa kupumua 2 (SARS-CoV-2) ni virusi vipya, vilivyotengwa kwanza kutoka kwa watu watatu walio na nimonia iliyounganishwa na kundi la visa vya magonjwa mabaya ya kupuma huko Wuhan.

English: The soil should be well drained and carefully irrigated to prevent excessive moisture.
Ekegusii: Endagera nigo egokonywa buya na gosegeta buya erio gotanga oboremi bwendagera.

English: Hong Kong recommends wearing a surgical mask when taking public transport or staying in crowded places.
Kiswahili: Hong Kong inapendekeza kuvaa kwa barakoa ya kimatibabu unapotumia usafiri wa umma au kukaa sehemu ambapo kuna watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Hong Kong yarure omoroberio bwokoruta ebinto biria bigokorerwa obokoreri (surgical mask) ekero ogotwara ebinto biobotuki bweserikari gose korwa ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Since the virus is very similar to SARS-CoV and the symptoms are also similar between COVID-19 and SARS, the outbreak of COVID-19 has created a sense of SARS recurring.
Kiswahili: Kwa vile virusi hivi vinafanana sana na SARS-CoV na dalili pia ni sawa kati ya COVID-19 na SARS, mkurupuko wa COVID-19 umesababisha dhana ya kutokea tena kwa SARS.

English: Use clean nursery soil for container-grown plants.

English: Avoid field operations when it is wet.
Ekegusii: Renda ebirengererio biria bigokorerwa omoroberio bweserikari ekero ekoremereria.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri (KRA) kiabwenerete gokurereria abamenyi bemeroberio igoro yobosaria bwa VAT.

English: There are many effective ways to treat and prevent anaemia.
Ekegusii: Kuna njia nyingi za ufanisi za kutibu na kuzuia upungufu wa damu.

English: Most businesses were ordered to close, with exceptions for businesses deemed "essential", including supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, hardware shops, petrol stations, and garages.
Kiswahili: Biashara kadhaa ziliagizwa kufunga, isipokuwa biashara zilizoonwa kuwa "muhimu", pamoja na maduka makubwa, maduka ya dawa, benki, duka za vifaa vya ujenzi, vituo vya mafuta, na gereji.

English: Food and feed contamination monitoring systems must be in place to ensure that tolerance levels are not exceeded.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bwechindagera na chindagera goikerania ng'a endagera yoboremi bw'ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto biogotumia chingaki chionsi chiokoruta chingaki.

English: Tests on patient samples present an extreme biohazard risk and should only be conducted under maximum biological containment conditions.
Ekegusii: Ogochoria ase ebirengererio bia abarwaire nigo goikerania omoroberio omonene bwogokonya ebinto biria bigokonya amagenderero ao ao ao na goetera gokorerwa ase oboremi bwao.

English: It is therefore not too surprising that bats might transmit HCoV-229E to humans directly.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo si ajabu sana kwamba popo wana uwezo wa kusambaza HCoV-229E moja kwa moja kwa binadamu.

English: KRA embraces digital platforms and urges taxpayers to file tax returns ahead of deadline
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi (KRA) kiabwatire ebinto biria bigotumia omoroberio bwegechidichitari na gosaba abanto baria bakorenta chibesa goikerania obokoreri bwabo bwetugo nyuma yamatuko.

English: There may be substantial underreporting of cases, particularly among those with milder symptoms.
Kiswahili: Huenda kukawa kutoripotiwa kwa kesi vikubwa, hasa kati ya walio na dalili hafifu.

English: Avoid crowded areas, especially enclosed areas without much air circulation, such as conferences, performances, shopping malls, public transportation, and religious services.
Kiswahili: Epuka maeneo yenye watu wengi, hasa maeneo yaliyofungwa bila hewa ya kutosha, kama vile mikutano, maonyesho, duka kuu za ununuzi, usafiri wa umma, na ibada za kidini.

English: On 20 January, China reported nearly 140 new cases in one day, including two people in Beijing and one in Shenzhen.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 20 Januari, Uchina iliripoti takribani visa vipya 140 kwa siku, pamoja na watu wawili Beijing na mmoja katika Shenzhen.
Ekegusii: Nomotienyi 20 omotienyi omotano omotambe, China yaamete ebinyoro 140 ase omotieny omonene, buna abanto babere ase Beijing na oyomo ase omoroberio o'Shenzhen.

English: KUCCPS has opened applications for diploma and certificate courses in public technical and vocational institutions.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imefungua maombi ya kozi za diploma na vyeti katika taasisi za umma za mafunzo ya kiufundi na kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri (KUCCPS) kiaigorete ogosaba igoro yogotanga chisukuru chiobobundi na chisatifiketi ase chinsemo chieserikari.

English: The envelope of the virus in electron micrographs appears as a distinct pair of electron dense shells.The viral envelope consists of a lipid bilayer where the membrane (M), envelope (E) and spike (S) structural proteins are anchored.
Kiswahili: Mfuniko wa virusi hizi katika picha ya kitaalamu ya elektroni huonekana kama jozi ya kipekee ya sheli nzito za elektroni. Mfuniko wa virusi una tabaka ya lipidi ambapo protini za muundo za utando (M), mfuniko (E) na ncha kali (S) zimeshikilia.

English: It is a key part of Regulation 12 about safe care and treatment, periodically inspected by the Care Quality Commission.

English: No sick days or PTO required - just tell your manager and help your team revise calendars and schedules to make sure key areas of work are covered.

English: An FBC is one of the most common tests performed, and we hope this will give an approximate indication of overall numbers of blood tests performed.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya FBC ni mojawapo ya vipimo vya kawaida vinavyofanywa na tunatumai kwamba hii itatupa makadirio ya ishara ya jumla ya idadi ya vipimo vya damu vinavyofanywa.

English: The International Clinical Trials Registry Platform of the WHO recorded 536 clinical studies to develop post-infection therapies for COVID-19 infections, with numerous established antiviral compounds for treating other infections under clinical research to be repurposed.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Usajili wa Majaribio ya Kimatibabu la Kimataifa la WHO lilirekodi tafiti 536 za kimatibabu ili kutengeneza matibabu ya baada ya maambukizi kwa maambukizi ya COVID-19, na kemikali nyingi zilizopatikana za kingavirusi za kutibu maambukizi mengine chini ya utafiti wa kimatibabu zikielekezwa kwingine.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri bwogokonya emeremo (WHO) nkiagete ebirengererio 536 igoro yogokinia oborwaria bwa nyuma bwokoruta emeremo ya COVID-19, amo na ebinto biria bigokonya obokorwaria bw'emeremo eyio korwa obokorari bw'amarwaire goikerania emeremo yebirengererio biria bikoruta amarwaire.

English: We will curate our data using the Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable principles.
Kiswahili: Tutapanga na jumuisha data yetu kwa kutumia misingi ya Kupatikana, Kufikiwa, Kuhamishwa na Kutumika tena.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosegeta amang'ana etu goetera omoroberio bwokoruta, okogendereria, okobwaterana, na okogokorerwa emeremo.

English: Early recognition of suspected cases, prompt isolation, and consistent adherence to recommended infection prevention and control measures remain essential to protect health-care personnel.

English: Further, some commercial actors work to capture branches of government in order to prevent or weaken regulation of their products and services, leading to unregulated activity, limiting their liability and bypassing the threat of litigation and pre-emption.

English: As of Thursday, Associated Press reported there were at least 126,000 cases of COVID-19 worldwide, resulting in over 4,600 deaths.

English: SARS, also known as “atypical pneumonia”, was the first well documented HCoV-caused pandemic in human history and the etiological agent is SARS-CoV, the third HCoV discovered.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya SARS, ambavyo pia vinafahamika kama “nimonia isiyo ya kawaida”, vilikuwa janga la kwanza lililosababishwa na HCoV katika historia ya binadamu vilivyonakiliwa vyema na ajenti wa kietiolojia ni virusi vya SARS-CoV, virusi vya tatu vya HCoV kugunduliwa.

English: They stay in their own natural reservoirs until there is a chance for spillover.
Kiswahili: Virusi hivi huishi katika hifadhi zao asilia hadi wakati kuna nafasi ya kusambaa.

English: Use biopesticides that are not harmful to natural enemies (e.g. neem, ashes, soapy water).

Kiswahili: Uchujaji wa kimatibabu ilifanywa kabla ya kuondoka, na Waafrika Kusini wanne waliokuwa wanaonyesha dalili za virusi vya korona waliachwa nyuma kupunguza hatari.

English: Ordinary consular services such as visa and passport processing may be suspended or restricted to urgent need, depending on the location and the consulate.
Kiswahili: Huduma za kawaida za ubalozi kama vile kuchakata visa na pasipoti zinaweza kusitishwa au kuzuiwa kwa mahitaji ya haraka, kulingana na eneo na ubalozi.

English: Particularly avoid cruise ship travel.

Ekegusii: Segeta korwa ebinto biria bigotwara ebinto biengencho.

Kiswahili: Katika utafiti uliofanywa huko Wuhan kwa wagonjwa 240 wenye ugonjwa wa nimonia, nusu yao walipewa favipiravir na nusu walipewa umifenovir.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokororwa ase omoroberio o'Wuhan ase abarwaire 240 baria baranyare oborwaria bw'obongo, abanto batano bakonyorigwa favipiravir na abange bakonyorwa umifenovir.

English: The studies of chloroquine and hydroxychloroquine with or without azithromycin have major limitations that have prevented the medical community from embracing these therapies without further study.Oseltamivir does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 in vitro and has no known role in COVID-19 treatment.
Kiswahili: Utafiti kuhusu dawa ya chloroquine na hydroxychloroquine iwe au isiwe na chembe cha azithromycin una upungufu mkubwa ambao umewazuia wataalamu wa matibabu kukumbatia matibabu haya bila utafiti zaidi kufanywa. Oseltamivir haizuii SARS-CoV-2 katika utungishaji na haina jukumu linalofahamika katika matibabu ya COVID-19.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (KRA) nkigokurereria abamenyi bonsi baria bakorenta ebinto bia petroli igoro yobochori bwabo bwogotumia ekerengo kia eTIMS (Fuel Station System) ase ebiombe biabo.

English: Addressing climate change's health burden underscores the equity imperative: those most responsible for emissions should bear the highest mitigation and adaptation costs, emphasizing health equity and vulnerable group prioritization.
Ekegusii: Okorwania omoroberio bwoborwaria bwokoruta omochando omonene bwobogima bw'obongo goikerania oboteneneri bwa obokoreri: abanto baria bakorire obotenereri bwechindagera baranyare kobwatia oboremi bwao na kobwaterania ebirengererio biobochenu, korwa oborwaria obuya na korwa ase abanto babwenerete korwa ebinto biria bigotenererete.

English: The pathogenic detection of blood sample was added to the fourth (27 January 2020) and fifth (8 February 2020) editions; and then the serological evidence was added to the seventh edition.

English: Devolution brings services closer to you; visit your ward administrator's office for help with county matters.

English: On 31 January, the Trump administration declared a public health emergency, and placed restrictions on entry for travellers from China.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 31 Januari, utawala wa Trump ilitangaza hali ya dharura ya umma, na kuweka vikwazo ya kuingia kwa wasafiri kutoka Uchina.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 31 omotienyi omotambe, obokoreri bwa Trump bwabarure omoroberio bwobobwenia bwoborwaria bwabanto, na goikerania abanto baria bakorire chingaki chionsi goikera chinsa.

English: Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, liver damage, and other adverse reactions can occur following combined therapy with lopinavir/ritonavir.
Kiswahili: Kuendesha, kichefuchefu, kutapika, kuharibika kwa ini na hali nyingine mbaya zinaweza kutokea kufuatia jumla ya tiba na lopinavir/ritonavir.
Ekegusii: Oboremaru, obokebago, okobua, obokonyi bw'ebirengererio, na ebinto ebio bionsi biogokorwa nyuma y'ogokonywa na lopinavir/ritonavir.

English: Anyone who is considered to possibly have GBS should be closely monitored for respiratory difficulty and be admitted to a monitored setting such as intensive care.
Ekegusii: Omonsi ogotemwa ng'a nigo aranyare na GBS goikerania korwa ase obotambe bwokoremerwa na goikera ase oborendi bwokoremerwa buna oborwaria obuya.

English: U.S. older adults, including those aged ≥65 years and particularly those aged ≥85 years, also appear to be at higher risk for severe COVID-19–associated outcomes; however, data describing underlying health conditions among U.S. COVID-19 patients have not yet been reported.
Kiswahili: Watu wazima wazee nchini Marekani, wakiwemo wale walio na miaka ≥65 na hususan wale walio na umri wa ≥85, pia wanaonekana kuwa katika hatari kubwa ya kuwa na matokeo yanayohusiana na COVID-19; hata hivyo, data inayoeleza hali sugu za afya miongoni mwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19 nchini Marekani bado haijaripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Abakuu abakwegete ase America, goika abanto bonsi abana emyaka ≥65 na especially abanto bare nemyaka ≥85, nabo baranyare korwa emeroberio eyemo eyemo yogoikerania na COVID-19; korwa obo, amang'ana igoro yokorwania oborwaria ase abarwaire ba COVID-19 ase America goika ataranyorwa.

English: However, the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is a new disease, our awareness and knowledge are gradually increasing based on the ongoing research findings and clinical practice experience; hence, the strategies of diagnosis and treatment are also continually updated.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona 2019 (COVID-19) ni ugonjwa mpya, ufahamu na ujuzi wetu unaendelea kua kulingana na matokeo ya utatifi unaoendelea na uzoefu wa matendo ya kimatibabu; hivyo, mikakakti ya upimaji na matibabu pia inaendelea kusasishwa.
Ekegusii: Nere, oborwaire bwa korona 2019 (COVID-19) nigo oborwaria obuya, obomanyi bwetugo na obongo bwao goikerania ase obotuki bwao na oboronge bwogokonya obokoreri bwao. Nigo, emeroberio yobochori na obochenu nabo igoro yokoremerwa.

English: IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that as soon as hereafter possible, this Order be filed in the Office of the Secretary of State and that widespread publicity and notice be given of this Order.
Kiswahili: AMRI IMETOLEWA kwamba kwa haraka iwezekanavyo, Amri hii itawasilishwa kwa Ofisi ya Katibu wa Jimbo na kwamba matangazo ya kitaifa na ilani itatolewa ya Amri hii.
Ekegusii: KWAKWABWA KWAO KWANZA kwamba baada ya muda mfupi iwezekanavyo, Amri hii itawasilishwa katika Ofisi ya Katibu wa Jimbo na kwamba utangazaji na taarifa ya kina ya Amri hiyo itolewe.

English: The only U.S. cases (both survived) were recorded in May 2014.In May 2015, an outbreak of MERS-CoV occurred in the Republic of Korea, when a man who had traveled to the Middle East, visited four hospitals in the Seoul area to treat his illness.
Kiswahili: Visa nchini Marekani (ambao wote walipona) vilivripotiwa mwezi Mei 2014.Mnamo Mei 2015, mlipuko wa MERS-CoV ulitokea katika Jamhuri ya Korea, ambapo mwanaume ambaye alisafri kuenda Mashariki ya Kati, alitembelea hospitali nne katika eneo la Seoul ili kutibu ugonjwa wake.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korwa America (ebirengererio bionsi) nkiagera omotienyi 5 omwaka 2014.Omwaka 2015 omotambe, omoroberio o'MERS-CoV owabwatire ase eserikari ya Korea, ng'a omonto oyomo ogotamire ase ensemo eyemo ya Middle East, yabarure ase chinyomba chiria chinene ase enchera ya Seoul erio okorwarera oborwaria bwe.

English: We have developed training material to support this coding (Multimedia Appendix 4).
Kiswahili: Tumeunda nyenzo za mafunzo ili kusaidia usimbaji huu (Kiambatisho cha 4 cha Midianuwai).
Ekegusii: Twarure ebinto biria bigosomia igoro yogotumia ekodi eyio (Multimedia Appendix 4).

English: Most people with COVID-19 recover.
Kiswahili: Watu wengi walio na COVID-19 hupona.
Ekegusii: Watu wengi walio na COVID-19 hupona.

English: Should it be a bat, a pangolin or another mammal, it is expected that SARS-CoV-2 or its parental viruses that are almost identical will be identified in its natural hosts in future.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ni popo, kakakuona au mnyama mwingine, inatarajiwa kwamba SARS-CoV-2 au virusi vyake vizalishaji ambavyo vinakaribia kufanana vitatambuliwa kwenye wabebaji wake asilia katika siku zijazo.
Ekegusii: Iwapo ni popo, pangolin au mamalia mwingine, inatarajiwa kwamba SARS-CoV-2 au virusi vyake vya mzazi ambavyo ni karibu sawa vitatambuliwa katika wabebaji wake wa asili katika siku zijazo.

English: For example, the acquisition or loss of novel protein-coding genes has the potential to drastically modify viral phenotypes.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, kupata au kupoteza jeni mpya inayosimba protini kuna uwezekano wa kubadilisha haraka sampuli ya virusi.
Ekegusii: Kwa mfano, upatikanaji au upotevu wa jeni mpya za protini zinazopeana msimbo una uwezo wa kubadilisha sana aina za virusi.

English: Recycled toilet paper producer Who Gives a Crap said on last Wednesday they'd run out of stock.
Kiswahili: Kampuni inayotengeneza karatasi shashi kutokana na karatasi zilizotumika Who Gives a Crap ilisema siku ya Jumatano iliyopita kwamba waliuza bidhaa zao zote.
Ekegusii: Omonyagitari omonyene bw'ebinto biogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia chinguru (Who Gives a Crap) abwateirie omotienyi o'Chitatu chionsi chiria chire, ng'a baranyare korwa ebinto biogosaria.

English: Specialized negative pressure ventilation may be appropriate in some healthcare and mortuary settings.
Kiswahili: Upitishaji maalum wa hewa chanya ya msukumo inaweza kufaa katika baadhi ya mipangilio ya huduma ya afya na vyumba vya kuhifadhia maiti.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania omoroberio bwogosegeta bwokoruta chinguru chinguru nigo kogokonya ase oborwaria na oboremi bwechindagera.

English: Wash nymphs from plants with a strong jet of water.
Ekegusii: Sacha nymphs kutoka kwa mimea kwa kutumia maji yenye nguvu.

English: Methods include quarantines; travel restrictions; and the closing of schools, workplaces, stadiums, theatres, or shopping centres.
Kiswahili: Mbinu ni pamoja na; vizuizi ya safari; kufungwa kwa shule, sehemu za kazi, viwanja, sinema, au maduka.
Ekegusii: Obokoreri bwebwenerete gokong'ia abanto; oborendi bwogokonya abanto goikerania ebirengererio biabo; na gosoa chisukuru, chinsemo chiabo, chindagera, chinyomba chieserikari gose chingaki chiobokoreri.

English: On 26 March 2020, dozens of UN human rights experts emphasized respecting the rights of every individual during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 26 Machi 2020, wataalam wengi wa haki za kibinadamu wa UN walisisitiza kuheshimu haki za kila binadamu katika janga la COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 26 omotienyi 3 omwaka 2020, abakori emeremo igoro yobochori bwoboronge bwabanto (UN) baranyare koenekia oboronge bwomonto omonto omonene ase obokoreri bwoboronge bwa COVID-19.

English: Infectious disease preparedness and response plans may be subject to national or subnational recommendations.
Kiswahili: Matayarisho ya magonjwa ya kuambukizwa na mipango ya mwitikio huweza kufuata mapendekezo ya taifa au eneo fulani.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwoborwaria bwoborwaria na emeroberio yobochori bwebirengererio biranyare korwa ebirengererio bieserikari gose ebinyoro.

English: Recommendations for infection control while providing care to patients with suspected or confirmed Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever should follow those developed by WHO for Ebola and Marburg haemorrhagic fever.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa igoro yokorenda oborwaria ekero okonyara abarwaire baria bakoremerwa gose baranyare oboremi bwogotanga amache ase ebinyoro bia Crimean-Congo goikeranete korwa ebibago bia WHO igoro yoboremi bwa Ebola na Marburg.

English: Alcohol-free hand sanitizer efficacy is heavily dependent on the ingredients and formulation, and historically has significantly under-performed alcohol and alcohol rubs.
Kiswahili: Ufanisi wa kieuzi kisicho na alkoholi hutegemea sana viungo na chembe chembe zake, na kihistoria havijafanya vyema ikilinganishwa na vile vilivyo na alkoholi.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwa omoroberio bwogokonya amaoko ao ao ao goetera oboremi bw'ebinto biria bigotumia obokoreri bwebinto biogokonywa, na obotambe bwa kera buna oboremereria bw'obokoreri bw'amaboko na oborokereria bwabwo.

English: This is to identify a carrier state in patients who have recovered from the virus but may continue shedding the virus.
Kiswahili: Hii itasaidia kutambua hali za ubebaji kwa wagonjwa ambao wamepona kutokana na virusi lakini huenda bado wanatoa virusi.
Ekegusii: Icho ni kutambua hali ya mbebaji kwa wagonjwa ambao wamepona kutokana na virusi lakini huenda wakaendelea kutoa virusi.

English: In fact, many viruses have existed in the planet for a very long time.
Kiswahili: Hakika, virusi vingi vimekuwepo duniani kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Kwa kweli, virusi vingi vimekuwepo kwenye sayari kwa muda mrefu sana.

English: One of the early PCR tests was developed at Charité in Berlin in January 2020 using real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (rRT-PCR), and formed the basis of 250,000 kits for distribution by the World Health Organization (WHO).
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya vipimo vya awali vya PCR kiliundwa katika Charité kule Berlin mnamo Januari 2020 kwa kutumia kipimo cha muda halisi cha (rRT-PCR), na kikawa msingi wa vifurushi 250,000 vilivyosambazwa na Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni (WHO).
Ekegusii: Moja ya vipimo vya awali vya PCR iliundwa katika Charité huko Berlin mnamo Januari 2020 kwa kutumia muda halisi wa mmenyuko wa reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (rRT-PCR), na ikawa msingi wa vifurushi 250,000 vya kusambazwa na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO).

English: As a driving force in evolution, recombination is widespread among beta-CoVs.
Kiswahili: Kama msukumo katika ukuaji, uunganishaji tena umeenea miongoni mwa virusi vya beta-CoV.
Ekegusii: Kama kichocheo cha ukuaji, kuunganishwa tena kunaenea sana miongoni mwa virusi vya beta-CoV.

English: The percentage of COVID-19 patients with at least one underlying health condition or risk factor was higher among those requiring intensive care unit (ICU) admission (358 of 457, 78%) and those requiring hospitalization without ICU admission (732 of 1,037, 71%) than that among those who were not hospitalized (1,388 of 5,143, 27%).
Kiswahili: Asilimia ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19 waliokuwa na angalau hali moja sugu ya afya au kigezo cha hatari ilikuwa juu miongoni mwa wale waliohitaji kulazwa kwenye chumba cha kuhudumia wagonjwa mahututi ICU (358 kati ya 457, 78%) na wale waliohitaji kulazwa hospitalini lakini sio katika ICU kwa 9732 kati ya 1,037, 71%) kuliko miongoni mwa wale ambao hawakulazwa hospitalini (1,388 kati ya 5,143, 27%).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarwaire ba COVID-19 amo na oborwaria buna oranyare gose omoroberio bw'obobobwenia bwokoruta oborwari bwogokorerwa emeremo (ICU) nkogwancherwa ase abanto baria bakorire emeremo emeng'e emegondo emegumi (358 korwa 457, 78%) na abanto bagwancherwe ase okoremerwa ase emeremo y'emeremo yemeremo emegento emegati (1,037, 71%) korwa abanto batari koremerwa

English: Avoid touching your eyes, nose and mouth with your hands.
Kiswahili: Epuka kugusa macho, pua na mdomo wako kwa mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Tiga gokora amaiso, omonto na omoroberio bw'amaoko.

English: Pregnant women with HIV should have access to, and take, ART as soon as possible.
Ekegusii: Abakungu baria batamire na gotwara oborwaire bwa HIV nabo bagotumia, na goikera, ART.

English: In the absence of a semen testing programme, male survivors should follow safer sex practices for 12 months.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera goikerania omoroberio bwogotemwa ebirengo, abanto baria bakorire emeremo gochia ebinto biabo biogokora emeremo ase emetienyi 12.

English: Users are asked to enter their name and ID number.
Kiswahili: Watumiaji wanaulizwa kuina jina na nambari yao ya kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baborigwe koenekia ribaga riabo na enamba yao yobokoreri.

English: Ants feed on the liquid honeydew excreted by the aphids, manage the aphid colony, and protect the aphid colony from enemies.
Ekegusii: Oboremi nigo bagokonya omogondo omonene ogosegeta ase ebinyoro, gokonya oboremi bw'ebinyoro (aphid colony), na kobarenda obokoremi bwebinyoro korwa enchera eyemo y'abamenyi.

English: The estimated mean incubation period of SARS-CoV-2 is 1-14 days, mostly 3-7 days based on a study of the first 425 cases in Wuhan.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha wastani kilichokadiriwa cha kuatamia kwa SARS-CoV-2 ni siku 1-14, mara nyingi siku 3-7 kulingana na utafiti wa visa 425 vya kwanza kule Wuhani.
Ekegusii: Kipindi cha wastani cha kuambukizwa kwa SARS-CoV-2 kinakadiriwa kuwa siku 1-14, hasa siku 3-7 kulingana na utafiti wa visa 425 vya kwanza huko Wuhan.

English: Schools are encouraged to hold civic education sessions that teach learners about their rights and responsibilities as citizens.
Kiswahili: Shule zinahimizwa kufanya vikao vya elimu ya kiraia vinavyowafundisha wanafunzi kuhusu haki na wajibu wao kama raia.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chiaborigwe gokora emeroberio yamasomo yobochenu bwobobwenia igoro yogosomia abana igoro yoboronge bwabo na obotenereri bwabo buna abamenyi.

English: Some scientists chose to share their results quickly on preprint servers such as bioRxiv.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wengine waliamua kusambaza matokeo yao haraka katika seva otomatiki kama vile bioRxiv.
Ekegusii: Abanasayansi abange bakoririe gosanga ebirengererio biabo chingaki chionsi ase ebikoreri bia bioRxiv.

English: Drive-through centers have helped South Korea do some of the fastest, most-extensive testing of any country.In Germany, the National Association of Statutory Health Insurance Physicians said on 2 March, that it had a capacity for about 12,000 tests per day in the ambulatory setting and 10.700 had been tested in the prior week.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupitia kwa gari vimesaidia Korea Kusini kutekeleza baadhi ya vipimo ya haraka na yenye kadiri kubwa kuliko nchi yoyote.Huko Ujerumani, Shirika la Taifa ya Madaktari wa Sheria ya Bima ya Afya walisema tarehe 2 Machi, kuwa ilikuwa na kiwango cha takriban vipimo 12,000 kila siku katika mpangilio wa ambulansi na 10.700 walikuwa wamepimwa wiki iliyopita.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oborwaria nkigokonya korwa South Korea goikerania ebirengererio biobochenu ase enchera engima.Enyomba ya Germany, National Association of Statutory Health Insurance Physicians (NASP) yaaririe omotienyi 2 omotieny, ng'a endagera yebirengererio 12000 ase omotiencho omoroberio bwogokonya emeremo, na 10.700 yaarengererete ase esekenderi eyemo.

English: after exposure to blood/body fluids
Kiswahili: baada ya kuwa katika uwezekano wa kugusa damu/viowevu vya mwili
Ekegusii: baada ya kuguswa na damu/vioevu vya mwili

English: Ward administrators will visit each village to collect views on priority projects for the coming year.
Kiswahili: Wasimamizi wa wadi watatembelea kila kijiji kukusanya maoni kuhusu miradi ya kipaumbele kwa mwaka ujao.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bonsi baria bare ase chindagera chionsi baranyare gosegeta ebirengererio igoro yobochenu ase omwaka omoroberio.

English: We urge all persons owning rental properties and earning rental income to update/correct their property details as appropriate in the new KRA system.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosegeta abanto bonsi baria babwatirie chinyomba chiogosaria na baranyare chibesa chiosaria goikerania obotuki bwabo goetera omoroberio bweserikari (KRA) omochando omonene.

English: Enrolment figures based on latest UNESCO Institute of Statistics data.
Kiswahili: Takwimu za usajili kwa mujibu wa data za hivi punde kutoka Taasisi ya Takwimu ya UNESCO.
Ekegusii: Enamba yobochori igoro yobokoreri ase ekeombe keria ekenene kia UNESCO (UNESCO Institute of Statistics).

English: Parents should report any form of abuse against a child to the nearest chief's office or police station.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuripoti unyanyasaji wa aina yoyote dhidi ya mtoto katika ofisi ya chifu aliye karibu au kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Abaibori goika barure igoro yobokoreri bwebinyoro ase omwana goetera omosikari omonene gose ekeombe keria ekenene.

English: All require two doses to fully protect an adult.
Ekegusii: Ogoonsi goika goikerania amariogo abiri erio gotanga omonto omonene.

English: Plant 3 seeds per hole covered by 6-8 cm of soil • Raising seedlings in polybags in the nursery: This method has the advantages that it is easier to water the seedlings properly, which is particularly important in the dry season, and that is possible to select the strongest and healthiest plants for transplanting .
Ekegusii: Bwatia ebirengo 3 ase omoroberio omonene bwamasentimita 6-8. • Gokinia ebirungo ase ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto biengencho ase omochando: Enchera eyi nigo egokonya okoremereria ebirengererio ase oboremi bw'ebirengo, buna enchera eyemo endagera engiya, na buna ekiagera gosora ebirengerio biria biranyare obotambe na buna oborwaria ase okobwatia.

English: These studies have laid the foundation for the new concept that bats host emerging human pathogens.
Kiswahili: Utafiti huu umeweka msingi wa dhana mpya kwamba popo hubeba virusi vinavyoibuka vya binadamu.
Ekegusii: Oboronge obo bwabekire ebirengererio ase omoroberio omonene buna ebinto biria bigotwara oborwaire biogotwara ebinto bioborwaria ase abanto.

English: A recent study on 138 cases reported that 41% of the cases were possibly caused by nosocomial infections, including 17 patients with other prior diseases and 40 health-care providers.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa hivi majuzi kwa visa 138 uliripoti kwamba 41% ya visa vilisababishwa na maambukizi ndani ya hospitalini, ikiwa ni pamoja na wagonjwa 17 walio na magonjwa mengine ya awali na watoa huduma 40 wa matibabu.
Ekegusii: Okorigia kwa kera ase abanto 138 nigo kwabaririe ng'a 41% ya abanto baranyare korwa oborwaria bwogokorerwa emeremo, amo na abarwaire 17 baria barwarete amarwaire amangana amo na baria bakorire emeremo 40 ase oborwari bwabo.

English: occasionally i have some chest pain
Kiswahili: wakati fulani huwa nina maumivu fulani ya kifua
Ekegusii: mara kwa mara nina maumivu ya kifua

English: Ideally, ECPs with UPA, ECPs with LNG or COCs should be taken as early as possible after unprotected intercourse, within 120 hours.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (ECP) na UPA, ECP na LNG gose COC goikerania korwa omoroberio bwango nyuma yobochenu bwogosaria, nyuma y'amasaha 120.

English: None of these changes should be seen as an abandonment of our work and obligations.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yoyote kati ya mabadiliko haya yanapaswa kuonekana kama kuachwa kwa kazi na majukumu yako.
Ekegusii: Goikera gochia ebinto ebi goika goikeranwa buna okoregwa omoroberio bwetugo na obotenereri bwebinyoro.

English: For sexually active people, consistent and correct use of condoms is the best way to prevent genital herpes and other STIs.
Ekegusii: Kwa watu wenye shughuli za kingono, kutumia kondomu kwa uthabiti na kwa usahihi ndiyo njia bora ya kuzuia herpes ya viungo vya uzazi na magonjwa mengine ya kijinsia.

English: Citizens are urged to demand official receipts for every payment made at government offices.
Kiswahili: Raia wanahimizwa kudai risiti rasmi kwa kila malipo yanayofanywa katika ofisi za serikali.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baborigwe koboreria obokonyi bweserikari ase omoroberio obabwenerete gosoa chibesa chionsi chiokorwa ase obokoreri bwa eserikari.

English: The most recent common ancestor of the alphacoronavirus line has been placed at about 2400 BCE, the betacoronavirus line at 3300 BCE, the gammacoronavirus line at 2800 BCE, and the deltacoronavirus line at about 3000 BCE.
Kiswahili: Kizazi cha hivi punde cha virusi cha alphacoronavirus kimewekwa kati ya takriban 2400 BCE, kizazi cha betacoronavirus katika 3300 BCE, kizazi cha gammacoronavirus katika 2800 BCE na kizazi cha deltacoronavirus katika takriban 3000 BCE.
Ekegusii: Mzee wa mwisho wa kawaida wa mstari wa alphacoronavirus amewekwa takriban mwaka wa 2400 BCE, mtindo wa betacoronavirus mwaka wa 3300 BCE na mtandao wa gammacoronavirus mnamo 2800 BCE. na mtando wa deltacoronavirus katika takriban 3000 BCE.

English: Other mechanisms however, such as antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and/or phagocytosis, may be possible.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mbinu nyingine, kama vile sitotoksiki ya seli na/au phagocytosis zinazotegema kingamwili, zinawezekana.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete, buna obokebago bw'ebinto biria bigokonya ebinto biobotambe na/or phagocytosis, nigo kegokonya.

English: Medical hand-washing became mandatory long after Hungarian physician Ignaz Semmelweis discovered its effectiveness (in 1846) in preventing disease in a hospital environment.
Kiswahili: Kuosha mikono kimatibabu kukawa jambo la lazima muda mrefu baada ya mtaalamu kutoka Hungary, Ignaz Semmelweis kugundua ufanisi wake (mwaka wa 1846) katika kuzuia magonjwa katika mazingira ya hospitalini.
Ekegusii: Ogochacha amaoko ase oborwaria nigo kwabeire goikeranwa nyuma yobochenu bwao ignaz semmelweis, omoganga o'Hungary, ogotumeka kwao (ng'a 1846) ase okorenda oborwari ase chinyomba chiokwegendereria.

English: Further, in compliance with the same Act and Article 201 of the Constitution, the Commissioner General, on behalf of the Cabinet Secretary, the National Treasury, invites interested members of the public, professionals and stakeholders to submit their inputs and comments for consideration in finalising these Regulations.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, korwa omoroberio oo na ekeombe 201 keria ekerengete, omominisita omonene, ase enamba ya omosikari omonyene, obokoreri bweserikari, omobasekano bwoborendi, ogochora abanto bonsi baria bakwegendereria, abakori emeremo na baria babwenerete goikerania ebirengererio biabo na komenta igoro yoboremi bwabo erio koenekia amachiko aya.

English: 35 patients in Shenzhen tested negative in a median of 4 days, while the length of illness was 11 days in the 45 patients who did not receive it.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa 35 huko Shenzen walipimwa na matokeo yalikuwa hasi katika wastani wa siku 4, ambapo urefu wa ugonjwa ulikuwa siku 11 kwa wagonjwa 45 ambao hawakupokea dawa hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire 35 aaria Shenzhen babwenerete korwa emeroberio yamatuko 4 ase oborwaria, buna omoroberio bwomoroberio bwechitariki 11 ase abarwaire 45 batamwarire.

English: Avoid growing brassica crops in the same field for a period of at least three seasons.

English: Vaccination strategies have been developed for MERS by using inactivated virus, DNA plasmids, viral vectors, nanoparticles, virus-like particles and recombinant protein subunits and some have been evaluated in animal models.
Kiswahili: Mikakati ya chanjo imeundwa kwa ajili ya MERS kwa kutumia virusi vilivyolemazwa, plasmidi za DNA, mikondo ya virusi, chembechembe ndogo, chembechembe zinazofanana na virusi na vitengo vidogo vya protini vilivyounganishwa tena na zingine vimetathminiwa katika miundo ya wanyama.

Ekegusii: Ogoikerania korwa omoroberio bwokoruta chipomu (ECDC) omonene bwango, okorwania chipomu, obokoreri na oboremi bwogokonya goikera okogendereria kwa SARS-COV-2, korwa okwegendereria korwa oboronge ase okorenda chipomu gochia oborendi bwogokeania, ekero okoruta kwa chipomu korwa ebirengererio ebio goikeranie, goikerana na korenda oborwaria bwebinyoro biao korwa ekero gotabwate

Kiswahili: Virusi vya HCoV-NL63 vinahusishwa na kuchomeka kwa koo kunakoziba koo, pia iitwayo kifaduro.

Kiswahili: Kwa kuongezea vipimo vinavyohitajika kutoa chanjo kipya au dawa ya kukinga virusi kwa kliniki kwa mara ya kwanza, lazima watengenezaji wahakikishe kuwa sumu zozote za muda mrefu au za kudumu zimetambuliwa vizuri, ikiwemo athari kwenye mifumo ambayo haijachunguzwa hapo awali (uwezo wa kupata mimba, uzazi, mfumo wa kinga, kati ya zingine).

English: As of March 7, 2020, the surveillance system has detected 2 cases of COVID-19 in low-risk patients with no history of travel through extended virological sampling.

English: The risk of getting stuck in the connection city is higher than usual right now, due to delays for screening and testing as well as extensive cancellations.
Kiswahili: Hatari ya kukwama katika mji wa kuunganisha safari iko juu kuliko kawaida wakati huu, kwa sababu ya kucheleweshwa na kupimwa na hata pia kughairishwa kwingi.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokobwateka ase omoroberio omoteneneri bwokoruta chingaki chiria chiria chieserikari korwa ebirengererio, korwa oboremi bwokwerenda na gosomia na gosegeta oborendi bwogotumia chingaki chionsi.

English: The half-life of rhACE2 in human beings is about 10 hours and the onset of action is 30 minutes in addition to the course of effect (duration) of 24 hours.
Kiswahili: Maisha nusu ya rhACE2 kwa binadamu ni saa 10 na itaanza kufanya kazi baada ya dakika 30 pamoja na sababu ya matokeo (muda) saa 24.

English: Damage to the global economy has been felt in China: according to a media report on 16 March, the economy in China was very hard hit in the first two months of 2020 due to the measures taken by the government to curtail virus spread, and retail sales plunged 20.5%.
Kiswahili: Kuharibika kwa uchumi wa kimataifa kumekuwa na athari mbaya nchini China: kulingana na ripoti ya vyombo vya habari ya tarehe 16 Machi, uchumi wa China uliathirika pakubwa katika miezi miwili ya kwanza ya 2020 kwa sababu ya hatua zilizochukuliwa na serikali kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi na mauzo ya rejareja yalipungua kwa 20.5%.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwegechinyomba chioboremi bwobochenu bwomochenu mbobwenerete korwa chinasi: korwa omoroberio o'mwaka 16 omotienyi 3 omotambe, obochenu bwa chinasi nabwo bwabeire obotambe ase emetienyi yobotambe yomwaka 2020 ekero eserikari yabekire goikerania okobwaterana kw'esimi, na oboremi bw'ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto bionsi bwabereire amo na 20.5%.

English: In December 2019, a pneumonia outbreak was reported in Wuhan, China.
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa Desemba 2019, mlipuko wa nimonia uliripitiwa huko Wuhan, Uchina.
Ekegusii: Omomotienyi 12 omwaka 2019, omoroberio bw'oboremi bw'ebinyinyi (pneumonia) nabwateirwe ase e'Wuhan, China.

English: MERS-CoV was first isolated in 2012 from the lung of a 60-year-old patient who developed acute pneumonia and renal failure in Saudi Arabia.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya MERS-CoV vilitolewa kwa mara ya kwanza katika mwaka wa 2012 kutoka kwa mgonjwa wa mapafu wa umri wa miaka 60 ambaye alipata ugonjwa wa nimonia kali na kufeli kwa njia ya kupitisha mkojo nchini Saudi Arabia.
Ekegusii: MERS-CoV ilitolewa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka wa 2012 kutoka kwa mapafu ya mgonjwa mwenye umri wa miaka 60 ambaye alipata nimonia kali na kutofaulu kwa figo nchini Saudi Arabia.

English: Safaricom and bank staff will never call to ask for your PIN or password; hang up and report such callers to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa Safaricom na benki hawatawahi kupiga simu kuuliza PIN au nenosiri lako; kata simu na uwaripoti wapigaji kama hao kwa mamlaka.

English: Finally, same as the other HCoVs, SARS-CoV-2 can be detected in fecal samples.

Ekegusii: Hatimaye, sawa na virusi vingine vya HCoV, SARS-CoV-2 inaweza kugunduliwa katika sampuli za kinyesi.

English: Major clinical symptoms: Chest radiography and temporal progression of clinical symptoms should be considered together with the other issues for the prediction of outcomes and complications of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Dalili kuu za kimatibabu: Upimaji wa kifua na maendeleo ya muda ya dalili za kimatibabu zinapaswa kuzingatiwa pamoja na masuala mengine kwa ajili ya utabiri wa matokeo na matatizo ya COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Obomanyi obuya ase obokoreri: Oboremi bw'ebinto biria bigokorwa ase obotuki bw'obobongo na oboremi bwogotwara oborwaria goikerania obokong'u bw'ebibago biria bikogendererete korwa ebinto binde biria biogokorwa amo na ebibago biobotuki bwa COVID-19.

English: SARS-CoV-2 was found to be a new type of beta-CoV with more than 99.98% genetic identity among 10 sequenced samples collected from the original site of the outbreak, the Huanan Seafood Market in Wuhan.
Kiswahili: SARS-CoV-2 ilipatikana kuwa aina mpya ya beta-CoV yenye zaidi ya 99.98% ya utambulisho wa kijenetiki miongoni mwa sampuli 10 zilizofuatilizwa zilizokusanywa kutoka eneo asili la mkurupuko huu, soko la Huanan Seafood la Wuhani.
Ekegusii: SARS-CoV-2 ilipatikana kuwa aina mpya ya beta-CoV yenye zaidi ya 99.98% ya utambulisho wa kijenetiki miongoni mwa sampuli 10 zilizopangwa kwa utaratibu zilizokusanywa kutoka eneo la awali la mkurupuko, Soko la Vyakula vya Baharini la Huanan huko Wuhan.

Ekegusii: Rora buna ebinto biria bigosegeta ebirengo biria bikoremereria ebinto biogosegeta oboremi bwao.

English: The SARS outbreak occurred in 2003 is one of the most devastating in current history, infecting over 8,000 people with a crude case fatality of approximately 10%.
Kiswahili: Mkurupuko wa SARS uliotokea 2003 ni moja ya mikurupuko mbaya zaidi katika historia ya sasa, ukiambukiza zaidi ya watu 8,000 ukiwa na kiwango kibaya cha vifo kwa takriban 10%.
Ekegusii: Oborwaria bwa SARS obwatire omwaka 2003 nobwenerete korwa ebinto biria bigosegeta enchera eyemo, na goikerania abanto 8,000 ase abanto baria bakorire oborwaria bwogokonya abanto goika 10%.

English: Will it become a pandemic worldwide, die down like SARS or relapse periodically like the flu?

English: ACE2 is present in most organs: ACE2 is attached to the cell membrane of mainly lung type II alveolar cells, enterocytes of the small intestine, arterial and venous endothelial cells and arterial smooth muscle cells in most organs.

English: Whole-genome comparison to date has found at most 92% of genetic material shared between pangolin coronavirus and SARS-CoV-2, which is insufficient to prove pangolins to be the intermediate host.

English: Besides the highly pathogenic HCoVs, the zoonotic origin of HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63 and HCoV-HKU1 have also been studied.
