Kiswahili: Mnamo 22 Machi, chombo cha habari ya Associated Press iliripoti: "Watu wengi ambao wana dalili na agizo la daktari wamesubiri kwa masaa au siku nyingi kupimwa."Baada ya kifo cha kwanza Marekani iliripotiwa katika jimbo la Washington mnamo 29 Februari, Gavana Jay Inslee alitangaza hali ya dharura, kitendo kilichofuatwa na majimbo mengine.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (Associated Press) kiabwatete omotienyi omonene omotano omonene, ng'a: "Abanto abange baranyare ebirengererio na omoroberio bwogokurerwa na omoganga babwatete amatariki ao ao goetera obotambe."Nyomo omonto oyomo ase America obwateteirwe ase eserikari ya Washington omotieny 29, omogabana Jay Inslee abwatete oboremi bwobotambe, na ekero ekero ekeombe ekenene kiao

English: More pathogenic CoV strains might also evolve by recombination, leading to the acquisition of novel proteins or protein features for host adaptation.
Kiswahili: Sampuli zaidi za kusababisha ugonjwa za CoV zinaweza kukua kupitia uunganishaji tena, na kusababisha kupatikana kwa protini mpya au sifa za protini kwa ajili ya kuzoeleka kwenye mbebaji.
Ekegusii: Aina nyingi za CoV zinazosababisha magonjwa pia zinaweza kuibuka kupitia kuunganishwa tena, na kusababisha upatikanaji wa protini mpya au vipengele vya protini kwa ajili ya kuzoeleka kwa mbebaji.

English: Notice to Register Tenants for Nairobi City County Government Rental Houses on Nairobi Revenue System (NRS) for Payments
Ekegusii: Okoraria igoro yokorika abamenyi ase chinyomba chieserikari chieserekari chiria chikorenta Nairobi City County ase omoroberio bwokorenta chibesa (NRS) ase oboremi.

English: In March 2020 China reported problems with accuracy in their test kits.
Kiswahili: Mwezi Machi 2020 China iliripoti matatizo katika usahihi wa vifurushi vya vya upimaji.
Ekegusii: Omwaka 2020 omotienyi omotaraba, China yabarure ng'a ebinto bionsi biria bigotemwa ase ebinto biao biogotemwa.

English: However, only N95 (series # 1860s) masks can protect against the inhalation of virions as small as 10 to 80 nm, with only 5% of the virions being able to penetrate completely; SARS-CoV-2 is similar to SARS-CoV in size and both are approximately 85 nm.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, barakoa za N95 pekee (matoleo ya # 1860) zinaweza kulinda dhidi ya kupumua ndani viini vidogo hata kwa vipimo vya 10 hadi 80 nm, huku 5% ya viini hivyo vikiweza kupenyeza kikamilifu; SARS-CoV-2 ni sawa na SARS-CoV kwa ukubwa na ni takriban 85 nm.
Ekegusii: Hata hivyo, barakoa za N95 pekee (series # 1860s) ndizo zinaweza kulinda dhidi ya kupumua virusi vidogo kama 10 hadi 80 nm, na 5% tu ya virusi vinavyoweza kuingia kabisa; SARS-CoV-2 ni sawa na SARS-COV kwa ukubwa na zote ni takriban 85 nm.

English: The trends in the 14-day truncated cumulative incidence of COVID-19 cases in EU/EEA countries and the UK generally followed that of Hubei Province (China) (Figure 1).
Kiswahili: Masuala ya sasa katika matukio ya visa vya COVID-19 katika siku 14 zilizopunguzwa katika nchi za EU/EEA na Uingereza kwa jumla yalifuata yale ya Mkoa wa Hubei (China) (Picha ya 1).
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwamasiku 14 bwokoruta ebinyoro bia COVID-19 ase chindagera chia EU/EEA na Engenerio ekenene buna oboronge bwa Hubei Province (China) (Figure 1).

English: These modifications based on the researchers continued work that to search for an optimal nucleic acid detection kit for rapid diagnosis, as well as the samples from respiratory tract including blood sampling, which increased the availability of different specimens, and supported bringing the specific antibody positive result into the confirmed criteria.
Kiswahili: Marekebisho haya kulingana na watafiti yaliendeleza kazi ya kutafuta kifurushi bora cha kugundua asidi ya nyuklea kwa ajili ya upimaji haraka, pamoja na sampuli kutoka kwa njia ya pumu ikiwa ni pamoja na sampuli wa damu, ambayo iliongeza upatikanji wa sampuli tofauti na kusaidia kuletwa kwa matokeo chanya ya antibodi mahususi katika utaratibu uliothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Obokoreri obuo bweserikari goikerania abakoreri gochia omoroberio bwokoruta amariogo ao ao ao goetera oboremi bwogokonya korwa oboronge bw'esimi ya nucleic acids ase obotambe bw'omoroberio omotambe, amo na ebirengererio biogokorwa ase omoberio bw'obongo goetera okoruta amache, na gosegeta goikera oborimo bw'amache ao ao ase obokoreri bw'emebasekano.

English: SafeTrace utilizes secure hardware technologies to allow users to share sensitive location and health data with other users and officials, without compromising the privacy of that data.
Kiswahili: SafeTrace hutumia teknolojia salama za maunzi za kuruhusu watumiaji kushiriki eneo nyeti na data ya afya kwa watumiaji na maafisa wengine, bila kuathiri faragha ya data hiyo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (SafeTrace) nkogotumia tekinorochia yetekinorochia ya obokoreri erio gokonya abakoreri kobwaterana ebirengererio biobochenu na oborwaria na abakori emeremo emeremo amo na abanto abange, erio gotanga oborendi bwabo.

English: Politico quoted Tim Manning, formerly a deputy administrator at FEMA, as saying "FEMA has an important role in coordinating the larger response to the crisis" and "[i]f there's an emergency, FEMA needs to be involved."
Kiswahili: Politico ilimtaja Tim Manning, aliyekuwa naibu msimamizi wa FEMA, akisema "FEMA ina wajibu muhimu wa kuratibu hali pana zaidi ya kukabiliana na janga" na "[i] iwapo kuna dharura, FEMA inahitaji kuhusika."
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obokoreri (Politico) nkiabwateirie Tim Manning, omoriki omoteneneri omonene ase FEMA, ng'a ogokwanchereria "FEMA endagera eyemo ekenene ase okorwania oboremi bwebinyoro" na "ng'a ekero ekeene ekenene, FEMA goikeranete kobwaterana."

English: Albeit the high homology between these two viruses, it is generally believed that WIV1 is not the immediate parental virus of SARS-CoV and bats are not the immediate reservoir host of SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfanano mkubwa kati ya virusi hivi, inaaminika kwa jumla kwamba WIV1 si virusi vizalishaji vya kati vya SARS-CoV na popo sio wabebaji wa kati wanaohifadhi SARS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Ijapokuwa ubadilishanaji mkubwa kati ya virusi hivi viwili, kwa ujumla inasemekana kuwa WIV1 sio virusi vya SARS-CoV na popo sio wabebaji wa hifadhi ya SARS-COV.

English: Their work added new evidence for our guideline and also make valuable reference for this pandemic worldwide.
Kiswahili: Kazi yao iliongeza ushahidi mpya kwa mwongozo wetu na pia kufanya rejeleo la thamani kwa janga hili kote ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Obokoreri bwabo bwabekire obosemia obuya ase omoroberio bwetugo yao na gosegeta obokoreri obuya igoro yobochenu bwomochenu.

English: Besides SARS-CoV and MERS-CoV, recombination events have also been observed in other HCoVs, in which the HCoVs recombine with other animal CoVs in their non-structural genes.
Kiswahili: Kando na SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV, matukio ya kuunganishwa tena kuwa aina nyingine ya HCoV yameshuhudiwa pia, ambapo HCoV mbalimbali huunganishwa tena na na virusi vingine vya CoV vya wanyama kwenye jeni zao zisizo na umbo.
Ekegusii: Pamoja na SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV, matukio ya kuunganishwa tena pia yameonekana katika HCoV zingine, ambapo HCoVs huunganisha tena na CoV zingine za wanyama katika jeni zao zisizo na muundo.

English: Herein lie the secrets of why asymptomatic carriers are seen and what causes the severe cases in human infection.
Kiswahili: Hapa kuna siri kuhusu ni kwa nini wabebaji virusi wasio na dalili hupatikana na kinachosababisha visa kali katika maambukizi ya binadamu.
Ekegusii: Hiki ndicho siri ya kwa nini vibebaji visivyo na dalili vinaonekana na kinachosababisha visa vikubwa katika maambukizi ya binadamu.

English: On 21 February, a plane carrying 129 Canadian passengers who had been evacuated from Diamond Princess landed in Trenton, Ontario.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 21 February, ndege iliyokuwa imebeba abiria 129 Wakanada ambao walikuwa wamehamishwa kutoka Diamond Princess walifika Trenton, Ontario.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 21 omotienyi 2 omotambe, ekeombe keria ekoretie abakendi 129 ba Canada abwo bakorwe gochia Diamond Princess, kiaikire ase omoroberio omonene o'Trenton, Ontario.

English: On 29 March it was reported that beginning 1 April all new overseas arrivals will be quarantined for two weeks.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 29 Machi iliripotiwa kuwa kuanzia 1 Aprili wageni wote wa kimataifa wanaoingia watawekwa karantini kwa wiki mbili.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ekenene 29 omotienyi 3 nkiageteirie ng'a gochia omotieny 1 omotieneti 4 abanto bonsi babwatirwe ase chingaki chionsi chiokoruta chingaki chiria chieserikari chiabo chiria chiria chikomire ase chitariki 2 chiomotienyi 4.

English: The UNESCO Institute for Statistics provides figures on students impacted by COVID-19 corresponding to the number of learners enrolled at pre-primary, primary, lower-secondary, and upper-secondary levels of education [ISCED levels 0 to 3], as well as at tertiary education levels [ISCED levels 5 to 8].
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Takwimu ya UNESCO hutoa takwimu kuhusu idadi ya wanafunzi walioathirika na COVID-19 inayooana na idadi ya wanafunzi walio katika chekechea, shule ya msingi, kiwango cha chini ya shule ya upili na kiwango cha juu cha shule ya upili [ISCED viwango 0 hadi 3], pamoja na viwango vya masomo katika vyuo vya mafunzo anuwali [ISCED viwango 5 hadi 8].
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obotuki (UNESCO Institute for Statistics) nkiagete amachiko igoro y'abana baranyare korwa COVID-19 ase enamba ya abana baria bakorire ase chisukuru chiokwegendereria, chisukuru chisesekenderi, chisekenderi chiokwerenda, na chisukuru chisekenderi [ISCED levels 0 to 3], amo na ase chisemi chiria chiria chikorire amasomo ase chisekonderi chisesekendi 5 to 8].

English: Some patients experienced dyspnea and/or hypoxemia one week after the onset of the disease.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wagonjwa walikuwa na ugumu wa kupumua na/au kiwango cha chini cha hewa safi mwilini mwanzoni mwa ugonjwa.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire bamwe baranyorete obokong'u na/or hypoxemia nyuma yechingu chionsi ekero oborwaria obo bwatangire.

English: Early diagnosis is important to prevent the worst effects of type 2 diabetes.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bw'obobwenia bw'omoroberio bw'ebinto biria bikoremerwa ase okorenda oborwari bw'esindani ya type 2.

English: The initial estimates of the basic reproduction number (R0) for COVID-19 were 1.4 to 2.4.
Kiswahili: Makisio ya hapo awali ya nambari msingi wa uzalishaji (R0) wa COVID-19 ulikuwa 1.4 hadi 2.4.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwogotoma bw'omoroberio omonene (R0) ase COVID-19 buna 1.4 gose 2.4.

English: Italian regional health commissioner Giulio Gallera said he has been informed by mobile phone operators that "40% of people are continuing to move around anyway".
Kiswahili: Giulio Gallera, Kamishna wa afya wa mkoa wa Italia, alisema kuwa amearifiwa na watoa huduma ya simu ya mkononi kuwa "asilimia 40 ya watu waendelea kutembea-tembea tu".
Ekegusii: Omominisita omonene bwoborwaria bw'Etalia, Giulio Gallera, otebete ng'a abanto baria bakorenta esimi yogotumia omoroberio bw'esimi (mobile phone operators) bamanyete nga "40% yabanto bagendererete korwa ebinto bionsi".

English: since you have a fever
Kiswahili: kwa vile una homa
Ekegusii: kwa kuwa una homa

English: The high-throughput automated systems in many clinical laboratories will be able to perform these assays but their availability will depend on the rate of production for each system.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya uchunguzi wa mwili ya kiotomatiki katika mahabari nyingi za kliniki zitaweza kutekeleza majaribio haya lakini upatikanaji wao utategemea kiwango cha uzalishaji cha kila mfumo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete ase ebinto biria bigotumia ekerengo ekenene ase ebikoreri biogokonya gokora ebirengererio ebi, na gosegeta oboremi bwabo goikerania omoroberio bwokorosia ebinto bionsi.

English: Don't stand or sit near people who might be sick.
Kiswahili: Usisimame au kukaa karibu na watu ambao wanaweza kuwa wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga korwa gose korwa ase abanto baria barwarete.

English: Because of small sample size and missing data on underlying health conditions among COVID-19 patients who died, case-fatality rates for persons with and without underlying conditions were not estimated.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kiwango kidogo cha sampuli na kutokuwepo kwa data kuhusu hali sugu za afya miongoni mwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19 waliofariki, viwango vya vifo vya kila kisa kwa watu walio na, na wasio na hali sugu za afya havikukadiriwa.
Ekegusii: Kwa sababu ya ukubwa mdogo wa sampuli na ukosefu wa data kuhusu hali mbaya za afya miongoni mwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19 waliokufa, viwango vya vifo vya watu walio na na wasio na hali mbaya havikadiriwa.

English: If possible, vegetables and fruits should be peeled.
Ekegusii: Iwapo iwezekanavyo, mboga na matunda vinapaswa kukatwa.

English: On 2 April 2020, researchers at the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine reported on testing of PittCoVacc, a possible COVID-19 vaccine in mice, stating that "MNA delivered SARS-CoV-2 S1 subunit vaccines elicited potent antigen-specific antibody responses [in the mice] that were evident beginning 2 weeks after immunization."
Kiswahili: Tarehe 2 Aprili 2020, watafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Pittsburgh cha Shule ya Tiba iliripoti kupima PittCoVacc, chanjo inayowezekana ya COVID-19 katika panya, ikisema kuwa "MNA ilitoa chanjo ndogo za SARS-CoV-2 S1 ilishawishi antijeni yenye nguvu-majibu maalum ya kingamwili [ndani ya panya] ambayo yalionekana wazo kuanzia wiki 2 baada ya chanjo."
Ekegusii: Tarehe 2 Aprili 2020, watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Pittsburgh School of Medicine waliripoti juu ya kupima PittCoVacc, chanjo inayowezekana ya COVID-19 kwa panya, wakisema kuwa "MNA ilitoa chanjo ndogo za SARS-CoV-2 S1 zilichochea majibu yenye nguvu ya antijeni maalum ya antibodi [kwa panya] ambayo yalikuwa wazi kuanzia wiki 2 baada ya chanjo."

English: As of March 12, more than 370 million children and youth are not attending school because of temporary or indefinite country wide school closures mandated by governments in an attempt to slow the spread of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 12 Machi, zaidi ya watoto na vijana milioni 370 hawaendi shuleni kwa sababu ya hatua za muda mfupi au za muda usiojulikana wa nchini nzima zilizowekwa na serikali katika jaribio la kupunguza kuenea kwa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Chitariki 12 chiomotienyi 3 omotienyi 3, abana na abakungu baria batari goikera chisukuru ase okorenda chisukuru chiria chieserikari chiria chiria chikoretwe goikerania obotuki bwa COVID-19.

English: Washing with plain soap results in more than triple the rate of bacterial infectious disease transmitted to food as compared to washing with antibacterial soap.Comparing hand-rubbing with alcohol-based solution with hand washing with antibacterial soap for a median time of 30 seconds each showed that the alcohol hand-rubbing reduced bacterial contamination 26% more than the antibacterial soap.
Kiswahili: Kuosha kwa sabuni pekee husababisha usambazaji zaidi ya mara tatu wa kiwango cha ugonjwa unaoambukizwa na bakteria unaoenezwa kwa chakula ikilinganishwa na kuosha na sabuni yenye kemikali ya kuua bakteria.Ikilinganishwa na kusugua mikono kwa kutumia mchanganyiko ulio na pombe na kuosha mikono kwa sabuni iliyo na kemikali za kuua bakteria kwa muda wa wastani wa sekunde 30 yote yalionyesha kuwa kusugua mikono kwa mchanganyiko ulio na pombe kulipunguza maambukizi ya bakteria kwa 26% zaidi kuliko sabuni yenye kemikali ya kuua bakteria.
Ekegusii: Gosaba na sabuni ya kawaida kunasababisha zaidi ya mara tatu ya kiwango cha magonjwa ya kuambukizana ya bakteria yanayoambukizwa kwa chakula ikilinganishwa na kuosha kwa sabuni inayolinda bakteria.Kulinganisha kusugua mikono na suluhisho linalotegemea pombe na kuoshua mikono kwa sabini inayolenga bakteria kwa muda wa wastani wa sekunde 30 kila moja ilionyesha kwamba kusuguliwa kwa mikono na pombe ilipunguza uchafuzi wa bakteria 26% zaidi kuliko sabuni inayozuia bakteria

English: An analysis of air travel patterns was used to map and predict patterns of spread and was published in The Journal of Travel Medicine in mid-January 2020.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa mitindo ya usafiri kwa ndege ilitumiwa kuweka kwenye ramani na kutabiri mitindo ya kuenea na ilichapishwa katika Jarida la Usafiri wa Kimatibabu katikati ya Januari 2020.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwobotambe bwechinyomba chiria chieserikari (air travel patterns) nabwo bwabekirwe erio gokora emeroberio yobochori na gosegeta omoroberio bwogokinia na gosigwa korwa The Journal of Travel Medicine goetera omotienyi omotano omwaka 2020.

English: For now, it is time to support one another and create space for the important work that will be coming in the weeks and potentially months ahead.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, ni wakati wa kusaidiana na kuunda nafasi ya kazi muhimu ambayo itakuwa ikija katika wiki na miezi ijayo.
Ekegusii: Ase bono, endagera yokonyarerana amo na korenta obosemia ase omoroberio bw'omoroberio omonene bwogokorwa ase chingaki chieserikari na chingaki chingiya.

English: Remdesivir is one of most promising anti-SARS-CoV-2 agents to be tested in clinical trials.
Kiswahili: Remdesivir ni mojawapo ya chanjo iliyo na uwezo mkubwa dhidi ya SARS-CoV-2 iliyofanyiwa majaribio ya kimatibabu.
Ekegusii: Remdesivir ni moja ya dawa zenye uwezo mkubwa zaidi za kupambana na SARS-CoV-2 zinazoweza kupimwa katika majaribio ya kimatibabu.

English: In March 2020, the AHTCPU established a second office in Mombasa to help protect more vulnerable children from sexual predators and traffickers operating along the Kenyan Coast.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 3 omwaka 2020, ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obokoreri (AHTCPU) kiabekirie ekeombe ekenene ase omoroberio bweserikari (Mombasa) erio gokonya okorenda abana baria bakoremerwa korwa oboremi bwokoruta chipomu ase abanto baria batemete na baria bagotumia chipomu goetera ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto bioboroso (Kenya Coast).

English: Gloves and other disposable items should be disposed of in a biohazard bag, and contaminated surfaces should be cleaned and disinfected afterwards.For commercial shipping, including cruise ships and other passenger vessels, hazard controls include postponing travel when sick, and self-isolating and informing the onboard medical center immediately if one develops a fever or other symptoms while on board.
Kiswahili: Glavu na zana zingine zinazotupwa baada ya matumizi hazifai kutupwa katika mifuko maalum ya kubeba takataka ya hospitali, na sehemu zilizoambukizwa zinafaa zipanguzwe na kusafishwa kwa dawa baadaye.Kwa usafirishaji wa meli, ikiwemo meli za kifahari na vyombo vingine za abiria, vidhibiti vya hatari ni pamoja na kuairisha safari ikiwa wewe ni mgonjwa, na kujitenga na kujulisha kituo cha afya chomboni mara moja ikiwa mtu ana hali ya joto au dalili zingine wakati yuko chomboni.
Ekegusii: Ebirengete na ebinto ebio biogotumia ebinto biria bikoretwe ase ebinto biogokonya ebinto biao, na ebionsi biria bigokonya ebio bikorwe na goikera ebinto bikorigwa ebinto binde.Ebitambokero bia obokoreri, goikerania chombo chiria chiria chikorwarigwa na chombo chionsi chioborendi, oborendi bwobokoreri bwokoruta ebinto bigokonyara ebinto buna oborwarete, na kobeka ekero ogokonya

English: Schools in the Seattle area cancelled classes on 3 March, and by mid-March, schools across the country were shutting down.On 6 March 2020, the United States was advised of projections for the impact of the new coronavirus on the country by a group of epidemiologists at Imperial College London.
Kiswahili: Shule katika eneo la Seattle zilikatiza madarasa mnamo 3 Machi, na kufikia katikati ya Machi, shule kote nchini zilikuwa zinafungwa.Mnamo 6 Machi 2020, Marekani ilishauriwa kuhusu makadirio ya athari ya virusi vya korana geni katika nchi na kikundi cha madaktari wakutabiri magonjwa katika Taasisi ya Imperial Uingereza.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chieserikari ya Seattle chire ase chisukuru chiria chiokwegendereria chitariki 3 chiomotienyi 3 omotienyi omotano, na goetera omotieny, chisukuru chionsi chiria chiria chikwegendererete gose gose chinyore.Omotienyi 6 omotieni 3 omwaka 2020, America yarureirwe igoro yobochori bwokorona omonene ase eserikari goetera abanto baria baranyare oborwaria bwogokwerenda korwa omoroberio omonene.

English: Home remedies should be used with caution and discussed with a health-care provider before use.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio biogotumia omoroberio bweserikari nigo bigotumia ase oborendi na goikerania na omonyene bwobobwenia bwogokonya emeremo nyuma yogotumia.

English: There is no established test assessing for the virus or antibodies in the blood, although tests are being developed.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kipimo kilichopatikana cha kutathmini virusi au kingamwili kwenye damu, ijapokuwa vipimo vinaendelea kutengenezwa.
Ekegusii: Haipo kipimo kilichowekwa kinachotathmini virusi au antibodi kwenye damu, ijapokuwa vipimo vinaendelea kutengenezwa.

English: Data from these practices are reported online in a weekly return, which includes monitoring weekly rates of influenza-like illness (ILI) and other communicable and respiratory diseases in England.
Kiswahili: Data kutoka katika huduma hizi zinaripotiwa mtandaoni kila wiki, ikiwa ni pamoja na kufuatilia viwango vya kila wiki vya ugonjwa unaofanana na homa ya mafua (ILI) na magonjwa mengine ya kuambukizana na ya pumu nchini Uingereza.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korwa ebinyoro ebio nkiagendererete goetera omoroberio bweserikari ase chingaki chionsi, ekiagera okorigereria oborwaria bwesikari (ILI) na oborwaire obuya ase england.

English: The droplets can land in the mouths or noses of people who are nearby or possibly be inhaled into the lungs.
Kiswahili: Matone hayo huweza kufikia midomo au mapua ya watu walio karibu au kuvutwa hadi mapafu.
Ekegusii: Ebitungu ebio biranyare korwa ebirengererio biabanto baria bakorire ase enchera eyemo, gose goikeranwa ase emete.

English: Recommendations for mask use by the general public vary, with some authorities recommending against their use, some recommending their use, and others requiring their use.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya umma kwa jumla kuvaa barakoa yanatofautiana, huku baadhi ya mamlaka zikipendekeza kutotumika kwao, baadhi zikipendekeza zitumike na zingine zikitaka watu wazitumie.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana igoro yogotumia chibesa ase abanto bonsi gochia, amo na abanto abange baranyare korwa ase ogotumia, abange goikerania goikera, na abange bagosegeta koikera.

English: The move gives the federal government access to around US$50 billion in extra funding to combat the pandemic, according to NBC News.
Kiswahili: Hatua hiyo inaipa serikali ya shirikisho uwezo wa kufikia dola bilioni $50 za Marekani za ziada katika kupambana na janga hili kubwa, kulingana na NBC News.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oo nigo ogokonya eserikari yobochenu goikera emirioni 50 ya dolari ya Amerika (US$50 billion) ase obokoreri obuya ase okorwania omoroberio oyo, korwa NBC News.

Baada ya kuingia kwenye seli mama, chembe cha virusi hufunguliwa, na genomu huingia sitoplazimu ya seli.
Ekegusii: Goikerania ase chinsemo chiria chiria chiogokonya omoroberio omonene, okobwaterana na okogendereria nigo kogokonya obokoreri bwao goikera omoberio bwomoberio ase endocytosis gose okobwatania oboremi bwomoroberio na omobuo bwomobereire.Obwango ogokonyara omobirusi omonene goikeranwa, na genome yao goika ase omobereire omonene.

English: Without clear answers to these questions, we cannot achieve fast and accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.
Kiswahili: Bila majibu bayana kwa maswali haya, hatuwezi kuafikia upimaji haraka na sahihi na matibabu faafu.
Ekegusii: Bila majibu wazi kwa maswali haya, hatuwezi kufikia upimaji wa haraka na sahihi na matibabu yenye ufanisi.

English: In other words, these two amino acid substitutions might be critical to viral adaption to humans.
Kiswahili: Yaani, ubadilishaji wa asidi amino hizi mbili unaweza kuwa muhimu katika virusi kuzoeleka kwa binadamu.
Ekegusii: Kwa maneno mengine, mbadala hizi mbili za asidi amino zinaweza kuwa muhimu kwa ajili ya kuzoeleka kwa virusi kwa binadamu.

English: Common symptoms include a fever, dry cough, and fatigue.
Kiswahili: Dalili za kawaida ni pamoja na homa, kikohozi kikavu, na uchovu.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio bionsi biria bigokwanerana buna omochando omonene, oboremi bwogokonya, na okoremerwa.

English: Addressing concerns about the spread of misleading or harmful "coronavirus" apps, Apple set limits on which types of organizations could add coronavirus-related apps to its App Store, limiting them to only "official" or otherwise reputable organizations.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia matatizo kuhusu usambazaji wa programu za "virusi vya korona" za kupotosha au mbaya, Apple huweka vizuizi vya ni aina gani ya mashirika ambayo inaweza kuweka programu zinazohusiana na virusi vya korona katika Duka lake la Programu, ikiwazuia kwa walio "rasmi" tu au mashirika mengine mashuhuri.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania obokong'u igoro yoboremi bwa ebinto biria bigosaria igoro yobochenu bwokorona, Apple yabekire oboremi igoro yogosaria ebinto biogosaria korwa ekorona ase ebinto ebio biogokonya korwa ebinto bikorwania obokoranu bwebinto biokorona ase ekorenta ekorenda ebinto biao, na goikera ebinto buna ebinto "bitari" gose ebinto bigokonya ebinto binde.

English: In Singapore, individuals have to report their locations with photographic proof.
Kiswahili: Huko Singapoo, lazima watu waripoti mahali walipo na ushahidi wa picha.
Ekegusii: Ase Singapore, abanto babwenerete kwerikia ebirengererio biabo ase obokoreri bweserikari.

English: Many Koreans signed petitions either calling for the impeachment of Moon over what they claimed to be government mishandling of the outbreak, or praising his response.
Kiswahili: Wakorea wengi walitia sahihi maombi rasmi zilizotaka kuondolewa mamlakani kwa Moon dhidi ya walichosema kuwa serikali kushughulikia vibaya mkurupuko, au kusifu mwitikio wake.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi abange ba korea babwatete ebirengererio biria bigosegeta omoroberio bwa Moon igoro yobochori bwabo igoro yobokoreri bwebinyoro, gose gokeania obokoreri bwao.

English: Beyond government restrictions, individual establishments are shutting their doors and cancelling events to try to reduce the spread of the virus.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya vikwazo vya serikali, biashara za kibinafsi zinafunga milango yako na kughairisha matukio ili kujaribu kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi.
Ekegusii: Korwa oboronge bwa eserikari, ebinyoro bionsi biranyare okorenta ebirengererio biao na gokeania ebikoru biao erio goikerania okogendereria okobwaterania kwerwaria.

English: Patients with severe respiratory symptoms have to be supported by extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO), a modified cardiopulmonary bypass technique used for the treatment of life-threatening cardiac or respiratory failure.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa walio na hali mbaya ya pumu lazima wasaidiwe kwa njia ya extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO), na mbinu ya cardiopulmonary bypass inayotumika katika matibabu ya kukosa kufanya kazi kwa moyo au njia ya pumu ambayo ni hatari.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire baria bare nemeroberio yoboremi bwokoruta omoroberio omonene goikerania oboremi bwabo goetera okoruta omobere omonene (ECMO), enchera eyemo yokoruta obochenu bw'omoyo gose oborema bw'oboremi bwe'omwoyo.

English: Employees are advised to promptly provide their employers with all required documentation to support claims for deductions and reliefs, where applicable.
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo bakoremerwa kobeka abariki babo ebitabu bionsi bikoremereria gosegeta ebirengererio biabo ase obokoreri bwabo.

English: Measures you are encouraged to take include working from home whenever possible, avoiding crowds and avoiding leaving your home unless absolutely necessary.
Kiswahili: Hatua ambazo unahimizwa kuchukua zinajumuisha kufanya kazi nyumbani ikiwezekana, kuepuka maeneo yenye watu wengi na kuepuka kutoka nyumbani ispokuwa iwe inahitajika kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio biria bigosegetigwe goikerania nigo bikorokereria korwa ase omoroberio bwebinyoro, gotanga ebinyoro biabanto, na gotanga gota ase omoberio bwogokonya.

English: The WHO update on 28 September 2012 said the virus did not seem to pass easily from person to person.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya WHO ya tarehe 28 Septemba 2012 ilisema kwamba virusi hivi havikuonekana kusambaa kwa urahisi kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete amagenderero (WHO) kia 28 omotienyi 9 omwaka 2012 nkiagete ng'a omoroberio oyo tibwateire ase omonto goetera omonto.

English: Our investments in Disease Control and Prevention strengthen health systems to detect, prevent, and manage leading infectious and non-communicable diseases.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwetugo ase okorenda na gotanga oborwaria goikerania emeroberio yobochenu erio koenekia, gotanga, na korenda oborwari obuya na obuya.

English: As of March 2020, it was unknown if past infection provides effective and long-term immunity in people who recover from the disease.
Kiswahili: Kufikia Machi 2020, haikujulikana ikiwa maambukizi ya hapo awali yalitoa kinga ya kufaa na ya muda mrefu ndani kwa waliopona ugonjwa huu.
Ekegusii: Kufikia mwezi wa Machi 2020, haikujulikana iwapo maambukizi ya awali yanatoa kinga bora na ya muda mrefu kwa watu wanaopona kutokana na ugonjwa huo.

English: Mild illnesses include some cases of the common cold (which has other possible causes, predominantly rhinoviruses), while more lethal varieties can cause SARS, MERS, and COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Magonjwa kali yanajumuisha visa kadhaa vya mafua ya kawaida (ambayo ina sababu zingine zinazowezekana, rhinoviruses) wakati aina mbaya zaidi zinaweza kusababisha SARS, MERS, na COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Magonjwa ya hali ya chini yanajumuisha baadhi ya visa vya homa ya kawaida (ambayo ina sababu zingine zinazowezekana, hasa virusi vya rhinovirus), huku aina zaidi hatari zikiweza kusababisha SARS, MERS, na COVID-19.

English: WHO recommends that countries that do not have testing capacity and national laboratories with limited experience on COVID-19 send their first five positives and the first ten negative COVID-19 samples to one of the 16 WHO reference laboratories for confirmatory testing.
Kiswahili: WHO inapendekeza kwamba mataifa yasiyo na uwezo kupima na mahabara ya kitaifa yenye uzoefu wa chini kuhusu COVID-19 yatume visa vitano vya kwanza vya kupatikana kwa ugonjwa na sampuli kumi za kwanza zisizo na COVID-19 katika mojawapo ya mahabara husika 16 ya WHO kwa ajili ya upimaji wa uthibitisho.
Ekegusii: WHO inashauri kwamba nchi ambazo hazina uwezo wa kupima na mahabara ya kitaifa yenye uzoefu mdogo wa COVID-19 zitume sampuli zao tano za kwanza na kumi za kwanza zisizofaa za COVID-19 kwa mojawapo ya mahabari 16 ya WHO kwa ajili ya upimaji wa uthibitishaji.

English: Thus, it is more critical and practical to isolate B cells from recovered patients and identify the genetic codes encoding effective antibodies or screen for effective antibodies against essential proteins of the virus.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ni muhimu zaidi kutoa seli za B kutoka kwa wagonjwa waliopona na kutambua misimbo ya kijenetiki inayosimbua antibodi faafu au kuchunguza kutafuta antibodi faafu dhidi ya protini muhimu ya virusi.
Ekegusii: Kwa hivyo, ni muhimu na muhimu zaidi kutenganisha seli za B kutoka kwa wagonjwa waliopona na kutambua nambari za kijenetiki zinazosimamia antibodi za ufanisi au kuchunguza kwa ajili ya protini za virusi muhimu.

English: Second, HCoV-229E-related bat alpha-CoVs are diverse and non-pathogenic in bats, whereas alpaca alpha-CoV caused an outbreak of respiratory disease in infected animals.
Kiswahili: Pili, virusi vya alpha-CoVs vya popo vinavyohusiana na HCoV-229E ni tofauti na havina uwezo wa kusababisha ugonjwa ndani ya popo, ilhali virusi vya alpha-CoV vilivyopatikana kwa alpaca vilisababisha mkurupuko wa ugonjwa wa kupumua kwa wanyama walioambukizwa.
Ekegusii: Cha pili, virusi vya alpha-CoV vya popo vinavyohusiana na HCoV-229E ni tofauti na haviwezi kusababisha ugonjwa kwa popo, huku alpaca-alpha-CoV ikisababisha mkurupuko wa magonjwa ya kupumua kwa wanyama walioambukizwa.

English: High PEEP may not be available on older ventilators.
Kiswahili: PEEP ya juu inaweza kuwa haipatikani kwenye vyombo vya kuingiza hewa vya zamani.
Ekegusii: PEEP ya juu haiwezi kupatikana kwenye mashine za zamani za kupumua.

English: Protect seedlings from monkeys, rodents and bucks by placing wire cages or thorns around the seedlings.
Ekegusii: Renda ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto biogosegeta korwa ebinyinyi, ebinyoro, na ebinto ebio ase okorenta ebinto bikorenta chinguru gose ebinto biechinguru gochia ebinto binde.

English: The Canadian government announced CA$275 million in funding for 96 research projects on medical countermeasures against COVID-19, including numerous vaccine candidates at Canadian universities, with plans to establish a "vaccine bank" of new vaccines for implementation if another coronavirus outbreak occurs.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Canada imetangaza milioni dola 275 za Canada katika ufadhili kwa miradi 96 ya utafiti kuhusu hatua za kimatibabu za kukabiliana na COVID-19, ikiwa ni pamoja na chanjo kadhaa zilizochaguliwa na vyuo vikuu vya Canada, na mipango ya kuanzisha "benki ya chanjo" ya chanjo mpya za kutumika ikiwa mlipuko mwingine wa virusi vya korona utatokea.
Ekegusii: Eserekali ya Canada yarure omoroberio bweserikari emirioni 275 (CA$275 million) ase obokonyi ase emeroberio yechisemi 96 igoro yoborwaria igoro yokorwania COVID-19, amo nebinto binde biria bigosegeta obokoreri ase chinyomba chiria chiria chiokwegendereria ase chinsemia chia Canada, amo na oboronge bwogotumia ebinto biria biogosegeria korwa ekero ekero korona ekorete.

English: MERS-CoV causes very mild disease and maintains a relatively low mutation rate in these animals.
Kiswahili: MERS-CoV husababisha ugonjwa kiasi sana na hudumisha kiwango cha chini cha kubadilika ikilinganishwa miongoni mwa wanyama hawa.
Ekegusii: MERS-CoV inasababisha ugonjwa mwembamba sana na hudumisha kiwango cha chini cha mabadiliko katika wanyama hawa.

English: In five of six patients, the first sample showed the highest viral load, and the sixth patient showed the highest viral load on the second day tested.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wagonjwa sita, sampuli ya kwanza ilionyesha kiwango cha juu zaidi cha virusi na mgonjwa wa sita alionyesha kiwango cha juu zaidi cha virusi siku ya pili ya kupimwa.
Ekegusii: Kwa watu watano kati ya wagonjwa sita, sampuli ya kwanza ilionyesha kiwango cha juu zaidi cha virusi, na mgonjwa wa sita alionyesha viwango vya juu zaidi vya virusi siku ya pili ya kupimwa.

English: It cannot be assumed that those with missing information are similar to those with data on either hospitalizations or underlying health conditions.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kuchukuliwa kuwa wale ambao maelezo yao hayapo ni sawa na wale walio na data kuhusu kulazwa hospitalini au hali sugu za afya.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosegeta ng'a abanto baria batamanyete igoro yobomanyi buna abanto bare na igoro yobochori bwogokorerwa emeremo gose oborwaria bwoborwaria.

English: An online map and dashboard from the John Hopkins University Center for Systems Science and Engineering with live updates
Kiswahili: Ramani na dashibodi ya mtandaoni kutoka kwa Kituo cha Chuo Kikuu cha John Hopkins cha Sayansi ya Mifumo na Uhandisi na taarifa za moja kwa moja
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete omoroberio bweserikari (online map and dashboard) ekenene kia John Hopkins University Center for Systems Science and Engineering na obokoreri bwebinyoro.

English: On certain itineraries there is a risk of getting quarantined somewhere along the way.
Kiswahili: Katika safari nyingine kuna hatari ya kuingia karantini mahali katikati ya safari yako.
Ekegusii: Ase ebirengererio bionsi nigo biranyare gokorerwa emeremo yokobekwa ase enchera eyemo.

English: School drama and music festivals will include themes that promote peace, tolerance, and national unity among learners.
Kiswahili: Tamasha za maigizo na muziki shuleni zitajumuisha mada zinazohimiza amani, uvumilivu na mshikamano wa kitaifa miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete ase chisukuru na omoroberio bwesukuru nigo kegokorwa ase ebinto biria bikogendereria oborendi, obokebago, na obomokanu bweserikari ase abana.

English: Define the duration of distance learning units based on students’ self-regulation skills: Keep a coherent timing according to the level of the students’ self-regulation and metacognitive abilities especially for livestreaming classes.
Kiswahili: Fafanua muda wa vipindi vya masomo kupitia njia za kimtandao kulingana na uwezo wa wanafunzi kujisimamia wenyewe: Weka muda unaofaa kulingana na kiwango cha wanafunzi kujisimamia na uwezo wa utambuzi hasa kwa mafunzo kupitia njia za kimtandao ya moja kwa moja.
Ekegusii: Manya igoro yoboremi bwa baria basomire chingaki chionsi goikerania ebirengererio bia baria baranyare gosegeta oborendi bwabo: Renda omoroberio bwogosegeta korwa oboremi bwogokwegendereria na obokoreri bwogosomia ase abana ase oboroso bwabo.

English: For the EU/EEA and the UK overall, the cumulative incidence of COVID-19 started to increase around 21 February and then increased sharply around 28 February 2020 (Supplementary material).
Kiswahili: Kwa EU/EEA na Uingereza kijumla, jumla ya matukio ya COVID-19 yalianza kuongezeka mnamo tarehe 21 Februari na kuongezeka zaidi tarehe 28 Februari 2020 (Andiko la ziada).
Ekegusii: Kwa EU/EEA na Uingereza kwa ujumla, hali ya jumla ya COVID-19 ilianza kuongezeka takriban tarehe 21 Februari na kisha kuongezeka kwa kasi takriban 28 Februari 2020 (Maudhui ya ziada).

English: This should be carried out once or twice a year, according to growth.
Ekegusii: Hii inapaswa kufanywa mara moja au mara mbili kwa mwaka, kulingana na ukuaji.

English: The most closely related bat coronavirus and SARS-CoV diverged in 1986.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona na SARS-C0V inavyohusiana sana na popo vilitofautiana mwaka wa 1986
Ekegusii: Virusi vya korona vya popo vinavyohusiana sana na SARS-CoV vilitofautiana mwaka wa 1986.

English: Since germs may remain in the water on the hands, it is important to rinse well and wipe dry with a clean towel.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu vijidudu vinaweza kusalia kwenye maji yaliyo mkononi, ni muhimu kusuuza vyema na kukausha mikono kwa taulo safi.
Ekegusii: Kwa kuwa vijidudu vinaweza kubaki ndani ya maji kwenye mikono, ni muhimu kuosha vizuri na kuosha kwa kutumia taulo safi.

English: The sampling rate, per 100,000 patients was highest for children 15-17 years of age and 60 year or older in adults, with the lowest rates in children 0-4 years of age and 18-29 years of age in adults (Figures 6-​-99).
Kiswahili: Viwango vya sampuli, wagonjwa 100,000 vilikuwa juu zaidi kwa watoto wenye umri wa miaka 15-17 na miaka 60 au zaidi kwa watu wazima, kwa viwango vya chini zaidi kwa watoto wa umri wa miaka 0-4 na miaka 18-29 kwa watu wazima (Picha 6--99).
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogotumia ebirengererio, ase abarwaire 100,000, nobogima ase abana baria bare emakore 15-17 na 60 gose ase abakuru, buna omoroberio omotambe ase abana 0-4 na 18-29 ase abanto bakuru (Ebitari 6-99).

English: Does the virus also bind ACE2-expressing cells in other organs?
Kiswahili: Je, virusi hivi pia vinaunganisha seli zinazoonyesha ACE2- katika viungo vingine?
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oyo nogotumia ebinyoro biria bigotumia ACE2 korwa ebinto ebionsi?

English: Schooling provides essential learning and when schools close, children and youth are deprived opportunities for growth and development.
Kiswahili: Shule zinatoa mafunzo muhimu na shule zinapofungwa, watoto na vijana wanakosa fursa za kukua na maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru nigo chikonyora chisukuru chionsi, na chisukuru chiria chire, abana na abasae bagosigwa chisemi chiabo goikera na gosegeta oboremi bwabo.

English: Data reported to CDC are preliminary and can be updated by health departments over time; critical data elements might be missing at the time of initial report; thus, this analysis is descriptive, and no statistical comparisons could be made.
Kiswahili: Data zilizoripotiwa kwa CDC ni za awali na zinazoweza kusasishwa na idara ya afya muda baada ya muda; vipengele muhimu vya data vinaweza kukosekana wakati wa ripoti ya awali; hivyo, uchanganuzi huu ni fafanuzi na hakuna ulinganisho wa kitakwimu ambao ungeweza kufanywa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obokoreri (CDC) nigo kegokurerwa ase oborwaria na gosegetigwa na emeremo yobochenu goikera obotambe; ebinto biria bigosegeta ebirengererio biranyare korwa ekero korwa oboreri bwao bwa motwe; buna enchera eyemo, enchera eyio yaboririe, na endagera eyemo tiyenerete koiranigwa.

English: Based on Johns Hopkins University statistics, the global death-to-case ratio is 6.0% (97,039/1,617,204) as of 10 April 2020.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na takwimu ya Chuo Kikuu cha Johns Hopkins, uwiano wa kimataifa ya kifo-hadi-kisa ni 6.0% (97,039/1,617,204) kufikia 10 Aprili 2020.
Ekegusii: Goikerania ebirengererio bia Johns Hopkins University, omoroberio bwogotumia ebinto biria bigokonya abanto korwa emeremo yechinsemo chiria chionsi, buna 6.0% (97,039/1,617,204) korwa 10 omotienyi 4 omwaka 2020.

English: Regions with schools remaining open included Taiwan, Singapore, Australia, Sweden, and some U.S. states.
Kiswahili: Maeneo ambapo bado shule zimesalia kufunguliwa ni pamoja na Taiwan, Singapore, Australia, Uswidi na baadhi ya majimbo nchini Marekani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekero chisukuru chiria chinyorire korwa chinyomba chiria chiogokorwa chikorokereria chibesa chiria chikoremereria chiesukuru chiokoremereria chikorengereria chiria chingete chiria chisukuru chiokorwa chisukuru chikorengete chiokorerigwa chikorerengereria chiosukuru chionsi chiokwegendereria chiokwerenda chisukuru chiao chire ase esukuru, chiria chiao, esukuru ya Singapore, Australia, na eserikari ya America.

English: Some canceled events, especially performances, sporting events, and classes, are being moved online, which means you can experience them without traveling.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya matukio yaliyoghairishwa, hasa maonyesho, matukio ya michezo, na madarasa, yanahamishwa mtandaoni, ambayo inamaanisha unaweza kunufaika bila kusafiri.
Ekegusii: Ebionchorerio bionsi bikoregwa, buna obokoreri, ebionchoreri biesukuru, na chisukuru, biranyorigwe goetera omoroberio bweserikari, ekiagera oranyare goikerania.

English: Small numbers of COVID-19 patients aged < 19 years were reported to be hospitalized (48) or admitted to an ICU (eight).
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19 walio na umri wa < 19 waliripotiwa kulazwa hospitalini (48) au kulazwa katika chumba cha watu walio katika hali mahututi ICU (wanane).
Ekegusii: Abarwaire bake ba COVID-19 baria batari na miaka 19 baranyareirwe korwa chisukuru (48) gose goikeranwa ase ekeombe keria ekenene (nane).

English: It is worth noting that age and underlying disease are strongly correlated and might interfere with each other.
Kiswahili: Ni muhimu kutaja kwamba umri na magonjwa sugu yana mahusiano makubwa na yanaweza kuingiliana.
Ekegusii: Nigo goikerania ng'a oboikeranu na oborwaria obuya nigo bikorwatania na gosegerana.

English: We are not tracking your time.
Kiswahili: Hatufuatilii muda wako.
Ekegusii: Hatuko tunasoma saa yako.

English: While there are concerns it may spread by faeces, this risk is believed to be low.
Kiswahili: Ilhali kuna mashaka kuwa inaweza kusambazwa na kinyesi, hatari inaaminika kuwa duni.
Ekegusii: Nche chingaki chiria chiria chionsi chiria chingokonya korwa ebinto biogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia oboremi bwetugo, endagera eyio yabekirwe ng'a ekero ekoremerwa.

English: Bali was reported as least able among the 20 most popular destination cities in terms of preparedness, while cities in Australia were considered most able.Australia released its Emergency Response Plan for Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) on 7 February.
Kiswahili: Bali iliripotiwa kama mahali iliyo na uwezo duni kati ya vituo vipendavyo zaidi 20 ya miji katika matayarisho, ilhali miji Australia zilidhaniwa kuwa na matayarisho nzuri.Australia ilitoa Mpango wa Mwitikio wa Hali ya Dharura ya Virusi vya Korona Geni (COVID-19) mnamo 7 February.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ekenene getenenerete omoroberio o'Bali kiabwenerete korwa ebinyoro 20 biria bikonyare korwa oborendi bwogokorerwa bobe, ekero emoroberio ya Australia yabwateirwe korwa ase obokoreri.Ekeombe ekenene gotanga oboremi bwa Australia kiabwaterete omobasekano bwokorwania oborwaria bwa korona (COVID-19) omotienyi 7 omotieny.

English: The RCGP RSC practices have been advised on the clinical coding that has been made available for COVID-19 across all CMR systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma za RCGP RSC zimeshauriwa kuhusu usimbaji wa kimatibabu ambao unapatikana kwa ajili ya COVID-19 katika mifumo yote ya CMR.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (RCGP RSC) nkiagendererete igoro yokorwania oborwaria igoro yogotanga COVID-19 ase chinsemo chiria chionsi chia CMR.

English: Health and care workers should always take standard precautions when caring for patients, regardless of their presumed diagnosis.
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo yoborwaria na oborendi goika bare emeremo emegondo yoborendi ekero bakorenda abarwaire, gose oboikeranu bwabo.

English: HCoVs that cause severe diseases in humans and humans who developed severe HCoV diseases have been eliminated.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya HCoV vinavyosababisha magonjwa kali kwa binadamu na binadamu waliopata magonjwa kali ya HCoV wameondolewa.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya HCoV vinavyosababisha magonjwa kali kwa binadamu na binadamu waliopata magonjwa mabaya ya HCoV vimeondolewa.

English: We do not plan to go “double-time to catch up” once the pandemic has passed.
Kiswahili: Hatupangi kwenda kwa "muda zaidi ili kufidia" punde janga hili likipita.
Ekegusii: Nigo togotara goikerania omoroberio omonene bwokoruta chingaki chiokoruta oborwaire bwetugo.

Ekegusii: Beka baranyare gokora omoroberio bwogokonya okoremerwa ase abanto "ng'a ebiro 90."

English: To monitor the burden of suspected COVID-19 activity in the community through primary care surveillance and clinical coding of possible COVID-19 cases referred into the containment pathway
Kiswahili: Kufuatilia uzito wa shughuli ya kushukiwa kwa COVID-19 kwenye jamii kupitia uchunguzi wa tiba ya kimsingi na kuwekewa msimbo visa vinavyoweza kuwa vya COVID-19 vinavyorejelewa kwenye njia ya udhibiti
Ekegusii: Goikerania omoroberio bwogokorwa kwa COVID-19 ase abanto goetera oborendi bwogotumia emeroberio yobochenu bwoboteneneri na gosegeta obokoreri bwobwenerete bwa COVID-19 goetera enchera eyemo yokwerenda.

English: If school closures occur late relative to an outbreak, they are less effective and may not have any impact at all.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kufungwa kwa shule inafanywa kama imechelewa kulingana na mkurupuko, zina ufanisi duni na huenda zisiwe na athari yoyote.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gochia chisukuru ekero chikorire ase ekero ekorwarerigwa, nigo tari korwa ase oboremi bwao na goikerania.

English: A further randomized trial in Australia is seeking to enrol 4,170 healthcare workers.
Kiswahili: Jaribio zaidi zisizokuwa na utaratibu maalum huko Australia inatafuta kuajiri wafanyakazi 4,170 wa huduma ya afya.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekeombe keria ekoremereria ase Australia nkigendererete kogesa abakori emeremo 4,170 ase oborwaria.

English: Many developed countries do not have enough hospital beds per capita, which limits a health system's capacity to handle a sudden spike in the number of COVID-19 cases severe enough to require hospitalisation.
Kiswahili: Nchi nyingi zilizoendelea hazina vitanda vya kutosha vya kila mtu, ambayo inapunguza uwezo wa mfumo wa afya kushughulikia matukio ya ghafla ya COVID-19 ambayo ni kali sana kuhitaji kulazwa hospitalini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ekenene getenerete oborwaria bwokorwara COVID-19 nigo tari gotanga oborwari bwogokorerwa emeremo ase abanto bonsi, ekiagera okorenta obosemia bwebinyoro goikerania omoroberio bwokorwa emeremo ya COVID-19 ase obokoreri bwokorwaria emeremo yoborwari.

English: A Turkish research team in Istanbul is conducting a small study on the use of chloroquine in combination with zinc, vitamin A, vitamin C and vitamin D.
Kiswahili: Timu ya Uturuki ya utafiti huko Istabul inafanya utafiti mdogo wa matumizi ya chloroquine pamija na zinki, vitamini A, vitamini C, na vitamini D.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete igoro yoboremi bwa Turkey ase omoroberio bweserikari ya Istanbul nkorwania oboronge bwogotumia chloroquine goikerania na zinc, vitamini A, vitamin C na vitamini D.

English: They are widely distributed across the Middle East and Africa.
Kiswahili: Wamesambaa pakubwa kote Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika.
Ekegusii: Bigo bionsi biranyare ase obotambe obuya na Afrika.

English: One study has found decreased infection rates with their use.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mmoja umepata kupungua kwa viwango vya maambukizi kutokana na matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Obomanyi bwebinyoro buna bwabwenerete gokeania oborwaria ase ogotumia ebinto ebio.

English: Potential impacts of school closures and reliance on distance learning are not addressed in federal acts of legislation at this time.
Kiswahili: Athari zinazowezekana za kufungwa kwa shule na kutegemewa kwa masomo ya mbali hazijaangaziwa katika utungaji wa sheria ya shirikisho wakati huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ekero chisukuru chikorigwa na gosegeta chisukuru goetera omoroberio bweserikari ekero ekero gose okogendererigwa gose gose goikerania chisukuru chionsi.

English: Your work makes this possible, whether you keep the sites stay up or our colleagues paid or our communities safe.
Kiswahili: Kazi yako hufanya hii iwezekane, iwe ni kufanya vituo viendelee kufanya kazi au wenzetu kulipwa au jamii yetu kuwa salama.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwonsi bwebinyoro bwogokonya obo, gose gose ogokonya chinsemo chionsi gose baria batwe baranyare gose ebinyoro bionsi.

English: The first recorded incidents of COVID-19 infection in Bangladesh were on March 8, in two people who returned from Italy and also the wife of one of them.
Kiswahili: Matukio ya kwanza ya maambukizi ya COVID-19 nchini Bangladesh yalikuwa tarehe 8 Machi, kwa watu wawili ambao walirejea kutoka Italia na pia mke wa mmoja wao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete igoro yokorwara COVID-19 aaria Bangladesh kiabeire omotienyi 3 omotieny 8, ase abanto babere baria bakorire gochia Italia amo na omosaria omonene.

English: Containment should slow the spread, and there may be benefits in the management of spread from intense surveillance.
Kiswahili: Udhibiti unapaswa kupunguza kuenea kwa ugonjwa na kunaweza kuwepo manufaa katika kudhibiti maenezi kutokana na uchunguzi wa kina.
Ekegusii: Ogochora buna okorenta okobwaterania, na goikerania koba na oboremi ase okorenda oboteneneri bwao goetera oborendi obuya.

English: Phylogenetic evidence has shown that bats and rodents serve as the gene source of most alpha-CoVs and beta-CoVs, while birds are the main reservoir of gamma-CoVs and delta-CoVs.
Kiswahili: Ushahidi wa kifilogenetiki umeonyesha kwamba popo na wanyama wagugunaji hutumika kama vyanzo vya jeni ya alpha-CoV na beta-CoV nyingi, huku ndege wakiwa ndio wahifadhi wakuu wa gamma-CoV na delta-CoV.
Ekegusii: Ushahidi wa kifilogenetiki umeonyesha kwamba popo na vimelea hutumika kama chanzo cha jeni ya virusi vingi vya alpha-CoV na beta-CoV, huku ndege zikiwa hifadhi kuu ya virusi vya gamma-CoVs na delta-CoV.

English: The mustard row is either in the outermost or in the middle row to avoid caterpillars being blown by wind into the cabbage plants.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gose ekero ekenene ekenene gotanga ebirengo biria bigokonya ebinyinyi korwa omochando.

English: People with symptoms suggestive of genital herpes should be offered HIV testing.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bare nemeroberio yoboremi bwokoruta chipomu (herpes genital) goikerania goikera obotambe bwa HIV.

English: If you must go out, try to stay at least 2 meters (6 feet) away from other people.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ni lazima utoke nje, jaribu kuweka umbali wa angalau mita 2 (futi 6) na watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Okonyorwa gose okogenda, geria korwa emeremo 2 (mita 6) ase abanto abange.

English: The WHO noted the contrast between the 2002–2004 SARS outbreak, where Chinese authorities were accused of secrecy that impeded prevention and containment efforts, and the current crisis where the central government "has provided regular updates to avoid panic ahead of Lunar New Year holidays".
Kiswahili: WHO ilionyesha tofauti kati ya mkurupuko wa SARS 2002–2004, ambapo mamlaka ya Uchina zililaumiwa kwa usiri iliyozuia juhudi za kinga na udhibiti, na hali ya hatari ya sasa ambapo serikali ya kati "imetoa taarifa za mara kwa mara kuzuia wasiwasi kabla ya likizo ya Mwaka Mpya wa Kichina".
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amagenderero (WHO) kiabwatete omoroberio omonene omonene bwetugo ya SARS (SARS) omwaka 20022004, buna abatenereri ba China bagosigwe igoro yokorenda ebirengererio bigosegeta obotenereri bwao, na oboremi bwango buna ekero eserikari ekenene "yabekire obokoreri obuya erio gotanga obokebago nyuma yobochenu bwomwaka omonene.

English: SARS-CoV-2 mainly attacks the lungs in the beginning and probably also attacks, to a lesser degree, other organs that express ACE2, such as the gastrointestinal system and the kidneys.
Kiswahili: SARS-CoV-2 hushambulia sana mapafu mwanzoni na pengine pia hushambulia viungo vingine vinavyodhihirisha ACE2 japo kwa kiwango cha chini, kama vile mfumo wa matumbo ya gesi na figo.
Ekegusii: SARS-CoV-2 huwashambulia hasa mapafu mwanzoni na pengine pia huashambulia, kwa kiwango kidogo, viungo vingine vinavyoonyesha ACE2, kama vile mfumo wa tumbo na figo.

English: Imperial College London researchers announced on 20 March 2020 that they are developing a self-amplifying RNA vaccine for COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Watafiti wa chuo cha Imperial huko London walitangaza mnamo tarehe 20 Machi 2020 kuwa wanakuza chanjo cha RNA yenye nguvu zaidi kwa ajili ya COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Imperial College London baranyare omotienyi omotano omochati omwaka 2020 ng'a bagotumia omoroberio bw'ekero kia RNA goikerania ekero kia COVID-19.

English: These numbers vary by region and over time and are influenced by the volume of testing, healthcare system quality, treatment options, time since initial outbreak and population characteristics such as age, sex and overall health.
Kiswahili: Idadi hizi hutofautiana kulingana na mkoa na muda na huathiriwa na idadi ya vipimo, ubora wa mfumo wa huduma ya afya, chaguo za matibabu, muda tangu mlipuko wa kwanza kutokea na sifa za idadi ya watu kama vile umri, jinsia, na afya kwa ujumla.
Ekegusii: Ebitengo ebi biranyorekana korwa ebinyoro na korwa obotambe na bikoremerwa ase omoroberio bwogotemwa, oboremi bwobobwenia bwoborwaria, emeroberio yoborwari, oborai bwogokorerwa emeremo, ekero ekero okoremereria kwegitang'ani na oborendi bw'abanto buna omwaka, ogokwegendereria, na obochenu bwomonto.

English: They found that the complex, which had open and closed conformations, was assembled as a dimer and the ACE2-B0AT1 complex can bind two S proteins, which provides evidence for CoV recognition and infection.
Kiswahili: Waligundua kwamba uchangamano huo, uliokuwa na pande wazi na funge za kuendana, ulikusanywa kama molekuli mbili na uchangamano wa ACE2-B0AT1 unaweza kuunganisha protini mbili za S, jambo linalotoa ushahidi wa utambuzi na maambukizi ya CoV.
Ekegusii: Bwobaibonye ng'a ekeombe ekenene, ekiagete oboremi bwao na obokoreri bwao, kiabwaterete buna ekeombe na ekeombe keria ekenene ACE2-B0AT1 nigo kegokonya kobwatia ebinyoro ebio bia S, buna ekiagera obosemia bwa CoV na obotambokero.

English: Adding diluted hydrogen-peroxide increases further the antimicrobial activity.Hand sanitizers containing a minimum of 60 to 95% alcohol are efficient germ killers.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza Haidrojeni peroksaidi iliyoyeyushwa huzidisha shughuli ya kupambana na uchafu.Vieuzi vya mikono vilivyo na angalau 60 hadi 95% ya alkoholi hufaa katika kuuwa viini.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania endagera ya hydrogen-peroxide egosegeta omoroberio bwogokonya ebinto biria bigokonya oboremi bw'ebinto biogosaria amagento.Ebitoki biria bionchoreria ebinto biogokonywa na ebinto ebio bionkoreria amagento ebirengererio biogotumia ebinto binde goika 60 goika 95%.

English: Use of uniform transplants and consistent growing conditions also helps reduce the number of harvests.
Ekegusii: Ogotumia ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto biogosegeta na oboremi bwogokinia na gosegeta goikerania omoroberio bwogoteka.

English: As of March 28, 2020, a total of 571,678 confirmed COVID-19 cases and 26,494 deaths have been reported worldwide.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 28 Machi 2020, jumla ya visa 571,678 vya COVID-19 na vifo 26,494 vimeripotiwa ulimwenguni kote.
Ekegusii: Chitariki 28 chiomotienyi 3 omwaka 2020, ebinyoro 571,678 bia COVID-19 na abanto 26,494 baranyare korwa oborwaire ase chingaki chionsi.

English: All declared income and expenses must be supported by a valid electronic tax invoice, correctly transmitted with the buyer’s PIN, where applicable, subject to exceptions provided under Section 23A of the Tax Procedures Act, Cap 469B and the Tax Procedures (Electronic Tax Invoice) Regulations, 2024.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chionsi na chibesa chiria chinyorigwe goikeranie goikera gochia oboremi bwa motwe ase obokoreri bwetekinorochia, na gosomigwa buya goetera PIN ya omogori, korwa ebirengererio bionsi, ase ekero ekoremerwa, korende gokorwa ase ekeombe kia 23A ase omoroberio bweserikari, Cap 469B na ebikoreri bia motwe (Electronic Tax Invoice) Regulations, 2024.

English: Plant in sunny areas as much as possible, provide good air circulation.
Ekegusii: Bwatia ase ebinyoro biria bigotumia omotienyi omonene ase chingaki chionsi chiria chire ase ekero ekoremereria omochando omonene.

English: Complications may include pneumonia and acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Kiswahili: Matatizo yanaweza kuwa ni pamoja na mchochota wa pafu na ugonjwa sugu wa mapafu yaliyofungana.
Ekegusii: Matatizo yanaweza kujumuisha nimonia na ugonjwa mbaya wa kupumua.

English: Phase III trials are large, pivotal trials to determine safety and efficacy in sufficiently large numbers of people with the COVID-19 infection.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya III ni vikubwa, vipimo muhimu vya kujua usalama na ufanisi katika idadi kubwa ya watu wenye maambukizo ya COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Obotuki bwa ekeombe keria ekenene kia III buna obotuki obonene, buna oboremi bwokoruta oborendi na obokoreri bwebinyoro ase abanto abange baranyare oborwaria bwa COVID-19.

English: The replicated positive-sense genomic RNA becomes the genome of the progeny viruses.
Kiswahili: RNA genomiki inayorudufiwa ya hisia chanya inakuwa genomiki ya virusi vya kizazi.
Ekegusii: RNA ya genomiki yenye hisia chanya iliyobadilishwa inakuwa genomiki ya virusi vya kizazi.

English: The world needs the information that Wikipedia provides, now more than ever.
Kiswahili: Ulimwengu unahitaji maelezo ambayo Wikipedia inayatoa, wakati huu kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amang'ana aaria Wikipedia, bono ase enchera eyemo.

English: The Center For Disease Control and Prevention in USA tracks the travel information of individuals using airline passenger data.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Udhbiti na Uzuizi wa Ugonjwa huko Marekani hufuatilia maelezo ya usafiri wa watu wanaotuma data za abiria wa ndege.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete na gotanga oborwaria (Center for Disease Control and Prevention) ase USA nkorenda obomanyi bwebinyoro biabanto bare korwa ebirengererio bieserikari (airline passenger data).

English: A survey conducted in Shanghai among pregnant women in different trimesters of pregnancy identified a strong demand for online access to health information and services.
Kiswahili: Utafiti uliofanywa huko Shangai wa wanawake wajawazito katika miezi tofauti ya ujauzito ulibaini hitaji kubwa la ufikiaji wa mtandaoni wa maelezo na huduma za afya.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omoroberio owabwatirwe ase eshanghai ase abakungu baria bakorete ase emetienyi etari goikerania oboremi bwabo, owabateire oboronge bwabanto baria bare korwa internet goikera obomanyi na obokoreri bwoborwaria.

English: On 5 March, the majority of learners affected by COVID-19 emergency measures were located in China, with 233 million learners affected, followed by Japan at 16.5 million and Iran at 14.5 million.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 5 Machi, wengi wa wanafunzi walioathirika na hatua za dharura ya COVID-19 walikuwa Uchina, na wanafunzi milioni 233 walioathirika, ikifuatwa na Japan na milioni 16.5 na Irani na milioni 14.5.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 5 omotienyi 3, abanto abange baranyorigwe ase emeroberio ya COVID-19 buna baranyare chingaki chinene, amo na abana baria baranyoreirwe 233 million, na goikeranwa na Japan amo na 16.5 million na Iran amo na 14.5 million.

English: According to the Imperial College study led by Neil Ferguson, physical distancing and other measures will be required "until a vaccine becomes available (potentially 18 months or more)".
Kiswahili: Kwa mujibu wa uchunguzi wa Chuo cha Imperial inayoongozwa na Neil Ferguson, kudumisha umbali na watu na hatua zingine zitahitajika "hadi chanjo ipatikane (kuna uwezekano wa miezi 18 au zaidi)".
Ekegusii: Kwa mujibu wa utafiti wa Chuo cha Imperial ulioongozwa na Neil Ferguson, kuweka umbali wa mwili na hatua zingine zitahitajika "hadi chanjo iwe inapatikana (uwezekano wa miezi 18 au zaidi)".

English: Currently, ART must be taken every day for the rest of a person’s life.
Ekegusii: Ase bono, ART goikerania kogotumia omotienyi omotano ase oboikeranu bwobogima bwomonto.

English: Notably, since 80% of the different animals in the markets in Guangzhou have anti-SARS-CoV antibodies, the possibilities that multiple species of small mammals might also serve as intermediate amplifying hosts of SARS-CoV cannot be excluded.
Kiswahili: Itabainika kwamba, kwa vile 80% ya wanyama tofauti katika masoko ya Guangzhou wana antibodi zinazopambana na SARS-CoV, uwezekano kwamba aina nyingi za mamalia wadogo pia wanaweza kutumika kama wabebaji wa kati waenezi wa SARS-CoV hauwezi kupuuzwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekero 80% ya chinsemo chiria chionsi chiria chire ase chindagera chia Guangzhou chire nechinsemo chiokwegendereria SARS-CoV, goikerania ng'a chinyomba chingiya chiria chikogendereria korwa SARS-COV chiria chitari korwa ebinto biria bigokonya korwa emeremo.

English: To control DBM in small farms, cover seedlings with covers (fine nylon mesh) to prevent moths from laying eggs on the leaves and or next to the plant.
Ekegusii: Erio korenda ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto bigotwara ebinto biengencho (DBM) ase ebirengo bionsi, rangia ebinto ebionsi na ebinto bikorenta ebinto binde (fine nylon mesh) erio gotanga ebinto bitoba bikoreta ebinto biao ase ebinto.

English: Other less common symptoms include shortness of breath, a sore throat, headache, muscle pain, or sputum production.
Kiswahili: Dalili nyingine zisizo za kawaida ni pamoja na matatizo ya kupumua, maumivu ya koo, kuumwa na kichwa, maumivu ya misuli, au kutoa makohozi.
Ekegusii: Oboteneneri obubwenerete korwa ebinto biria bitari bionsi buna oboremi bw'omwoyo, obotenereri bw'ekogo, oborongo bw'eng'e, obokong'u bw'emibere, gose okorema kwa ebinto.

English: We intend to apply approximate Bayesian inference (ABC) to (possibly spatially heterogeneous) Susceptible-Exposed- Infectious-Removed (SEIR) stochastic epidemic models.
Kiswahili: Tunanuia kutumia miundo isiyofuata utaratibu maalum ya uchanganuzi ya Bayesian inference (ABC) hadi (uwezekano wa mfanano kidogo) Susceptible-Exposed- Infectious-Removed (SEIR).
Ekegusii: Tuko na mogondo bwogotumia omoroberio o'Beyesian inference (ABC) ase emegondo yechinyomba chiria chiria chionsi (ng'a chingaki chinyomba) chiria chikonyare korwa ebirengererio biobochori (SEIR).

English: The WHO has published several testing protocols for the disease.
Kiswahili: WHO imechapisha itifaki kadhaa za uchunguzo wa ugonjwa huo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oborwaria (WHO) nkiarwete amachiko amang'ana igoro yogotanga oborwaire obo.

English: In response there were intensive efforts to provide alternative services through digital platforms.Another recent and rapidly accelerating fallout of the disease is the cancellation of religious services, major events in sports, and other social events, such as music festivals and concerts, technology conferences, and fashion shows.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwitikio kulikuwa na juhudi nyingi sana kutoa huduma mbadala kupitia jukwaa za mtandaoni.Tukio nyingine ya hivi karibuni inayoongezeka kwa kasi kwa sababu ya ugonjwa huu ni kufutwa ka ibada ya kidini, matukio kuu katika michezo, na matukio mengine ya kijamii, kama vile tamasha ya muziki na maonyesho, kongamano ya teknolojia, na maonyesho ya mitindo.
Ekegusii: Goikerania buna enchera eyemo yobochenu bwokorosia obokoreri obuya goetera ebinyoro biedichitari.Obwango obuya na oborwaria bwokoruta oborwari obuya buna oboremi bwokoraria oborendi, ebinto biria bigendererete igoro yobokoreri, na ebinto ebionsi bioboroso, buna ebikoru biogokinana na obokonyi, ebiombe bia tekinorochia, na ebiombe biobokoreri.

English: Dry with a clean towel or allow to air dry.
Kiswahili: Kausha maji kwa kutumia taulo safi au uruhusu ikauke kwenye hewa.
Ekegusii: Somia na tochi safi au acha hewa iome.

English: The WHO additionally uses "the COVID-19 virus" and "the virus responsible for COVID-19" in public communications.
Kiswahili: WHO vile vile inatumia "virusi vya COVID-19" and "virusi vinavyosababisha COVID-19" katika mawasiliano ya umma.
Ekegusii: WHO pia inatumia "virusi vya COVID-19" na"virusi vinavyosababisha COVID-19", katika mawasiliano ya umma.

English: People with symptoms should talk to a healthcare provider.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bare nemeroberio yoborwaria goikerania korwa omonyene bwoborwaria.

English: The "Essential Health Care Program" implemented by the Department of Education in the Philippines is an example of at scale action to promote children's health and education.
Kiswahili: "Programu ya Kimsingi ya Huduma ya Afya" iliyotekelezwa na Wizara ya Elimu huko Ufilipino ni mfano wa hatua ya hali ya juu kukuza afya na elimu ya watoto.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (Essential Health Care Program) getenenerete ase omobasekano o'Philippines nigo nigo ekero ekero okorwania oborwari na chisemi ase abana.

English: In the meantime, you can continue to find the information from this email, and all other essential COVID-19 related information, on Office Wiki.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, unaweza kuendelea kutafuta maelezo kutoka kwa barua pepe hii, na maelezo mengine yote muhimu yanayohusiana na COVID-19, kwenye Office Wiki.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, oranyare korwa omoroberio o'eimeiri eyio, amo n'omoroberio onsi o'Covid-19 goikerania, ase Office Wiki.

English: As it happens, you probably aren't missing much by staying home, as many attractions around the world are closing their doors to avoid spreading the disease.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na hali ilivyo, hakuna vitu vingi unavyokosa kwa kukaa nyumbani, kwa kuwa vivutio vingi duniani vimefunga milango yao ili kuepuka kueneza ugonjwa huu.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania ng'a, gose otari korenta chingaki chionsi korwa ase ensemo, buna ebinto binde biria bigokonya ase enchera engiya nigo bikorenta amachiko ao gotanga oborwaria obo.

English: However, questions still remain since many confirmed cases of MERS have no contact history with camels prior to symptom onset, plausibly ascribed to human-to-human transmission or unknown transmission routes involving unrecognized animal species that harbour MERS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, maswali bado hayajajibiwa kwa kuwa visa vingi vya watu waliothibitishwa kuwa na MERS hawana historia ya kutangamana na ngamia kabla ya kuanza kwa dalili, na kuashiria pakubwa maambukizi ya binadamu hadi kwa binadamu au njia zisizojulikana za usambazaji zinazohusisha aina za wanyama ambao hawajatambuliwa wanaobeba MERS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Hata hivyo, maswali bado yanabaki tangu visa vingi vilivyothibitishwa vya MERS havina historia ya kugusana na ngamia kabla ya dalili kuonekana, na kwa kuaminika vinahusianishwa na usambazaji kutoka kwa binadamu hadi kwa binadamu au njia zisizojulikana za usafirishaji zinazohusisha aina zisizotambuliwa za wanyama zinazobeba MERS-CoV.

English: New York State began trials for the antibiotic azithromycin on 24 March 2020.
Kiswahili: Jimbo la New York lilianza majaribio ya kiua vijasumu cha azithromycin tarehe 24 Machi 2020.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia New York nkiaambokire ogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia amatemwa (antibiotic) ase azithromycin omotienyi 24 omotieny 3 omwaka 2020.

English: The drying effect of alcohol can be reduced or eliminated by adding glycerin and/or other emollients to the formula.
Kiswahili: Athari ya alkoholi ya kukausha ngozi inaweza kupunguzwa au kuondolewa kwa kuongeza gliserini na/au viungo vingine vya emolineti kwenye fomula hiyo.

English: In SARS-CoV, the RBD is in the 318th to 510th amino acids on the S1 fragment, which binds to the human ACE2 as well as its coreceptors for viral entry.

English: Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) informs all users of Kenya’s ports that an Advance Cargo Declaration (ACD) platform, a digital pre-arrival cargo system for all containerised cargo destined for Kenya ports is now available.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri (KRA) nkiabarure abanto bonsi baria bakorigereria ebinto bia Kenya ng'a ebinto biria bigotwara ebinto (ACD), ebinto biogotwara oboremi bwagechidichitari ase ebinto ebionsi biria bikoretwe goikerania ebito bia Kenya.

English: COVID-19 patients transmit the virus even when they are symptomless whereas SARS patients do so usually when they are severely ill, which causes much greater difficulty to contain the spread of COVID-19 than SARS.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa wa COVID-19 wanasambaza virusi hata wakati hawaonyeshi dalili zozote huku wagonjwa wa SARS wakiwa wanafanya hivyo wakiwa katika hali mbaya sana, jambo linalosababisha ugumu zaidi wa kudhibiti kuenea kwa COVID-19 kuliko SARS.

English: Particularly in developing countries where law enforcement are poorly trained, enforcement of curfew, lockdown or stay-at-home orders are often brutal, often using forces not proportionate against crowds.

English: Stated in April, imperatives of the CEPI initiative for vaccine development are speed, manufacturing capacity, deployment at scale, and global access.

English: It is therefore impossible to sacrifice all camels for the control of MERS, as what was done in wild animal markets in China to prevent the spreading of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2.

English: However, verification and clarification are necessary to propose the method for large-scale use before specific therapies are not yet developed.

English: To maintain growth, cabbage requires a consistent supply of moisture, and should as a general rule receive a minimum of 2.5 cm of water per week.

Kiswahili: Rais wa Marekani Donald Trump amesutwa kwa kurejelea virusi vya korona kuwa "Virusi vya China", kauli inayozingatiwa na wahakiki kuwa ni la ubaguzi wa rangi na inayobagua Uchina.

English: Borrell also said that "China is aggressively pushing the message that, unlike the US, it is a responsible and reliable partner."

English: The World Health Organization issued a global alert soon after.

English: The New England Journal of Medicine reports that a lack of hand-washing remains at unacceptable levels in most medical environments, with large numbers of doctors and nurses routinely forgetting to wash their hands before touching patients, thus transmitting microorganisms.
Kiswahili: Jarida la The New England linaripoti kuwa ukosefu wa kuosha mikono unasalia katika viwango visivyokubalika katika mazingira mengi ya kimatibabu, huku idadi kubwa ya madaktari na wauguzi wakisahau kila mara kuosha mikono yao kabla ya kuwagusa wagonjwa na hivyo kusambaza viini.

English: According to Dr Meerjady, two cases were aged above 60, two between 51 and 60, and one 41-50 years old.

English: OSHA considers healthcare and mortuary workers exposed to known or suspected person with COVID-19 to be at high exposure risk, which increases to very high exposure risk if workers perform aerosol-generating procedures on, or collect or handle specimens from, known or suspected person with COVID-19.

Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa macho: pleurisy, pericarditis, pafu kujazwa na kioevu badala ya hewa na mkusanyiko wa maji katika tishu na nafasi za hewa za mapafu.
