English: While intact ORF4 could be observed in bat and camel viruses related to HCoV-229E, the alpaca alpha-CoV displays a single nucleotide insertion, resulting in a frameshift.
Kiswahili: Huku ORF4 thabiti ikiwa na uwezekano wa kupatikana kwenye virusi vinavyopatikana kwenye popo na ngamia vinavyohusiana na HCoV-229E, virusi vya alpha-CoV vilivyopatikana kwenye alpaca vilionyesha kuwekwa kwa nukleotidi moja, kukisababisha kubadilika kwa fremu.
Ekegusii: Ijapokuwa ORF4 haijakamatwa inaweza kuonekana katika virusi vya popo na ngamia vinavyohusiana na HCoV-229E, alpaca alpha-CoV inaonyesha uingizaji wa nucleotide moja, na kusababisha mabadiliko ya fremu.

English: A lumbar puncture or electromyography (EMG) may be done for supportive information, though should not delay treatment.
Ekegusii: Ogochora gose omochando omonene (EMG) goikorwa ase obomanyi bwogokonya, gose gotagendererete gokeania oborwaria.

English: An AI-powered Early Warning System that uses climate and vector data to predict malaria outbreaks, strengthening surveillance accuracy, timely response, and resilience to climate-driven transmission.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboremi bw'obongo (AI) nkogotumia amachiko igoro y'obobwenia bw'ebinto biria bigokonya korwa omochando bw'omochando (Climate and Vector data) gosegeta obotuki bwa Esosera, gokong'ia oboronge bw'okwegendereria, obotoki bw'ekero, na obogima bw'ogokonya ekero ebinto biogokonyarigwa ase oboremia.

English: Communities should be involved in deciding the location of oral rehydration points (ORPs) and other community cholera control interventions.
Ekegusii: Ebinyoro biranyare kobwaterania ase okorenta oboremi bw'ebinto biria bigotumia ebinyoro (ORPs) na oborendi bwerigesa ria cholera.

English: Presumably, it has already been adapted to another host close to humans.
Kiswahili: Inaweza kuchukuliwa kwamba, tayari vimezoeleka kwa mbebaji mwingine wa karibu na binadamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo gokora ng'a enchera eyemo, yabekirwe ase enchera eng'e endagera eyemo yogoikerania ase abanto.

English: Fifth, no conclusions could be drawn about underlying conditions that were not included in the case report form or about different conditions that were reported in a single, umbrella category.
Kiswahili: Tano, hakuna mahitimisho ambayo yangetolewa kuhusu hali sugu ambazo hazikujumuishwa kwenye fomu ya kuripoti visa au kuhusu hali tofauti ambazo ziliripotiwa katika kategoria moja ya jumla.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene, gochia goikeranwa igoro yamatemwa igoro yebitambokero ebirengererio bitari korwa omoroberio bwokoruta chibesa gose igoro yobotambe bwendagera ebinyoro bionsi bigotambokerwa ase ekerasi ekenene.

English: The surveillance system should be able to identify areas where COVID-19 spread is taking place that might be suitable for trials of antiviral therapy.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa uchunguzi unapaswa kuweza kutambua maeneo ambao maenezi ya COVID-19 yanafanyika yanayoweza kufaa kufanyia majaribio ya tiba dhidi ya virusi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gotanga obokoreri bwebinyoro (COVID-19) nigo kegokonya korwa ebinto biria bigokonya gosegeta oborwaria bw'ebinyoro.

English: On 23 March 2020, Cambridge International Examinations (CIE) released a statement announcing the cancellation of Cambridge IGCSE, Cambridge O Level, Cambridge International AS & A Level, Cambridge AICE Diploma, and Cambridge Pre-U examinations for the May/June 2020 series across all countries.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 23 Machi 2020, Mitihani ya Kimataifa ya Cambridge (CIE) ilitoa taarifa ikitangaza kukatizwa kwa Cambridge IGCSE, Cambridge Kiwango cha O, Cambridge Kiwango cha AS & A, Cambridge AICE Diploma, na mitihani ya Cambridge kabla ya Chuo Kikuu kwa mfulilizo wa Mei/Juni 2020 katika nchi zote.
Ekegusii: Tariki 23 Machi 2020, Cambridge International Examinations (CIE) yaachie taarifa ikitangaza kufutwa kwa Cambridge IGCSE, Cambridge O Level, Cambridge International AS & A Level,Cambridge AICE Diploma, na Cambridge Pre-U exams for the May/June 2020 series across all countries.

English: Manufacturers are reminded of their obligation to submit their Excise Duty Returns for the month of June 2026 and pay the taxes due by 20th July, 2026.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baranyorigwe igoro yoboronge bwabo koenekia obokoreri bwabo ase omotienyi 6 omwaka 20226 na kobeka emeroberio eyemo ekero ekoremerwa nyuma yechitariki 20 chiomotienyi 7, 2026.

English: Land preparation The fields should be cleaned by removing tree stumps, bushes and perennial weeds.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bweserikari Ebirima biranyare gokorerwa buya ase okorenta ebinto biria bigosegeta emete, emete na emete.

English: Nevertheless, the features of SARS-CoV-2 including its transmissibility, pathogenicity and sustainable spreading after passages in humans will be influential on the ultimate fate of the ongoing outbreak of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Licha ya hayo, vipengele vya SARS-CoV-2 ikiwa ni pamoja na uwezo wa kusambazwa, uwezo wa kuambukiza na kuendelea kusambaa baada ya kupitishwa kwa binadamu vitakuwa na ushawishi kwenye hatima ya mkurupuko unaoendelea wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Hata hivyo, sifa za SARS-CoV-2 ikiwa ni pamoja na uwezo wake wa kusambazwa, uwezo wa kusababisha magonjwa na kuenea kwa muda mrefu baada ya kupita kwa binadamu zitakuwa na ushawishi juu ya hatima ya mkurupuko unaoendelea wa COVID-19.

English: On 20 March, the United States began to partially withdrawal its troops from Iraq due to the pandemic.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 20 Machi, Marekani ilianza kuondoa jeshi lake kiasi kutoka Iraki kutokana na janga.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 20 omotienyi omotaraba, America yatangirie gotacha abasikari baye gochia Iraq ase omoroberio omonene.

English: As Robyn mentioned previously, the c-team met last night to discuss our approach and schedule for the coming days and months.
Kiswahili: Kama Robyn alivyotaja awali, timu c ilikutana usiku uliopita ili kujadili njia na ratiba yetu ya siku na miezi ijayo.
Ekegusii: buna Robyn abwatirie kera, ekeombe kia c kiabwateranirie omotienyi o'bwenerete gosegeta omoroberio bwetugo na oboremi bwechitariki na emetienyi erio ekenene.

English: All four community-acquired HCoVs causing mild symptoms have been well adapted to humans.
Kiswahili: Virusi vyote vinne vya HCoVs vinavyosambazwa kijamii vinavyosababisha dalili za wastani vimezoea binadamu.
Ekegusii: Virusi vyote vinne vya HCoV vinavyosambazwa na jamii vinavyosababisha dalili za hali ya chini vimebadilishwa vizuri kwa binadamu.

English: And remember, viruses enter through your mouth, nose, and eyes – wiping down the area doesn't hurt, but it's not a substitute for proper hygiene.
Kiswahili: Na ukumbuke, virusi vinaingia kupitia mdomo, pua, na macho yako - kupangusa eneo si vibaya, lakini sio mbadala wa usafi kamili.
Ekegusii: Na kumbuka, virusi vinaingia kupitia mdomo wako, pua, na macho, kusafisha eneo hilo si vibaya, lakini sio mbadala wa usafi sahihi.

English: On 10 April 2020, Google and Apple, the companies that control the Android and iOS mobile platforms, announced an initiative for contact tracing, which they claimed would preserve privacy, based on a combination of Bluetooth Low Energy technology and privacy-preserving cryptography.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 10 Aprili 2020, Google na Appe, kampuni zinazodhibiti majukwaa ya simu ya Android na iOs, zilitangaza mpango wa kutafuta watu waliotangamana, ambayo walidai kuwa walinda faragha, kulingana na mchanganyiko wa teknolojia ya Bluetooth Low Enerygy na ufichamishi wa uhifadhi wa faragha.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 10 omotienyi 4 omwaka 2020, Google na Apple, ebinyoro biria bigotumia Android na iOS, mbagete omoroberio omonene bwogokonya baria batamete chingaki chiabo, na goikerania ng'a ekero ekorenda amang'ana, ekiagera ekerengete oborendi bwao, goetera ekerengererio kia tekinorochia ya Bluetooth Low Energy na obokoreri bw'obotuki bwao.

English: If you are away from home, and especially if you are in another country, consider returning home as soon as possible; this may get even more difficult as restrictions continue to change.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa uko mbali na nyumbani, na hasa ikiwa uko katika nchi nyingine, zingatia kurudi nyumbani haraka iwezekanavyo, hii inaweza kuwa vigumu zaidi kwa kuwa vikwazo vinaendelea kubadilika.
Ekegusii: Kama uko mbali na nyumbani, na hasa ikiwa uko katika nchi nyingine, fikiria kurudi nyumbani haraka iwezekanavyo; hii inaweza kuwa ngumu zaidi kwani vikwazo vinaendelea kubadilika.

English: He said, in remarks published by CNN in February, "other than influenza, no other respiratory virus has been tracked from emergence to continuous global spread."
Kiswahili: Alisema, katika maoni yaliyochapishwa na CNN Februari, "bali na homa ya mafua, hakuna virusi vyovyote vya kupumua vilivyofuatiliwa kutoka kuenea hadi kuendelea kuenea kimataifa."
Ekegusii: Okoririe ng'a omoroberio bwechinkwana chieserikari (CNN) bwokoririe omotienyi omonene omotano omotieny, "ng'a endagera eyemo yengencho y'obongo, gochia endagara eyemo yokoremerwa gose okogendererigwa ase enchera engiya."

English: Human angiotensin converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) is known to be the receptor of SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Homoni ya binadamu inayosababisha shinikizo la damu inayobadilisha enzaimu 2 (ACE2) inafahamika kuwa kipokezi cha SARS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Enzyme ya uongofu ya angiotensin ya binadamu 2 (ACE2) inajulikana kuwa kipokezi cha SARS-CoV.

English: By 10 March, one in five students worldwide was "staying away from school due to the COVID-19 crisis" while another one in four was barred from higher education institutions.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 10 machi, moja kati ya wanafunzi watano ulimwenguni walikuwa "hawako shuleni kwa sababu ya hali ya hatari ya COVID-19" ilhali wengine moja kati ya wanne walizuiliwa katika taasisi za elimu ya ngazi ya juu.
Ekegusii: Chitariki 10 chiomotienyi 3 omotienyi 1 ase abana batano ase chisukuru chionsi chiria chiesukuru chiria chire na COVID-19 (COVID-19 crisis) ekero omonto 1 ase abanto batano abareirwe gosoa chisukuru.

English: Hazard controls appropriate for these workers include engineering controls such as negative pressure ventilation rooms, and personal protective equipment appropriate to the job task.
Kiswahili: Udhibiti wa hatari zinazofaa wafanyakazi hawa hujumuisha udhibiti za uhandisi kama vile vyumba vilivyo na hewa iliyo kiwango cha chini na mazingira, na vifaa vya kujikinga kibinafsi vinavyofaa kazi inayofanywa.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio biobochenu buna abakoreri aba bigosegeta obokoreri buna ebiombe biogokonya omochando, na ebinto biria bikorenda oborendi bwebinyoro biria bigokonya oboremi bwabo.

English: WHO supports a holistic health sector response to FGM prevention and care, by developing guidance and resources for health workers to prevent FGM and manage its complications and by supporting countries to adapt and implement these resources to local contexts.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (WHO) nkigendererete gosegeta obokoreri bwoborwaria igoro yokorenda na korenda obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (FGM), erio gokinia oboteneneri na ebirengererio ase abakori emeremo yobochenu erio gotanga kobua chipomu na gokonya emeremo goikerania na koenekia ebibikoreri ebi goetera obokoroberio bwebinyoro.

English: Avocado oil, extracted from the fruit is cholesterol free, of the monounsaturated type believed to protect against heart disease and certain kinds of cancers.
Ekegusii: Mafuta ya avocado, yanayotolewa kutokana na matunda hayana cholesterol, ya aina isiyo na mafuta mengi, ambayo inasemekana kulinda dhidi ya magonjwa ya moyo na aina fulani za saratani.

English: Trump made the decision under provisions of the National Emergencies Act, amongst other governing authorities.
Kiswahili: Trump alifanya uamuzi chini ya kanuni za Sheria ya Kitaifa ya Dharura, miongoni mwa mamlaka nyingine tawala.
Ekegusii: Trump akatoa uamuzi huo kwa mujibu wa masharti ya Sheria ya Kitaifa ya Hali ya Dharura, miongoni mwa mamlaka zingine za serikali.

English: Subsequent seroprevalence investigations indicated that animal traders had a higher prevalence of anti-SARS-CoV IgG compared with that of the general population.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi uliofuata wa kiwango cha maambukizi uliashiria kuwa wafanyabiashara ya wanyama walikuwa na kiwango cha juu cha anti-SARS-CoV igG ikilinganishwa na idadi ya jumla ya watu.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwechinyomba chiria chiogotumia seroprevalence bwokorigia ng'a abaremi bemebasekano ya chinsemo chinyomba babwenerete korwa igG ya anti-SARS-CoV korwa ase abanto bonsi.

English: Ms Nakholo, the Commission urged, knew or ought to have known that the suit property was reserved and developed with Government residential houses and was therefore unavailable for allocation.
Ekegusii: Nyomba Nakholo, Ekeombe kiaboririe, kiaamanyete gose kiabwenerete goikerania ng'a ebinto ebio biranyareirwe na gosegetigwa ase ebinyoro bia eserikari, na buna buna endagera eyio tari yabekirwe.

English: There are various theories about where the very first case (the so-called patient zero) may have originated.
Kiswahili: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu mahali kisa cha kwanza (inayojulikana kama mgonjwa wa kwanza) huenda alitokea.
Ekegusii: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu mahali ambapo kisa cha kwanza kabisa (ambacho kinajulikana kama zero ya mgonjwa) kinaweza kutokea.

English: German government conducted a 48 hours weekend hackathon with more than 42.000 participants.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Ujerumani iliendesha tukio la kutengeneza programu za kompyuta na washiriki zaidi ya 42.000.
Ekegusii: Eserekali yomoGermany yarure omoroberio bwamasomo bwamasana 48 ase chingaki chieserikari na abanto baria bare ase abanto 42.000.

English: On 11 March 2020, WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic.
Kiswahili: Mnamo tarehe 11 Machi 2020, WHO iliainisha COVID-19 kuwa ni janga kubwa.
Ekegusii: Tarehe 11 Machi 2020, WHO ilifafanua COVID-19 kama janga kubwa.

English: Viral cytopathic changes were observed in the pneumocytes.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko makubwa kati seli pia yalionekana katika seli za ufizi.
Ekegusii: Mabadiliko ya cytopathic ya virusi yalionekana katika viini vya mapafu.

English: All but a handful of countries have reported at least one case, with the highest numbers of reported cases in the United States, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, mainland China, Iran, and the United Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Karibu nchi zote zimeripoti angalau kisa kimoja, idadi kubwa zaidi ya visa vilivyoripotiwa ikiwa ni Marekani, Hispania, Italia, Ujerumani, Ufaransa, China Kuu, Irani, na Uingereza.
Ekegusii: Nchi zote isipokuwa chache zimeripoti angalau kisa kimoja, na idadi kubwa zaidi ya visa vilivyoripotiwa ni Marekani, Uhispania, Italia, Ujerumani, Ufaransa, Uchina, Iran, na Uingereza.

English: According to OSHA, medium exposure risk jobs include those that require frequent or close contact within six feet (1.8 m) of people who are not known or suspected COVID-19 patients, but may be infected with SARS-CoV-2 due to ongoing community transmission around the business location, or because the individual has recent international travel to a location with widespread COVID-19 transmission.
Kiswahili: Kwa mujibu wa OSHA, kazi za kuwa hatarini kwa kiwango cha wastani inajumuisha zile ambazo zinahitaji kutangamana na watu mara kwa mara au kuwa karibu na watu kati ya futi sita (mita 1.8) ambao hawajulikani au kushukiwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19, lakini huenda wameambukizwa na SARS-CoV-2 kutokana na usambazaji unaoendelea wa kijamii karibu na eneo la biashara, au kwa sababu mtu huyo amesafiri kimataifa hivi karibuni hadi eneo iliyo na usambazaji mkubwa wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Kwa mujibu wa OSHA, kazi za hatari ya wastani zinajumuisha zile zinazohitaji kugusana na watu mara kwa mara au karibu ndani ya futi sita (1.8m) ya watu ambao hawajulikani au wanaoshukiwa kuwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19, lakini wanaweza kuambukizwa SARS-CoV-2 kutokana na usambazaji unaoendelea wa jamii karibu na eneo la biashara, au kwa sababu mtu huyo amesafiri kimataifa hivi majuzi hadi mahali ambapo usambaishaji wa COVID-19 umeenea.

English: According to demographic studies so far, COVID-19 seems to have different epidemiological features from SARS.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na utafiti wa kidemografia kufikia sasa, COVID-19 inaonekana kuwa na vipengele vya kiepidemiolojia tofauti na vya SARS.
Ekegusii: Kwa mujibu wa uchunguzi wa idadi ya watu hadi sasa, COVID-19 inaonekana kuwa na sifa tofauti za kiepidemiolojia kutoka kwa SARS.

English: Individuals with compromised immune systems, including people living with HIV, should ideally receive two or three doses.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bare nechinguru chiabo chia boronge, goikerania abanto baria bonsi bare na oborwaire bwa HIV, kobwenerete korwa ebirengererio bibidi gose bitato.

English: In the early phase of the SARS outbreak, a range of psychiatric morbidities including persistent depression, anxiety, panic attacks, psychomotor excitement, psychotic symptoms, delirium, and even suicidality were reported.
Kiswahili: Katika awamu ya awali ya mkurupuko wa SARS, matatizo mbalimbali ya kiakili yanayojumuisha mfadhaiko uliokithiri, wasiwasi, mashambulizi ya hofu, msisimko wa kiakili, dalili za matatizo ya kiakili, hali ya kusumbuliwa kiakili na hata watu kutaka kujitoa uhai ziliripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korwa SARS, ebirengererio bioborwaria buna oborwaria bw'obongo, buna obokong'u, oboremi, obokebago, obokonyi bw'omongo, obosaria, na oboikeranu bw'okwerenda.

English: COVID-19 was confirmed to have spread to South Korea on 20 January 2020 from China.
Kiswahili: COVID-19 ilithibitishwa kuenea hadi Korea Kusini mnamo 20 Januari 2020 kutoka Uchina.
Ekegusii: COVID-19 ilihakikishwa kuenea hadi Korea Kusini tarehe 20 Januari 2020 kutoka China.

English: Interventions such as information, education and communication on safe food practices, improved sanitation and veterinary public health measures should be implemented to decrease transmission rates and reduce risk of infection.
Ekegusii: Oborendi buna obomanyi, amasomo na obokonyi igoro yoborendi bwechindagera, oboremi obuya na emeroberio yoborwaria bwabanto igoro yogotumia omoroberio bwokoruta chinguru na gosegeta obosemia.

English: The film industry has also experienced disruption.The Vatican announced that Holy Week observances in Rome, which occur during the last week of the Christian penitential season of Lent, have been cancelled.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya filamu pia imepata mvurugo. Vatican ilitangaza kuwa maadhimisho ya Wiki Kuu Roma, ambayo huwa katika wiki ya mwisho wa msimu ya Wakristo kutubu wa Kwaresima, zimefutwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri bwamafilimu nabo nkiagendererete obokong'u.Ekeombe kia Vatican kiabarure ng'a omoroberio bweserikari omotambe omonene ase Roma, ogokorwa ase eserikari ya nyuma yechitariki chiria abakoreri bakorire oborokererio bwokoruta chibesa (Lenten) nigo bakoretwe.

English: Compared to SARS-CoV with a high mutation rate, the mutation rate of SARS-CoV-2 is apparently lower, suggestive of a higher level of adaptation to humans.
Kiswahili: Ikilinganishwa na virusi vya SARS-CoV vilivyo na viwango vya juu vya kubadilika, viwango vya kubadilika kwa SARS-CoV-2 ni bayana kuwa viko chini, hali inayoashiria uwezekano wa juu zaidi wa kuzoeleka kwa binadamu.
Ekegusii: Ikilinganishwa na SARS-CoV yenye kiwango cha juu cha mabadiliko, kiwango cha mabadiliko ya SARS-COV-2 inaonekana kuwa chini, ikimaanisha kiwango cha hali ya juu ya kukabiliana na binadamu.

English: Histopathological examinations of post-mortem lung samples show diffuse alveolar damage with cellular fibromyxoid exudates in both lungs.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya histopatholojia vya sampuli za mapafu za baada ya kufa vinaonyesha mabadiliko fulani katika muundo wa mapafu na ugonjwa kali wa kupumua katika mapafu yote.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bw'obobongo bw'ebinto biria bigokorwa nyuma y'ogotemwa kw'ebirengererio biranyorekana obokong'u bw'amabere ao ao ao na obotuki bwa fibromyxoid bw'emeteo ase emeteo yomoi.

English: On February 18, 2020, the first pathological analysis of COVID-19 demonstrated the desquamation of pneumocytes, hyaline membrane formation, and interstitial lymphocyte infiltration, and multinucleated syncytial cells in the lungs of a patient who died of the disease, consistent with the pathology of viral infection and ARDS and similar to that of SARS and MERS patients.
Kiswahili: Mnamo tarehe 18, Februari 2020, uchanganuzi wa kwanza wa kipatholojia wa COVID-19 uliashiria kubambuliwa kwa sehemu za ndani za mapafu, muundo wa utandu wa hyaline, kuingia kwa lymphocytes mwilini kupitia vijia na seli za zenye nyulia nyingi kwenye mapafu ya mgnjwa ambaye alikufa kutokana na ugonjwa huu, kwa ulinganifu na patholojia ya maambukizi ya virusi na ARDS na sawa na ule wa wagonjwa wa SARS na MERS.
Ekegusii: Tarehe 18 Februari, 2020, uchambuzi wa kwanza wa kimatibabu wa COVID-19 ulionyesha kutoweka kwa seli za mapafu, kuundwa kwa membrane ya hyaline, na uingizaji wa seli za lymphocyte za kati, na seli za syncytial zenye nyukilia nyingi katika mapafu ya mgonjwa aliyekufa kutokana na ugonjwa huo, kulingana na hali ya maambukizi ya virusi na ARDS na sawa na ya wagonjwa wa SARS na MERS.

English: Rates of cardiovascular symptoms is high, owing to the systemic inflammatory response and immune system disorders during disease progression, but acute myocardial injury may also be related to ACE2 receptors in the heart.
Kiswahili: Viwango vya dalili za ugonjwa wa moyo ni ya juu, kwa sababu ya ugonjwa wa mfumo wa kujibu uchochezi na mfumo wa kinga wakati wa maendeleo ya ugonjwa huo, lakini jeraha kali la ukuta wa moyo unaweza pia unahusiana na vipokezi za ACE2 moyoni.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bw'oborwaire bw'omwoyo n'omogondo omonene, goetera oboremi bwechinsemo na oborwaire bwa oborwaria bw'oborwaria (immune system) ekero oborwari bwegwenerete gokong'u, korwa oborema bwa'myocardial (myocardial) nabwo nabwo bwendagete ase ebinto bia ACE2 ase omoyo.

English: On Thursday, Sergei Sobyanin, the mayor of Moscow, extended the city lockdown to May 1.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Alhamisi, Sergei Sobyanin, meya wa Moscow, aliendelezwa kufungwa kwa shughuli za jiji hadi tarehe 1 Mei.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene, Sergei Sobyanin, omosikari omonene omonene bweserikari ya Moscow, abekeire omoroberio bwokwerenda goika omotienyi 5.

English: The Communications Authority of Kenya warns the public never to share M-Pesa PINs or one-time codes with anyone, including callers claiming to be agents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaonya umma kutowahi kugawa PIN za M-Pesa au misimbo ya kuthibitisha na mtu yeyote, hata wanaojiita mawakala.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obomanyi (Kenya Communications Authority) nkiaboririe abanto kobwaterana ebinto bia M-Pesa (PINs) gose ebinto biria bionsi biria bigokonya korwa ebinto biobochori (single-time codes) na abanto bonsi, goika abanto baria bakorete ng'a babwenerete koba abamenyi.

English: Soils should be clean and high in organic matter.

English: There are two types of canine coronavirus (CCoV), one that causes mild gastrointestinal disease and one that has been found to cause respiratory disease.

English: On 11 March, Prime Minister Conte ordered stoppage of nearly all commercial activity except supermarkets and pharmacies.On 6 March, the Italian College of Anaesthesia, Analgesia, Resuscitation and Intensive Care (SIAARTI) published medical ethics recommendations regarding triage protocols that might be employed.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 11 Machi, Waziri Mkuu Conte aliagiza kuachishwa kwa takriban shughuli zote za kiuchumi isipokuwa maduka makubwa na maduka ya dawa.Mnamo 6 Machi, Taasisi ya Anesthesia ya Italia, Analgeisa, Kuhuisha na Uchungaji wa Hali ya Juu (SIAARTI) mapendekezo yaliyochapishwa ya maadili ya kiafya kuhusu itifaki ya kuchuja wagonjwa inayoweza kutumika.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 11 omotienyi 3 omoteneneri omonene, Conte, ogotokeirie ogocheka kwa ebikoru bionsi igoro yoborendi goetera ebinto biria bigosegeta oborendi bwendagera.Omotienyi 6 omotianyi 3 omotieny, Italian College of Anaesthesia, Analgesia, Resuscitation and Intensive Care (SIAARTI) yaasire ogokurerwa kwa oborwaria igoro yogotumia oborwari.

English: To stop the recurrent outbreaks of MERS, a comprehensive approach should be taken to develop effective vaccines against MERS-CoV for camels, in combination with other infection control measures.
Kiswahili: Ili kukomesha mikurupuko ya mara kwa mara ya MERS, mwelekeo tondoti unapaswa kuchukuliwa ili kuunda chanjo inayofaa dhidi ya MERS-CoV kwa ngamia, pamoja na mikakati mingine ya kudhibiti maambukizi.
Ekegusii: Erio gotanga ebirengererio bia MERS igoro yobokoreri, enchera eyemo yoboremi goikeranwa erio kogesa emeroberio eyemo yokorwania MERS-CoV ase enyamera, korwa ebinto biria bigosegeta oboremi obuya.

English: Practise a 2 to 3 year rotation.

English: However, patients transferred to an ICU had a median time of seven days between hospitalisation and death.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, wagonjwa waliohamishwa kwa chumba cha hali mahututi walikuwa na muda wastani wa siku saba kati ya kulazwa hospitalini na kufa.
Ekegusii: Na bado, wagonjwa waliohamishwa kwenye chumba cha afya kali walikuwa na muda wa wastani wa siku saba kati ya kulazwa hospitalini na kufa.

English: WASH FIT aims to guide small, primary health care facilities in low- and middle-income settings through a continuous cycle of improvement through assessments, prioritization of risk, and definition of specific, targeted actions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (WASH FIT) nkiagendererete gokora emeremo yoborwari bwoborwaria bwobotambe ase ebinyoro na ebinto bioboremi goetera omoroberio bwokoruta buya goetera oboremi, okorwania ebinto biria bigosegeta obokoreri, na gosegeta ebirengererio biria biranyare.

English: Although questions remain, there is no evidence that SARS-CoV-2 is man-made either deliberately or accidentally.
Kiswahili: Ingawa maswali bado yanasalia, hakuna ushahidi kwamba virusi vya SARS-CoV-2 vimetengenezwa na binadamu kwa kukusudia kwa bahati mbaya.

English: On the other hand, cured patients can be positive for the virus again.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mwingine, wagonjwa waliotibiwa wanaweza kupatikana na virusi hivi tena.
Ekegusii: Kwa upande mwingine, wagonjwa waliopona wanaweza kuwa na virusi tena.

English: When MERS became prevalent, it was believed that existing SARS research may provide a useful template for developing vaccines and therapeutics against a MERS-CoV infection.
Kiswahili: Wakati MARS ilianza kuenea, iliaminika kuwa utafiti uliopo wa SARS unaweza kutoa kiolezo muhimu cha kukuza chanjo na matibabu dhidi ya maambukizo ya MERS-CoV.
Ekegusii: MERS ilipoenea sana, iliaminika kuwa utafiti uliopo wa SARS unaweza kutoa templeti muhimu ya kutengeneza chanjo na matibabu dhidi ya maambukizi ya MERS-CoV.

English: Where testing capacity is limited, tests should first be done for those at higher risk of infection, such as health workers, and those at higher risk of severe illness such as older people, especially those living in seniors’ residences or long-term care facilities.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chiogotemwa chingaki chiria chiria chitari chinyinge, chingaki chiokororwa ase abanto baria bakwegendereria korwa oborwaria, buna abarimu ba oborwari, na abanto bagotemwa korwa ebirengererio biria bigotwara oborwaire buna abanto abakwegete, mono abanto bonsi baria bagendererete korwa emeremo yoborwari bwa kera.

English: It is usually better to add tomatoes onto vegetables, avoid cooking tomatoes for long so as to retain Vitamin C.
Ekegusii: Enchera engiya nigo egokonya kobeka amatamatani ase ebimera, gotanga okobeka amatamati ase chingaki chionsi erio korenda vitamini C.

English: Health-care activities protect and restore health and save lives.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwoborwaria bwokorenda na gosegeta oborwaria na korenda amang'ana.

English: Based on the comparative analysis between isolates of human and civet SARS-CoVs, SARS-CoV is thought to undergo rapid adaptation in different hosts, particularly with mutations at the RBD of the S protein.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na uchanganuzi wa kiulinganisho kati ya SARS-CoV ndani ya binadamu na ngawa, SARS-CoV inadhaniwa kuzoeleka haraka ndani ya wabebaji tofauti, hasa kwa mabadiliko katika RBD ya protini ya S.

Ekegusii: Okoraria ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto biogotumia ekondomu ekero ogokorerwa emeroberio yobokoreri bwokoruta chinguru na obokoreri bwebinyoro nigo enchera eyemo yokorenda oborwaria bwa chlamydial.

English: Women living with HIV should be screened every 3–5 years, starting at age 25 .
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi baria bakoretwe na oborwaire bw'obongo (HIV) nabo bagotenerwa goikeranwa nyuma y'emyaka 35, gochakera ase emyaka 25.

Ekegusii: Jina la mwisho la virusi hivi ni virusi vya korona vya ugonjwa wa kupumua vya Mashariki ya Kati (MERS-CoV).

English: A study comparing PCR to CT in Wuhan has suggested that CT is significantly more sensitive than PCR, though less specific, with many of its imaging features overlapping with other pneumonias and disease processes.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi unaolinganisha PCR na CT katika Wuhan umependekeza kuwa CT kwa kadri kubwa ni bora kuliko PCR, ingawa si mahususi, na vipengele vyake vya picha kuingiliana na mchochota wa pafu mengine na taratibu za ugonjwa.

English: The SRE, HR Ops, Trust & Safety, and Fundraising teams (among others) do critical work that may need additional support.
Kiswahili: Timu za SRE, HR Ops, Trust & Safety, and Fundraising (kati ya timu nyingine) zinafanya kazi muhimu ambazo zinaweza kuhitaji msaada wa ziada.
Ekegusii: Ekipomu chia SRE, HR Ops, Trust & Safety, and Fundraising (among others) nigo chikora obokoreri obuya bwogokonya.

English: Immunity is seen as likely, based on the behaviour of other coronaviruses, but cases in which recovery from COVID-19 have been followed by positive tests for coronavirus at a later date have been reported.
Kiswahili: Kinga huonekana kama na uwezekano, kulingana na tabia ya virusi vingine vya korona, lakini kuna ripoti ya matukio ambayo watu wamepona COVID-19 na yameambatana na vipimo chanya vya virusi vya korona katika siku za baadaye.
Ekegusii: Obotenereri bwebinyoro buna obwenerete, ase oborendi bw'ebinyoro bia korona, korwa ebinyoro ebio baranyare korwa COVID-19 na goikeranwa korwa emeremo ya korona nyuma.

Kiswahili: Ukatili wa kijinsia ni uhalifu nchini Kenya; washirika wanaopitia ukatili huu wanahimizwa kuripoti katika kituo cha polisi au kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: Early childhood educational programmes are usually designed for children below the age of 3 and may refer to preschools, nursery schools, kindergartens, and some day care programmes.

Ekegusii: Nonya ng'a oborwaria obo bwabereire ase chinese chinene, buna bwabwaterete ase enchera engima, na chinese nigo gotanga abanto abange baranyare korwa ebirengererio biao na baria bakorire oborai ase chindagera chionsi.

Kiswahili: Viwango vya juu vya kufeli vinavyohusiana na maendeleo ya dawa hujulikana kama "kiwango cha kutoa", vinavyohitaji maamuzi wakati wa hatua za mwanzo za maendeleo ya dawa ili "kuua" miradi mapema kuepuka kufeli ya gharama kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ebitengo bikorenta ebirengererio bigokwanerana na gosegeta oboremi bw'ebinto bia amariogo biranyareirwe buna "bitengo bia oborendi", buna bigosaba amang'ana ase ebinto bia kera ase ogosegeta ebinto bioborendi goikerania ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto binde.

English: The source accused Russia of embarking on a "geopolitical and diplomatic" charm offensive.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekenene kiabekire obokoreri bwa Russia goikerania omoroberio o'geopolitics and diplomacy.

English: Mutation and adaptation have driven the co-evolution of coronaviruses (CoVs) and their hosts, including human beings, for thousands of years.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya mwili na hali za kukabiliana na mazingira zimechangia kukua kwa virusi vya korona (CoVs) na wabebaji wake, ikiwa ni pamoja na binadamu kwa maelfu ya miaka.

Ekegusii: Segeta oborwaria obuya (ng'a oborito bw'amabere; obotambe) gose obonsi obuya obuya bwogokinia.

Kiswahili: Kohoa na upige chafya kwenye kiwiko chako au tishu, na kisha tupa tishu hiyo mara moja na unawe mikono yako.

Kiswahili: Katika uchunguzi uliofanywa na Tume ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Uchina (NHC), wanaume walikuwa na kiwango cha kifo cha asilimia 2.8 ambapo wanawake walikuwa na kiwango cha kifo cha asilimia 1.7.

English: Moisturizing lotion is often recommended to keep the hands from drying out; dry skin can lead to skin damage which can increase the risk for the transmission of infection.

English: Third, if a third mammal acts as the true intermediate host, how it interacts with the different species including humans, bats and pangolins has to be clarified.
Kiswahili: Tatu, ikiwa mamalia wa tatu atatumika kama mbebaji halisi wa kati, inapaswa kubainishwa jinsi mnyama huyo huingiliana na viumbe wengine ikiwa ni pamoja na binadamu, popo na kakakuona.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete, gose ekero ekeombe ekenene ekero ekorwe buna ekenyoro ekenene, buna ekorwania na ebinyoro biao buna abanto, ebinto biao, na ebinto bi'ebinyoro, goikeranwa.

English: Other school services remain open, but teaching is restricted to distant learning.
Kiswahili: Huduma zingine za shule zitafunguliwa, lakini mafunzo imewekewa vikwazo na kufanywa kupitia njia za kimtandao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete ase chisukuru nigo kegokorerwa, korwa chisukuru goikeranwa gochia chisukuru chionsi.

English: Trump did not place the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) in charge of the government's response to COVID-19, which Politico reported left some experts in disaster management disappointed.
Kiswahili: Trump hakulipa Shirikisho la Usimamizi wa Dharura (FEMA) kusimamia shughuli ya serikali kukabiliana na COVID-19, jambo ambalo Politico liliripoti kuwa liliwaacha baadhi ya wataalamu wa udhibiti wa majanga kutamaushwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri bwebinyoro (FEMA) ekiagera omoroberio bweserikari korwa COVID-19, ekeene Politico kiabwatete ng'a abakori emeremo bamanyete igoro yobokoreri bw'ebibago.

English: We have conducted initial searches within the RCGP RSC database to look at the number of full blood count (FBC) results and overall rates in adults and children (Figures 6-​-9).9).
Kiswahili: Tumefanya utafutaji wa awali ndani ya hifadhidata ya RCGP RSC ili kuangalia idadi ya matokeo ya idadi ya damu kamili (FBC) na viwango vya jumla kwa watu wazima na watoto (Picha ya 6--9).9).
Ekegusii: Twateteirie obotuki bwetugo ase ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (RCGP RSC) erio korigereria omoroberio omonene bwogokorwa kwerogongo (FBC) na oboremi bwebinyoro ase abakuru na abana (Ebitambokero 6- -9).9).9).

English: Residents are urged to pay their business permits early to avoid penalties and keep county services running.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanahimizwa kulipa vibali vyao vya biashara mapema ili kuepuka faini na kuwezesha huduma za kaunti kuendelea.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baborigwe kobakora chibesa chiabo ase oboremi bwao bweserikari goikera obosaria na gotanga obokoreri bwa eserikari.

English: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PED or PEDV), has emerged around the world.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa mlipuko wa nguruwe kuhara (PED au PEDV), umeibuka ulimwenguni kote.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene bwokoruta chinguru (PED gose PEDV), oboririe ase enchera engima.

English: Universities have closed for one week, but resumed with online teaching afterwards.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vimefungwa kwa wiki moja, lakini ikaendelea na masomo mtandaoni baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gose ebinyoro biria bigosomera chingaki chieserikari nigo bigotumia omoroberio o'intaneti nyuma yechitariki chionsi.

English: On February 14, 2020, the Feng Zhang group described a protocol of using the CRISPR-based SHERLOCK technique to detect SARS-CoV-2, which detects synthetic SARS-CoV-2 RNA fragments at 20 × 10-18 mol/L to 200 × 10-18 mol/L (10-100 copies per microliter of input) using a dipstick in less than an hour without requiring elaborate instrumentation.
Kiswahili: Mnamo tarehe 14 Februari 2020, kikundi cha Feng Zhang kilifafanua utaratibu wa kutumia mbinu ya SHERLOCK inayotegemea CRISPR kugundua SARS-CoV-2, ambayo inagundua vipande vya RNA vya kisinthetiki vya SARS-CoV-2 katika vipimo vya 20 × 10-18 mol/L hadi 200 × 10-18 mol/L (nakala 10-100 kwa kila lita ndogo ya mweko) kwa kutumia chuma cha kutumbukiza kwa chini ya saa moja bila kuhitaji kifaa cha uwezo changamano.
Ekegusii: Tarehe 14 Februari 2020, kikundi cha Feng Zhang kilielezea utaratibu wa kutumia mbinu ya SHERLOCK inayotegemea CRISPR kugundua SARS-CoV-2, ambayo inagundua vipande vya RNA vya SARS-COV-2 vya kisayansi kwa kiwango cha 20 × 10-18 mol/L hadi 200×10-18 mole/L (10-100 nakala kwa kila lita ndogo ya uingizaji) kwa kutumia kijiti katika muda usiozidi saa moja bila kuhitaji vifaa vya hali ya juu.

English: To further alleviate the shortage, Coles ordered bigger packages from suppliers and increased delivery frequency, Woolworths ordered extra stock, while ALDI made stocks for a planned Wednesday special available early.
Kiswahili: Ili kukabiliana na upungufu, Coles waliangiza vifurushi vikubwa kutoka kwa bidha na kuongeza kwa mara ya kuwasilisha bidhaa, Woolworths waliagiza bidhaa za ziada, huku ALDI walitengeneza bidhaa kwa ajili ya mipango ya Jumatano maalum mapema zaidi.
Ekegusii: Goikerania obokoreri, Coles yaboririe ebinto biria bigosegeta ase abaremi na gosegeta oboremi bwao, Woolworths yaoririe oborendi bwogokonya, na ALDI yaorete oboronge bwogotumia ebinto biogosegeta buna ebinto bigosereria ebinto biao biogosereria ase omotienyi omotano.

English: In 11.8% of the deaths reported by the National Health Commission of China, heart damage was noted by elevated levels of troponin or cardiac arrest.
Kiswahili: Katika asilimia 11.8 ya vifo vilivyoripotiwa na Tume ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Uchina, uharibifu wa moyo ulionekana na viwango vilivyoongezeka vya troponini au mshtuko wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Ase chinkwana 11.8% chiria chirepotiirwe na ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (National Health Commission) kia China, obokong'u bw'omwoyo bwareirwe ase oboremi bw'obongo (troponin) gose okorema kw'omoyo (cardial arrest).

English: International Baccalaureate exams have also been cancelled.School closures impact not only students, teachers, and families, but have far-reaching economic and societal consequences.
Kiswahili: Mitihani ya International Baccalaureate pia zimekatizwa.Kufungwa kwa shule haiathiri wanafunzi, walimu, na familia pekee, lakini zina athari inayowaathiri wengi za kiuchumi na kijamii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bweserikari (International Baccalaureate exams) nabwo kiabwenerete koiborigwa.Okoigwa kwa chisukuru goikeranete abana bonsi, abarimu, na ebinyoro, korwa ebinto biria bigokonya ebinto binde na ebinto bioboroso.

English: On January 20, the infection of health-care providers was reported, suggesting that human-to-human transmission was possible.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 20 Januari, maambukizi miongoni mwa watoa huduma ya matibabu yaliripotiwa, na kuashiria kuwa maambukizi kutoka kwa binadamu hadi binadamu yaliwezekana.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 20 omotienyi omotano omotambe omoroberio bwobobwenia bwoborwaria, na gosegeta ng'a ogotambokigwa kw'omonto gochia omonto nigo goikerania.

English: Although 96% genetic homolog was found between SARS-CoV-2 and two bat SARS-like CoVs, we still cannot conclude that SARS-CoV-2 is from bats.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mfanano wa kijenetiki wa 96% ulipatikana kati ya SARS-CoV-2 na CoV mbili vya SARS vinavyotokana na popo, bado hatuwezi kuhitimisha kwamba SARS-CoV-2 vinatokana na popo.
Ekegusii: Ijapokuwa homolojia ya kijenetiki ya 96% ilipatikana kati ya SARS-CoV-2 na CoV mbili zinazofanana na SARS za popo, bado hatuwezi kukata kauli kwamba SARS-COV-2 inatoka kwa popo.

English: COPD is not curable but symptoms can improve if one avoids smoking and exposure to air pollution and gets vaccines to prevent infections.
Ekegusii: COPD haiwezi kutibiwa lakini dalili zinaweza kuboresha ikiwa mtu ataepuka kuvuta sigara na kuathirika na uchafuzi wa hewa na kupata chanjo za kuzuia maambukizi.

English: After filling up, clean your hands with hand sanitizer.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kujaza, safisha mikono yako kwa kutumia kisafisha mkono.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboremi bwechinsemo chiokoruta chinguru chiogokonya amaoko ao.

English: By the time of this report, the disease has already spread throughout China and near 50 other countries all over the world (Fig. ​(Fig.2).2).
Kiswahili: Kufikia wakati wa kuchapishwa kwa ripoti hii, ugonjwa huu tayari umeenea kote nchini China na karibu nchi nyingine 50 kote ulimwenguni (Picha. (Picha.2). 2).
Ekegusii: Goikerania omoroberio oo, oborwaria obo bwabwenerete korwa ase chinese chiria chionsi na gosegeta eserikari 50 ase ensemo yobochenu (Ekiambokero 2.2).2).

English: Teachers attend CBC training next week.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahudhuria mazoezi ya CBC kuanzia juma lijalo.
Ekegusii: Abarimu baranyare amasomo ya CBC omotienyi omotambe.

English: With the construction overseen by BGI-founder Wang Jian and taking 5-days, modelling has show cases in Hubei would have been 47% higher and the corresponding cost of the tackling the quarantine would have doubled if this testing capacity hadn't come on line.
Kiswahili: Na ujenzi ukisimamiwa na mwanzilishi wa BGI Wang Jian na kukamilika katika siku 5, makadirio yameonyesha visa Hubei zingekuwa 47% zaidi na gharama inayoambatana ya kukabili karantini ingeongezeka maradufu ikiwa kiwango hiki cha kupima haingeanzishwa.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa na omochaki wa BGI, Wang Jian na gose ebiro bitano, omoroberio bweserikari buna oboremi bwa Hubei bwabeire 47% goikerania na gosegeta oborendi bwogotumia eserikari goikera ebirengererio biobochori.

English: Foreign countries visited in the last 28 days
Kiswahili: Nchi za kigeni ulizotembelea katika siku 28 zilizopita

English: The CDC has said that "the use, dosing, or duration of hydroxychloroquine for prophylaxis or treatment of SARS-CoV-2 infection" are not yet established.
Kiswahili: CDC imesema kuwa "matumizi, kipimo cha dawa, na muda wa hydrichloroquine kwa prophylaxis au matibabu ya maambukizo ya SARS-CoV-2" bado haijaanzishwa.

English: The World Health Organization and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention of the United States advises pregnant women to do the same things as the general public to avoid infection, such as covering cough, avoid interacting with sick people, cleaning hands with soap and water or sanitizer.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani na Vituo vya Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Ugonjwa huko Marekani hushauri wanawake wajawazito kufanya mambo sawa kama umma kwa ujumla ili kuzuia maambukizo, kama vile kujifuka ukikohoa, kuepuka kutangamana na watu wagonjwa, kusafisha mikono kwa kutumia sabuni na maji au kisafisha mikono chenye kileo cha kuua viini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (World Health Organization) na ekeombe getenenerete na gotanga oborwari (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention) kia America nkiaboririe abakungu baria bakorire ebinto ebio ase abanto bonsi gotanga ebinto biria bigotwara obokoreri, buna okorenta oboroso, gotanga abanto barwarete, gosaba amaoko ase esapuni na amache.

English: However, a lack of reliable water supply, soap or hand washing facilities in people's homes, at schools and at the workplace make it a challenge to achieve universal hand washing behaviors.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ukosefu wa maji yanayotegemeka, vifaa vya kuosha mikono au sabuni katika nyumba za watu, shuleni na maeneo ya kazi ni changamoto katika kutimiza tabia ya ulimwengu ya kuosha mikono.
Ekegusii: Ase oboikeranu, obotobu bw'amache, obosapuni gose ebinto biria bigosemia eboko ase ensemo y'abanto, ase chisukuru na ase obokoreri nigo bikorenta oboremi bwogosemia ebiboko ase abanto bonsi.

Kiswahili: kwa sababu ana kikohozi
Ekegusii: kwa sababu wana kikohozi

English: Finally, for some underlying health conditions and risk factors, including neurologic disorders, chronic liver disease, being a current smoker, and pregnancy, few severe outcomes were reported; therefore, conclusions cannot be drawn about the risk for severe COVID-19 among persons in these groups.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, kwa baadhi ya hali sugu za afya na vigezo vya hatari, ikiwa ni pamoja na matatizo ya kinyurolojia, ugonjwa sugu wa ini, matumizi ya sigara kwa sasa na ujauzito, matokeo machache ya hali mbaya yaliripotiwa; kwa hivyo, mahitimisho hayawezi kuafikiwa kuhusu hatari ya magonjwa haya kwa COVID-19 miongoni mwa watu walio katika vikundi hivi.
Ekegusii: Na mwisho, kwa baadhi ya hali mbaya za afya na vigezo vya hatari, ikiwa ni pamoja na matatizo ya kisaikolojia, ugonjwa sugu wa ini, kuvuta sigara kwa sasa, na ujauzito, matokeo machache mabaya yaliripotiwa; kwa hivyo, hitimisho haziwezi kuchukuliwa kuhusu hatari ya COVID-19 kali miongoni mwa watu katika vikundi hivi.

English: The aim of this study is to identify whether there is undetected community transmission of COVID-19, estimate population susceptibility, and monitor the temporal and geographical distribution of COVID-19 infection in the community.
Kiswahili: Lengo la utafiti huu ni kutambua iwapo kuna maambukizi ya jumuiya ambayo hayajagunduliwa ya COVID-19, makadirio ya watu kuwepo hatarini na kufuatilia kusambaa kwa COVID-19 kiwakati na kieneo katika jamii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ekerengo ekiagendererete korwa okobwaterana kwa COVID-19 ase abanto batari goikeranwa, gokinia buna abanto bagokonya korwa COVID-19, na gosegeta oboronge bwogokonya kwa Covid-19 ase ebinyoro.

English: Hand washing (or handwashing), also known as hand hygiene, is the act of cleaning one's hands for the purpose of removing soil, grease, microorganisms, or other unwanted substances.
Kiswahili: Kuosha mikono (au kunawa mikono), ambako pia kunajulikana kama usafi wa mikono, ni kitendo cha kusafisha mikono kwa madhumuni ya kuondoa mchanga, uchafu, viini au vitu vingine visivyotakana.
Ekegusii: Kogeza mikono (au kuosha mikono), pia hujulikana kama usafi wa mikono, ni kitendo cha kusafisha mikono ya mtu kwa madhumuni ya kuondoa udongo, mafuta, viini, au vitu vingine visivyohitajika.

English: Later in the 1890s, human coronavirus OC43 diverged from bovine coronavirus after another cross-species spillover event.
Kiswahili: Baadaye katika miaka ya 1980, virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu OC43 vilitoka kwa virusi vya korona vya ng'ombe baada ya tukio lingine ya kuruka kwenda kwenye spishi nyingine.
Ekegusii: Baadaye miaka ya 1890, virusi vya korona vya binadamu OC43 vilitofautiana na virusi vya corona vya ng'ombe baada ya tukio lingine la kuenea kati ya aina.

English: School closures were shown to reduce morbidity from the Asian flu by 90% during the 1957–58 outbreak, and up to 50% in controlling influenza in the US, 2004–2008.Multiple countries successfully slowed the spread of infection through school closures during the 2009 H1N1 Flu pandemic.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule zilionyeshwa kupunguza kuwepo kwa ugonjwa kutoka homa ya mafua ya Asia kwa 90% katika mkurupuko wa 1957-58, na hadi 50% katika udhibiti wa homa ya mafua Marekani, 2004-2008. Nchi nyingi zimefanikiwa kupunguza kuenea kwa maambukizi kupitia shule kufungwa katika janga la Homa ya mafua ya H1N1 ya 2009.
Ekegusii: Kufungwa kwa shule kulionyeshwa kupunguza maambukizi kutokana na homa ya mafua ya Asia kwa 90% wakati wa mkurupuko wa 1957-58, na hadi 50% katika kudhibiti mafua nchini Marekani, 2004-2008. Nchi nyingi zilifanikiwa kupunguza kuenea kwa maambukizo kupitia kufungwa kwa shule wakati wa janga la homa ya homa ya H1N1 ya 2009.

English: World Health Assembly resolution WHA63.12 urges Member States to establish, implement and support nationally coordinated, efficiently managed and sustainable blood and plasma programmes, according to the availability of resources, with the aim of achieving self-sufficiency.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (WHA63.12) nkiaboririe emeremo yechinsemo chiria chieserikari korosia, koenekia na gokonya emeroberio yoboremi bwesonde na oboremi bwao, erio korwa ebinto biria biranyareirwe ase enchera yobochenu.

English: Parents are encouraged to discuss national values such as honesty, respect, and responsibility with their children at home.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kujadiliana na watoto wao nyumbani kuhusu maadili ya kitaifa kama uaminifu, heshima na uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Abaibori bakoremerwa gosegeta ebinto biria bigosegeta chinse buna obokoreri, oborendo, na obotenereri ase abana babo ase endagera.

English: After washing your hands and before sitting down, use disinfectant wipes to wipe down the area around your seat.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kunawa mikono yako na kabla ya kuketi chini, tumia vipangusaji vya kuua viini kupangusa eneo karibu na kiti chako.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bwogokonya ebinto biogosaria ebinto biria bigokonya obokebago bwokoruta ebinto ebio.

English: Thus, if needed, steroids should be used at low dosage and for a short time in COVID-19 patients.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, ikihitajika, steroids zinapaswa kutumika kwa dozi ya chini na kwa muda mfupi kwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Kwa hivyo, ikihitajika, steroids zinapaswa kutumika kwa kipimo cha chini na kwa muda mfupi kwa wagonjwa wa COVID-19.

Kiswahili: Maambukizi kupitia njia ya kinyesi na mdomo yanaweza pia kufanyika.

Kiswahili: Dalili zingine zinaweza kujumuisha uchovu, maumivu ya misuli, kuhara, vidonda vya koo, kupoteza hisia ya kuhisi harufu, na maumivu ya tumbo.

English: Join us in advancing locally led solutions, driving innovation, and delivering impact where it matters most.
Ekegusii: Bwaterana nabo ase okogendereria emeroberio yobochori bwetugo, gosegeta obotuki, na gosaria obokoreri bwogokonya ebinto biria bigokonya.

English: Similar findings were reported in two recent studies of a family cluster and a cluster caused by transmission from an asymptomatic individual.
Kiswahili: Matokeo sawa na hayo yaliripotiwa katika tafiti mbili za hivi majuzi za sampuli ya familia na sampuli iliyosababisha na mtu ambaye hakuonyesha dalili za ugonjwa.
Ekegusii: Ebionchorerio bionsi buna ebionchoreri ebio biranyorigwe ase ebirengererio ebio bieserikari ase enamba yobochori na enamba eyemo ekoretwe ase omonyene otari na emeroberio.

English: Alcohol-based hand sanitizers are almost entirely ineffective against norovirus (or Norwalk) type viruses, the most common cause of contagious gastroenteritis.Enough hand antiseptic or alcohol rub must be used to thoroughly wet or cover both hands.
Kiswahili: Vieuzi vya mikono vilivyo na alkoholi karibu havifai kabisa dhidi ya virusi aina ya norovirus (au Norwalk), ambavyo ni visababishi vya kawaida zaidi vya ugonjwa wa kuambukizana wa gastroenteritisi.Dawa ya kutosha au kieuzi chenye alkoholi lazima kitumike ipasavyo ili kutia mikono majimaji au kufunika mikono yote.

Kiswahili: Majina rasmi COVID-19 na SARS-CoV-12 yalitolewa tarehe 11, Februari 2020.
