Ekegusii: Ase okobwaterana na ekeombe ekenene na ekerengo 201 kia ekeombe keria ekenene, omominisita omonene, ase omosikari omonene bweserikari, obokoreri bwoborendi na oboremi, ogosemia abanto bonsi baria bakwegendereria, abakori emeremo na baria bagendererete goikerania ebirengererio biabo ase ogotumia ebikoreri ebi.

English: Some commentators believe that this move was intended to protect Chinese Communist Party general secretary Xi Jinping from the public's anger over the coronavirus outbreak.
Kiswahili: Watangazaji wengine wanaamini kuwa msimamo huu ilikuwa ya kulinda katibu mkuu wa Chama cha Kikomunisti ya Uchina Xi Jinping kutoka hasira ya umma juu ya mkurupuko wa virusi vya korona.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi babwenerete gokinia ng'a enchera eyio yabekirwe gokonya omosikari omonene bweserikari ya chinese chinese, Xi Jinping korwa obokebago bwabanto igoro yoboremi bwa korona.

English: However, COVID-19 has lower severity and mortality than SARS but is much more transmissive and affects more elderly individuals than youth and more men than women.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, COVID-19 ina hali ya chini ya ukali na viwango vya vifo kuliko SARS lakini uwezo mkubwa wa kupitishwa na kuambukiza watu wazee kuliko vijana na wanaume zaidi ya wanawake.
Ekegusii: Hata hivyo, COVID-19 ina kiwango cha chini cha ukali na vifo kuliko SARS lakini inaambukiza zaidi na huathiri watu wazee zaidi kuliko vijana na wanaume zaidi kuliko wanawake.

English: Make video the default, with tools like Google Docs and Zoom to facilitate live collaboration and connection.
Kiswahili: Fanya video iwe chaguo-msingi, na zana kama vile Google Docs na Zoom ili kuwezesha ushirikiano na muunganisho wa moja kwa moja.
Ekegusii: Renda enchera eyemo yobochori, ase ebinto buna Google Docs na Zoom erio erengete obokoreri bwao na obokong'u.

English: For those who are asymptomatic, the WHO does not recommend masks, though some national governments do.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale ambao wana dalili, WHO haipendekezi barakoa, ijapokuwa baadhi ya serikali za kitaifa zinapendekeza.
Ekegusii: Kwa wale wasiokuwa na dalili, WHO haipendekezi barakoa, ijapokuwa baadhi ya serikali za kitaifa zinafanya hivyo.

English: Other solutions, such as benzalkonium chloride and chlorhexidine gluconate (a surgical disinfectant), are less effective.In a Hong Kong study, saliva samples were taken a median of two days after the start of hospitalization.
Kiswahili: Uoevu mwingine, kama vile benzalkonium chloride na chlorhexidine gluconate (kemikali ya upasuaji), hazifanyi kazi vizuri. Katika utafiti huko Hong Kong study, sampuli za mate zilichukuliwa kwa wastani wa siku mbili baada ya kuanza kulazwa hospitalini.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebio, buna benzalkonium chloride na chlorhexidine gluconate (chinsemo chiria chiogotumia korwa oboremi bwogokorerwa emeremo), n'ebirengererio bionsi biria bigotumika.Obwango bwa Hong Kong, chinsemo chiogokorwa chiria chire ase ebiro ebio nyuma y'omoroberio bwokoremerwa.

English: nucleic acid (DNA and RNA) (Phase I developer and vaccine candidate: Moderna, mRNA-1273)
Kiswahili: asidi za kiini cha chembe (DNA na RNA) (Mkuzaji wa awamu ya I na chanjo kilichoteuliwa: Moderna, mRNA-1273)
Ekegusii: nucleic acid (DNA na RNA) (Mpanua wa Awamu ya I na chanjo inayoteuliwa: Moderna, mRNA-1273)

English: Finger tips must be washed well too, rubbing them in both palms.The US Center for Disease Control and Prevention recommends hand washing over hand sanitizer rubs, particularly when hands are visibly dirty.
Kiswahili: Ncha za vidole lazima zioshwe vizuri pia, kwa kuzisugua kwenye viganja vyote.Kituo cha Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Magonjwa cha Marekani hupendekeza kuosha mikono kuliko kutumia vieuzi, hususan wakati ni wazi kuwa mikono ni chafu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gokonya ebinto biria bigokonya okwerwa ase ebinto ebionsi.Ekeombe ekenene giokorwania na gotanga oborwaria kia America (US Center for Disease Control and Prevention) kiabwenerete gokeania ebinto biobochenu ase ekero ebinto bikonyora ebinto binde biria bikonyara oboremi bw'amaboko.

English: In many countries, there is a low rate of hand washing with soap.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi nyingi, kuna kiwango cha chini cha kuosha mikono kwa sabuni.
Ekegusii: Katika nchi nyingi, kuna kiwango cha chini cha kuosha mikono kwa sabuni.

English: As of December 2019, 2,468 cases of MERS-CoV infection had been confirmed by laboratory tests, 851 of which were fatal, a mortality rate of approximately 34.5%.
Kiswahili: Hadi Desemba 2019, visa 2,468 vya maambukizo ya MERS-CoV vilithibitishwa na vipimo vya maabara, 851 kati yao walikuwa mamekufa, kiwango cha vifo cha takriban asilimia 34.5.
Ekegusii: Goikera omotienyi 12 omwaka 2019, ebinyoro 2,468 bia MERS-CoV nabinyorekire ase obotambe bweserikari, 851 gochia ebinyorokereria, oboremi bwechindagera 34.5%.

English: Other research directions include the development of a COVID-19 vaccine and convalescent plasma transfusion.SARS-CoV-2 has about 66 druggable proteins, each of which has multiple ligand binding sites.
Kiswahili: Miongozo mingine ya utafiti inajumuisha ukuzaji wa chanjo ya COVID-19 na kuchukua kinga mwili za mtu aliyepona na kuzipeleka kwa mtu mgonjwa kupitia damu. SARS-CoV-2 ina protini za dawa karibu 66, ambazo kila moja ina maeneo mengi yenye molekuli.
Ekegusii: Maelekezo mengine ya utafiti yanajumuisha ukuzaji wa chanjo ya COVID-19 na upasuaji wa plasma wa watu wanaopona.SARS-CoV-2 ina protini 66 zinazoweza kutumika kwa dawa, na kila moja ina maeneo mengi ya kuunganisha ligand.

English: MERS-CoV and its closest relative bat CoV-HKU25 share only 87% nucleotide sequence homology.
Kiswahili: MERS-CoV na jamii yake ya karibu zaidi ya virusi vya CoV-HKU25 vya popo vina mfanano wa 87% tu wa msururu wa nukleotidi.
Ekegusii: MERS-CoV na jamaa wake wa karibu wa popo CoV-HKU25 wanashiriki homolojia ya mfuatano wa nucleotide ya asilimia 87 pekee.

English: The citizens of Poland, China, and India deplaned in Poland, where the Brazilian plane made a stopover before following its route to Brazil.
Kiswahili: Raia wa Polandi, Uchina, na Uhindi walishuka Polandi, ambapo ndege ya Brazil ilisimama kabla ya kufuata
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba'Poland, China, na India bakorire omoroberio omonene ase oboremi bwa'Poland, ekeombe kia'Brazil kiabwaterete nyuma yobochori bwao goetera Brazil.

English: Stigma and shame often prevent people from seeking help.
Ekegusii: Oboremaru na obokoreri nigo bigosegeta abanto korwa ogosaba obokonyi.

English: This could be increased if PHE modelers require more samples.
Kiswahili: Hii inaweza kuongezwa ikiwa waundaji wa PHE watahitaji sampuli zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekero abanto bakoreta oboremi bwa PHE bakogosaba ebirengererio biengencho.

English: Hot water treatment of own seed to prevent seed.
Ekegusii: Ogosegeta amache amache ase enchera eyemo erio gotanga amache.

English: The new status as a pandemic follows the WHO's decision in January to declare the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.
Kiswahili: Hali mpya kama janga kubwa inafuatia uamuzi wa Shirika la Afya Duniani katika Januari kutangaza kuzuka kwa ugonjwa huu kuwa hali ya dharura wa afya ya umma ya hangaiko la kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Obomanyi obuya buna omoroberio bwokoruta chingongo (pandemic) bwaikire ekero ekeombe keria ekenene kia amagenderero (WHO) kiabwatete omotienyi omotano omonene omotani omonene korwa oborwaria bwobobwenia bwoborwaria (public health emergency) buna oboremi bweserikari.

English: Between them there is an alpaca alpha-CoV.
Kiswahili: Kati ya virusi hivyo kuna virusi vya alpha-CoV vinavyopatikana kwa alpaca ambaye ni aina ya mnyama.
Ekegusii: Kati yao kuna alpaca alpha-CoV.

English: On 19 March 2020, the FDA issued emergency use authorization (EUA) to Abbott Laboratories for a test on Abbott's m2000 system; the FDA had previously issued similar authorization to Hologic, LabCorp, and Thermo Fisher Scientific.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 19 Machi 2020, FDA ilitoa uidhinishaji wa matumizi wa dharura (EUA) kwa Abbott Laboratories kwa kipimo cha mfumo wa Abbott wa m2000; the FDA awali ilikuwa imetoa idhini sawa na hiyo kwa Hologic, LabCorp na Thermo Fisher Scientific.
Ekegusii: Tarehe 19 Machi 2020, FDA ilitoa idhini ya matumizi ya dharura (EUA) kwa Abbott Laboratories kwa ajili ya upimaji wa mfumo wa Abbott m2000; FDA hapo awali ilikuwa imetoa idhini sawa na hiyo kwa Hologic, LabCorp, na Thermo Fisher Scientific.

English: Symptoms in other species vary: in chickens, they cause an upper respiratory tract disease, while in cows and pigs they cause diarrhea.
Kiswahili: Dalili hutofautiana katika spishi zingine: kwa kuku, husababisha ugonjwa katika mfumo wa juu wa kupumua, ambapo kwa ng'ombe na nguruwe husababisha kuhara.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio ase ebinyoro ebio biranyorekanete: ase ebiombe, biranyare oborwaria bw'omogondo omonene bw'okoremereria, na ase enyamwa na chinguru bikorenta oboremi.

English: A CNN report indicated that the combination of Italy's large elderly population and inability to test all who have the virus to date may be contributing to the high fatality rate.
Kiswahili: Ripoti moja ya CNN ilionyesha kuwa mchanganyiko wa idadi ya watu wengi walio wazee na kutoweza kupima wote walio na virusi hadi sasa huenda inachangia idadi kubwa ya vifo.
Ekegusii: Eripoti ya CNN yarureirie ng'a omoroberio bw'abanto baria bakwegete na abatamanyete gochia abanto bonsi baria bare na enchera eyemo ya obomanyi bw'ebinyinyi (CNN) nigo egokonya korwa oboremi bwebinyinyi.

English: The city of Wuhan is on every list and the rest of mainland China is on most.
Kiswahili: Jiji la Wuhan liko kwenye kila orodha na China Kuu iko poa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete omoroberio bweserikari ya Wuhan nkiabeire ase ensemo yonsi, na ensemo eyemo yobochori bwa China.

English: In late March, the Canadian government announced C$275 million in funding for 96 research projects on medical countermeasures against COVID-19, including numerous vaccine candidates at Canadian companies and universities, such as the Medicago and University of Saskatchewan initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa mwezi wa Machi, serikali ya Kanada ilitangaza dola milioni 275 ya kufadhili miradi 96 ya utafiti wa upimaji wa matibabu dhidi ya COVID-19, ikiwemo chanjo kadhaa zilizoteuliwa katika kampuni na vyuo vikuu vya Kanada, kama vile mipango ya Medicago na Chuo Kikuu cha Saskatchewan.
Ekegusii: Chitariki chiomotienyi 3 omotienyi 3, eserikari ya Canada yaamanyirie chibesa chiemirioni 275 ase obokonyi ase chinkwana 96 chioboroso igoro yoborwaria igoro yokorwania COVID-19, gose chingaki chionsi chiria chire ase chindagera chia Canada na chinyomba chieserikari chia Canada, buna oboremi bwa Medicago na University of Saskatchewan.

English: We are also working to maintain regular communications with staff who reside in countries that are currently significantly affected.
Kiswahili: Tunashughulika pia kudumisha mawasiliano ya mara kwa mara na wafanyakazi wanaoishi nchi ambazo zimeathiriwa pakubwa kwa sasa.
Ekegusii: Nigo togokora goikerania obokoreri bwebinyoro ase abakori emeremo baria bakorire ase ebinyoro ebirengererio.

English: US authorities have also been accused of diverting aid meant for other nations to their own country.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka za Marekani pia zimelaumiwa kwa kuchukuwa msaada iliyotolewa kwa nchi zingine kuelekea nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Abarendi ba America nabo bagosigwe igoro yokorenda obokonyi bwogokonya ebinyoro biabo.

English: If it's impossible to avoid contact, then wash your hands both before and after.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ni vigumu kuepuka kugusana, basi nawa mikono yako kabla na baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania korwa okobwaterana nabwo, gosia amaoko ao nyuma na nyuma.

English: Cases among persons repatriated to the United States from Wuhan, China, and the Diamond Princess cruise ship were excluded.
Kiswahili: Visa miongoni mwa watu waliorejeshwa nyumbani nchini Marekani kutoka Wuhan, China na meli ya Diamond Princess havikujumuishwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete ase abanto baria batamire ase America goikera Wuhan, China, na ekeombe giokoruta omochando omonene Diamond Princess chiria chiria chitamire.

English: Stakeholders are urged to visit acd.kra.go.ke for full guidance on the ACD process.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi babwenerete baborigwe korwa acd.kra.go.ke korwa oboteneneri obuya igoro yobochenu bwa ACD.

English: During the first year bananas should be intercropped with shallow rooted crops for ease of weeding.
Ekegusii: Omwaka omoroberio bw'omwaka omotang'u, ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto bikoremerwa na ebinto biogosegeta ekero bigotemwa.

English: Use of steroids: As described above, steroids are immunosuppressant commonly used as an adjunctive therapy for infectious diseases to reduce the severity of inflammatory damage.
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya steroids: Ilivyofafanuliwa hapa juu, steroids ni vikandamizi vya kinga ambavyo hutumika sana kama tiba ya ziada kwa magonjwa ya kuambukizana ili kupunguza kiwango cha uharibifu wa kuchomeka.
Ekegusii: Ogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia endagera: Bwendagera buna ebinto biogotumia omoroberio bw'obotuki bwetugo ase oborwaria bwogokonya obokong'u bw'ebinto biogosaria obotoki bw'etugo erio korenta oboremi bw'emebasekano.

English: Wash your hands before putting on the mask and avoid touching the mask while wearing it.
Kiswahili: Nawa mikono yako kabla ya kuweka barakoa na epuka kugusa barakoa unapokuwa ukiiva.
Ekegusii: Sacha mikono yako kabla ya kuvaa barakoa na epuka kugusa barakoa unapoivaa.

English: The human coronavirus discovered in 2003, SARS-CoV, which causes severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), has a unique pathogenesis because it causes both upper and lower respiratory tract infections.Six species of human coronaviruses are known, with one species subdivided into two different strains, making seven strains of human coronaviruses altogether.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vya binadamu vilivyogunduliwa mwaka wa 2003, ambavyo husababisha ugonjwa kali wa matatizo ya kupumua (SARS), vina pathogenisis ya kipekee kwa sababu huambukiza sehemu ya juu na chini ya kupumua. Aina sita za virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu vinajulikana, na aina moja imegawanywa katika aina mbili tofauti, na kutengeneza aina sita za virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu kwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya korona vya binadamu vilivyogunduliwa mwaka wa 2003, SARS-CoV, vinavyosababisha ugonjwa mbaya wa kupumua (SARS), vina kizazi cha kipekee kwa sababu husababisha maambukizi ya njia ya juu na ya chini ya pumu. Aina sita za virusi vya corona vya binadamu vinajulikana, na aina moja imegawanywa katika aina mbili tofauti, na kufanya aina saba ya virusi vya korona za binadamu kwa jumla.

English: They also suggest that people with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 should have continuous electronic fetal monitoring.
Kiswahili: Pia wanapendekeza kwamba watu wanaoshukiwa au wamedhibitishwa kuwa na ugonjwa wa COVID-19 wanapaswa kuendelea na uchunguzi wa kijusi kielekroniki.
Ekegusii: Nao wanashauri kwamba watu wanaoshukiwa au waliothibitishwa kuwa na COVID-19 wanapaswa kuwa na ufuatiliaji endelevu wa kijusi kupitia njia za kielektroniki.

English: A spokeswoman for the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) acknowledged "We know that [the stated death toll] is an underestimation", a statement corroborated by anecdotal reports of undercounting in the U.S. Such underestimation often occurs in pandemics, such as the 2009 H1N1 swine flu epidemic.The first confirmed death was in Wuhan on 9 January 2020.
Kiswahili: Msemaji wa Kituo cha Udhibiti na Uzuiaji wa Magonjwa Marekani alikiri "Tunafahamu kuwa [takwimu iliyotajwa ya vifo] ni kadirio la chini", kauli inayothibitishwa na ripoti zilizothibitishwa ya kuhesabu duni katika Marekani. Kadirio la chini mara nyingi hutokea katika janga kubwa, kama ugonjwa wa mlipuko wa homa ya mafua ya nguruwe ya 2009 H1N1.Kifo cha kwanza iliyothibitishwa ilikuwa Wuhan tarehe 9 Januari 2020.
Ekegusii: Omomanyi omonene bweserikari yogotumia oborwaria (CDC) oranyare ng'a, "Tumanyete nga [enamba ya abanto baria baranyare okwegendereria kwa baria bakwegendererete korwa ebirengererio biobochenu] nigo goikerania ase obokoreri bwebinyoro", enchera eyemo egokwanerana na amang'ana ao igoro yobokoreri bwogokwerengereria ase America.Oborwaria obochenu bwetugo buna obogokwanerete

English: People living in or visiting areas with CHIKV transmission are advised to wear clothing that minimizes skin exposure to the day-biting mosquitoes.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bakorire gose baranyare ebinyoro bia CHIKV baranyorigwe gotwara ebinto biria bigosegeta obotambe bwetugo goetera ebinto ebio.

English: Contact your local health guidelines and follow their guidance.
Ekegusii: Manyia emeroberio yebirengererio biao bia oborwaria na gwatia oboteneneri bwabo.

English: The virus was officially named the SARS coronavirus (SARS-CoV).
Kiswahili: Virusi hivyo vilipewa jina rasmi la (SARS-CoV).
Ekegusii: Virusi hivi viliitwa rasmi virusi vya korona vya SARS (SARS-CoV).

English: It’s Better to File Your Annual Tax Returns Now
Ekegusii: Ni bora kupeleka marejesho yako ya kodi ya kila mwaka sasa

English: By yesterday, the World Health Organization reported 1,051,635 confirmed cases, including 79,332 cases in the twenty four hours preceding 10 a.m. Central European Time (0800 UTC) on April 4.
Kiswahili: Kufikia jana, Shirika la Afya Duniani liliripoti visa 1,051,635 vilivyothibitishwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na visa 79,332 katika saa ishirini na nne kabla ya 10 asubuhi, Saa za Ulaya ya Kati (0800 UTC) mnamo tarehe 4 Aprili.
Ekegusii: Goikera, ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (World Health Organization) kiaanenerete ng'a abanto 1,051,635 babwenerete korwa ebirengererio, amo na abanto 79,332 ase emeremo yechingaki chiria chiria chiabeire chitariki 10 chiomotienyi 0800 UTC (Central European Time) omotienyi 4.

English: The majority of colds are caused by rhinoviruses.
Kiswahili: Aina nyingi ya mafua husababishwa na rhinoviruses.
Ekegusii: Oboremaru ase oborwaria bwogokonywa na rhinoviruses.

English: Undergraduate education is education conducted after secondary education and prior to post-graduate education, for which the learner is typically awarded a bachelor's degree.
Kiswahili: Elimu ya shahada ni elimu inayoendeshwa baada ya elimu ya shule ya upili na kabla ya elimu za uzamifu, ambapo wanafunzi wanafuzu kwa shahada ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Chisemi chia bachelor nigo chisemi chiokorwa nyuma yechisemi chia secondary na nyuma ya chisemi chia postgraduate, buna omonyia nigo agokorerwa chisukuru chiogotanga chisukuru.

English: SARS-CoV-2 is apparently less pathogenic but more transmissible compared to SARS-CoV and MERS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Ni wazi kwamba SARS-CoV-2 haina uwezo mkubwa wa kusababisha ugonjwa lakini usambazaji wake ni wa juu ikilinganishwa na SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV.
Ekegusii: SARS-CoV-2 inaonekana kuwa haiwezi kusababisha magonjwa lakini inaweza kuambukizwa zaidi ikilinganishwa na SARS-COV na MERS-CoV.

English: Coles and Woolworths have a view [that] if there was plenty of stuff on the shelf, if product like toilet rolls and sanitiser could be [bought] and are there in quantities, you would probably minimise the panic said Russell Zimmerman per ABC News.
Kiswahili: Coles na Woolworths zina mtazamo kwamba ikiwa kulikuwa na bidhaa za kutosha kwenye rafu, ikiwa bidhaa kama vile karatasi shashi na kieuzi zingeweza kununuliwa na zipatikane kwa wingi, kuna uwezekano wa kupunguza wasiwasi, alisema Russell Zimmerman kwa mujibu wa ABC News.
Ekegusii: Coles na Woolworths buna oboremi bwao [ngo] ng'a ekero buna ebinto bionsi biria biria bigosegeta ebinto biria bikorwa ase eserifu, gose ekero ebinto ebio biria biogotumia eseribu gose ebinto bikoremereria emeremo yoboremi bwendagera ebinto bigotumia ebinto binde biria binde bikoremwa ase ebinto biabo, oboikeranu buna Russell Zimmerman ase ekeombe keria ekenene kia ABC News.

English: CoVs are non-pathogenic or cause mild symptoms in their reservoir hosts such as bats and camels.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya CoV havina uwezo wa kusababisha ugonjwa au husababisha dalili za kiasi kwa wabebaji wahifadhi wao kama vile popo na ngamia.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya CoV si vinavyosababisha magonjwa au husababisha dalili nyembamba katika mahabara yao kama vile popo na ngamia.

English: Use resistant varieties: Several lines of dry beans have been identified as having good levels of resistance to bean flies in East Africa.
Ekegusii: Tumia ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto biao: Ebinto binde biria biria bikorete ebinto biogosegeta ebio biranyorigwe buna bikoremereria ebinto ebio ase Afrika ya Botambe.

English: In Ithaca, New York, Cornell University students spent at least $4 million a week in Tompkins county.
Kiswahili: Huko Ithaca, New York, wanafunzi wa Chuo Kikuu cha Cornell walitumia angalau $4 milioni kwa wiki katika jimbo la Tompkins.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Ithaca, New York, abana ba University ya Cornell bakorire amariogo amamiliyoni 4 omotienyi ase ekaonti ya Tompkins.

English: In January and February 2020, during the height of the epidemic in Wuhan, about 5 million people in China lost their jobs.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Januari na Februari 2020, wakati janga lilikithiri zaidi Wuhan, takriban watu milioni 5 walipoteza kazi zao.
Ekegusii: Mnamo Januari na Februari 2020, wakati wa upeo wa janga hilo huko Wuhan, takriban watu milioni 5 nchini China walipoteza kazi zao.

English: This is called the incubation period.
Kiswahili: Hii inajulikana kama kipindi cha kupevuka.
Ekegusii: Ogoigo nigo ogotumeka buna omoroberio bwokoruta chinguru.

English: They also cause a range of diseases in farm animals and domesticated pets, some of which can be serious and are a threat to the farming industry.
Kiswahili: Pia husababisha maradhi anuwai katika mifugo na wanyama kipenzi, ambao baadhi yao wanaweza kuwa na hatari kubwa kwa tasnia ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Bigo nigo bikorenta oborwaria obuya ase ebiombe bioboremi na ebiombe biria bikoremerwa, buna ebio biranyare korwa ebirengererio biobochenu na gosegeta oboremi bwoboremi.

English: In Japan, the hashtag #ChineseDontComeToJapan trended on Twitter.
Kiswahili: Nchini Japani, alama ya reli #ChineseDontComeToJapan ilivuma katika mtandao wa Twitter.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya #ChineseDontComeToJapan yarure ase omoroberio bweserikari goetera Twitter.

English: Use overhead irrigation or wash plants with a strong jet of water to knock off mites and to destroy their webs.
Ekegusii: Tumia omoroberio bwogotumia amache gose gosaba ebimera ase amache agotumia omobere omonene bwamache erio gotanga ebimeri na gosegeta ebirengo biao.

English: People can use PrEP or PEP when the risk of contracting HIV is high; people should seek advice from a clinician when thinking about using PrEP or PEP.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baranyare korwa PrEP gose PEP ekero obochenu bwogotwara omoroberio bw'obobwenia bw'ebinto biria bigotwara oborwaire bw'esindani (HIV); abamenyi goika barure ogokurerwa na omoganga bw'oborwaria ekero bakoririe komanyia oborwaria bwa PrEP Gose Oborwaria Bwo'Omonya (PEP).

English: Complete removal of the lymph node bed under the arm (complete axillary dissection) was thought to be necessary in the past to prevent the spread of cancer.
Ekegusii: Goikerania oboremi bwa amariogo ao ao ase omochando (goikeranigwa kwa amariogongo ao ao ao) goikeranwa buna goika kera ase okorenda okobwaterania kwa kansa.

English: This is a moment in which not only what we do, but how we do it, will make a meaningful impact on the world.
Kiswahili: Huu ni wakati ambao si tu tunachokifanya, bali jinsi tunavyokifanya, italeta matokeo ya maana ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Hii ni wakati ambapo sio tu kile tunachofanya, bali jinsi tunavyofanya, vitakuwa na athari muhimu kwa ulimwengu.

English: None of the newborns were infected with SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Hakuna watoto wachanga waliozaliwa waliambukizwa na SARS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Hakuna mtoto mchanga aliyeambukizwa SARS-CoV.

English: Another independent study described the isolation of the same virus from a nasal specimen from an 8-month-old boy suffering from pneumonia in the Netherlands.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mwingine huru ulifafanua kutolewa kwa virusi sawa kutoka kwa sampuli za puani kutoka kwa mvulana wa umri wa miezi -8 aliyekuwa akiugua ugonjwa wa nimonia nchini Uholanzi.
Ekegusii: Utafiti mwingine huru ulifafanua kutengwa kwa virusi sawa kutoka kwa sampuli ya pua kutoka kwa mvulana mwenye umri wa miezi 8 mwenye ugonjwa wa nimonia nchini Uholanzi.

English: The main medical purpose of washing hands is to cleanse the hands of pathogens (bacteria, viruses, or other microorganisms that can cause disease) and chemicals which can cause harm or diseases.
Kiswahili: lengo kuu la kimatibabu la kuosha mikono ni kusafisha mikono kutokana na virusi (bakteria, virusi, au viini vingine vianavyoweza kusababisha magonjwa) na kemikali zinazoweza kusababisha madhara au magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Kusudi kuu la kimatibabu la kuosha mikono ni kusafisha mikono kutokana na viini vya magonjwa (bakteria, virusi, au viini vingine ambavyo vinaweza kusababisha magonjwa) na kemikali ambazo zinaweza kusababisha madhara au magonjwa.

English: Finally, alpaca alpha-CoV has not been found in feral animals.
Kiswahili: Mwisho, virusi vya alpha-CoV vilivyopatikana kwa alpaca havijapatikana ndani ya wanyama wa mwituni.
Ekegusii: Na hatimaye, alpaca alpha-CoV haijapatikana katika wanyama wa porini.

English: No medications or vaccine is approved to treat the disease.
Kiswahili: Hakuna dawa au chanjo iliyothibitishwa kutibu ugonjwa huo.
Ekegusii: Hakuna dawa au chanjo iliyoidhinishwa kutibu ugonjwa huu.

English: On 4 March, the Italian government ordered the full closure of all schools and universities nationwide as Italy reached 100 deaths.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 4 Machi, serikali ya Italia iliagiza kufungwa kabisa kwa shule na vyuo vikuu vyote kote nchini wakati Italia ilirekodi vifo 100.
Ekegusii: Omotienyi 4 omotienyi omotano, eserikari ya Italia yarure ogochika kwa chisukuru chiria chionsi na chinyomba chieserikari chiria chiria chinene chiria chiserikari gotwara abanto 100.

English: Privacy campaigners voiced their concern regarding the implications of mass surveillance using coronavirus apps, in particular about whether surveillance infrastructure created to deal with the coronavirus pandemic will be dismantled once the threat has passed.
Kiswahili: Wafanya kampeni ya faragha walionyesha wasiwasi wa madhara ya uchunguzi wa idadi kubwa ya watu kwa kutumia progwamu ya virusi vya korona, haswa kuhusu ikiwa miundombinu ya uchunguzi iliyoundwa kushughulikia ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona itasambaratishwa baada ya ugonjwa kudhibitiwa.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi boborendi bwebinyoro baranyare oboremi bwabo igoro yoborendi bwogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia oborendi bwa korona, buna oboronge bwokorora ebinto bikoretwe ase okorwania oborwaire bwokorona, na korwa ng'a ebinto binde biria bikorwe goikerania obokoreri bwebinto biokorona biranyare.

English: Enough cases of unknown pneumonia had been reported to health authorities in Wuhan to trigger an investigation in early January.During the early stages of the outbreak, the number of cases doubled approximately every seven and a half days.
Kiswahili: Visa vya kutosha vya mchochota wa pafu visivyojulikana vilikuwa vimeripotiwa kwa mamlaka za afya Wuhan kusababisha uchunguzi mwanzo wa Januari.Katika hatua za mwanzo wa mlipuko, nambari za visa viliongezeka maradufu takriban kila siku saba na nusu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete igoro yoboremi bw'obokong'u (pneumonia) nigo kiabwatirwe ase abarai ba oborwaria ase omoroberio o'Wuhan erio gotanga obotuki gochia omotienyi omonene omotano omonene.Ekiambokero chiokwegendereria, enamba y'ebirengererio nigo yaborerete ase ebiro ebionsi biria biria bigotoma.

English: These factors, if estimated accurately, will give good predictions for the likely length of the pandemic, the final number of infected cases.
Kiswahili: Vigezo hivi, vikikadiriwa kwa usahihi, vitatoa utabiri sahihi wa muda unaowezekana wa janga hili kubwa, idadi ya mwisho ya visa vya maambukizi.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebi, buna bigosegetigwa buya, bikorenta ebirengererio biengencho igoro yoboremi bwokoruta chinguru, enamba ya nyuma ya abanto baria bakorete oborwaire.

English: In the 1790s, equine coronavirus diverged from the bovine coronavirus after a cross-species jump.
Kiswahili: Miaka ya 1790, virusi vya koroma vya farasi vilitoka kwa virusi vya korona vya ng'ombe baada ya kuruka kwenda kwa spishi nyingine.
Ekegusii: Omwaka wa 1790, ekoronavirus ya echiro yarure ase ekorona ya ekombe nyuma yobochori bw'ebinyoro.

English: In Russia, the COVID-19 test was developed and produced by the State Research Center of Virology and Biotechnology VECTOR.
Kiswahili: Nchini Urusi, kipimo cha COVID-19 kiliundwa na kuzalishwa na Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Utafiti cha Vairolojia na Bayoteknolojia VECTOR.
Ekegusii: Nere ase Russia, oborimo bwa COVID-19 bwabekirwe na goikeranwa na ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bwa'Virology and Biotechnology (VECTOR).

English: Everyone deserves to live free from fear; together we can build homes and communities where violence is never tolerated.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili kuishi bila hofu; kwa pamoja tunaweza kujenga nyumba na jamii ambako ukatili huvumiliwi kamwe.
Ekegusii: Omonsi ng'a ogokina kobeka amang'ana ase oboikeranu; amo amo, tonyare kobakia ebiombe na ebinyoro buna obosaria tibwateirwe.

English: The 2019 novel HCoV (2019-nCoV), which has subsequently been renamed SARS-CoV-2, is the causative agent of the ongoing epidemic of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), which has claimed more than 3,120 lives and infected more than 91,000 people as of March 3, 2020.
Kiswahili: Virusi vipya vya 2019 vya HCoV (2019-nCoV), ambavyo baadaye vilipewa jina SARS-CoV-2, ndivyo ajenti sababishi wa janga linaloendelea la ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona 2019 (COVID-19), ambalo limewauwa zaidi ya watu 3,120 na kuwaambukiza zaidi ya watu 91,000 kufikia tarehe 3 mwezi Machi 2020.
Ekegusii: HCoV mpya ya 2019 (2019-nCoV), ambayo baadaye imebadilishwa kuwa SARS-CoV-2, ndiyo kisababishi cha janga linaloendelea la ugonjwa wa korona 2019 (COVID-19), ambalo limesababisha zaidi ya maisha 3,120 na kuambukiza zaidi ya watu 91,000 kufikia tarehe 3 Machi 2020.

English: The disadvantages are disproportionate for under-privileged learners who tend to have fewer educational opportunities beyond school.Student drop-out rates tend to increase as an effect of school closures due to the challenge of ensuring all students return to school once school closures ends.
Kiswahili: Madhara hayalingani kwa wanafunzi kutoka jamii zisizojiweza ambao wanafursa finyu za kielimu kando na shule.Idadi ya wanafunzi wanaoacha shule inaonekana kuongezeka kutokana na kufungwa kwa shule kwa sababu ya changamoto ya kuhakikisha kwmaba wanafunzi wote wamerejelea masomo pindi shule zikifunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwebinyoro bwendagera ase abana baria batamanyete oboronge bwogotanga chisukuru.Obwango bw'abana baria bakorire chisukuru gotiga chisukuru nigo bwokoruta chisukuru gose goikerania chisukuru ekero chisukuru chikorire.

English: During the initial outbreak in Wuhan, China, the virus and disease were commonly referred to as "coronavirus" and "Wuhan coronavirus".
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mlipuko wa kwanza huko Wuhan, Uchina, virusi na ugonjwa huo ulijulikana kwa kawaida kama "virusi vya korona" na "virusi vya korona vya Wuhan".
Ekegusii: Wakati wa mkurupuko wa kwanza huko Wuhan, Uchina, virusi na magonjwa hayo kwa kawaida vilijulikana kama "virusi vya korona" na "Virus vya Wuhan".

English: The vaccine contains a harmless genetic code copied from the virus that causes the disease.Antibody dependent enhancement has been suggested as a potential challenge for vaccine development for SARS-COV-2, but this is controversial.
Kiswahili: Chanjo hiyo ina msimbo wa jenitiki usio na madhara uliyonakiliwa kutoka kwa ugonjwa huo. Uboreshaji unaotegemea kingamwili umependekezwa kama changamoto inayowezekana ya maendeleo ya chanjo ya SARS-COV-2, lakini ina utata.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekerengo ekiagera ekero ekorosia ekero ekio ekorokereria oborwaria.Ekeombe keria ekoremereria ebinto biria bigotwara oborwari buna ebinto biogokonya obokoreri bwa SARS-COV-2, korwa ekero ekeene nigo nigo ekorengereria.

English: Russell Zimmerman, executive director of the Australian Retailers Association, said that retailers try to raise stock, but local council restrictions on the timing of truck-deliveries make it hard.
Kiswahili: Russell Zimmerman, mkurugenzi mtendaji wa Shirika la Wauzaji Rejareja nchini Australia, alisema kwamba wauzaji rejareja wajaribu kuongeza bidhaa, lakini vizuizi vya baraza la mitaa kuhusu wakati wa kuwasilisha bidhaa kwa gari vililemaza rai yake.
Ekegusii: Russell Zimmerman, omoroberio omonene bwokoruta chibesa ase abamenyi ba Australia, oganirie ng'a abarenda chingaki nigo bagerete korenta chiburaburu, korwa oborendi bweserikari korwa endagera yogotwara chingaki chionsi goikerania ebirengererio.

English: Analyzing those binding sites provide the reasonable project of developing effective antiviral drug against COVID-19 proteins.
Kiswahili: Kuchambua maeneo hayo ya kuunganisha hutoa mradi mzuri wa kutengeneza dawa bora ya kuzuia virusi itakayotoa protini za COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Goikerania ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto ebio nigo bikorenta omoroberio omonene bwogotumia ekero ekorwania ebinto bia COVID-19.

English: Apply personal relief to all resident employees as stipulated under the Act.
Ekegusii: Tumia oboremi bwomonyene ase abakori emeremo bonsi buna egendererete ase omoroberio oo.

English: The origin and intermediate host
Kiswahili: Chimbuka na mbebaji virusi wa kati
Ekegusii: Omonyene na omonyene omonene

English: School closures negatively impact student learning outcomes.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule kunaathiri vibaya matokeo ya masomo ya wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ogochigwa kwa chisukuru nigo goikerania buna abana baranyare gosoma.

English: On one hand, SARS-CoV-2 infection exhibits features that are more commonly seen during infection with community-acquired HCoVs, including the presentation of non-specific, mild or even no symptoms.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mmoja, maambukizi ya SARS-CoV-2 huonyesha sifa ambazo kwa kawaida huonekana wakati wa maambukizi ya virusi vya kuambukizana kijamii vya HCoV, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuonyesha dalili zisizo mahususi, kiasi au hata kutokuwepo kwa dalili zozote.
Ekegusii: Kwa upande mmoja, maambukizi ya SARS-CoV-2 yanaonyesha sifa ambazo huonekana kwa kawaida wakati wa maambukizo na virusi vya HCoV vilivyopatikana katika jamii, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuonekana kwa dalili zisizo maalum, nyembamba au hata hakuna dalili.

English: It has been reported that a bat CoV termed ARCoV.2 (Appalachian Ridge CoV) detected in North American tricolored bat displayed close relationship with HCoV-NL63.
Kiswahili: Imeripotiwa kwamba virusi vya bat CoV vinavyoitwa ARCoV.2 (Appalachian Ridge CoV) vilivyogunduliwa Kaskazini mwa Marekani popo wa rangi tatu alionyesha uhusiano wa karibu na HCoV-NL63.
Ekegusii: Goikeranwa ng'a omoroberio omonene omonene ogotumeka ARCoV.2 (Appalachian Ridge CoV) ogwatumeka ase omoberio omotatu omonene o'North America, nigo ogokwanerana na HCoV-NL63.

English: Healthcare providers should be educated on snake-bite management.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi bemebasekano goika baborigwe igoro yoborendi igoro yokorwania oboremi bwokoruta enamba.

English: Hopefully, the new technique can dramatically enhance the sensitivity and convenience if verified in clinical samples.
Kiswahili: Tunatumai kwamba mbinu hii mpya inaweza kuboresha kwa njia ya kipekee umuhimu na urahisi ikiwa itathibitishwa katika sampuli za kliniki.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegendereria, omoroberio omonene nigo ogosegeta obotenereri bwao na oboremi bwebinto biria bikoremerwa korwa ebirengererio biobobwenia.

English: In addition, the maintenance of electrolyte balance, the prevention and treatment of secondary infection and septic shock, and the protection of the functions of the vital organs are also essential for SARS-CoV-2 patients.
Kiswahili: Vilevile, kudumisha usawa wa electrolyte, kuzuia na kutibu maambukizi ya pili na kutofanya kazi kwa viungo vya mwili na ulinzi wa utendakazi wa viungo muhimu pia ni muhimu kwa wagonjwa wa SARS-CoV-2.
Ekegusii: Kwa kuongezea, kudumisha usawa wa electrolyte, kuzuia na kutibu maambukizi ya pili na mshtuko wa septic, na kulinda kazi za viungo muhimu pia ni muhimu kwa wagonjwa wa SARS-CoV-2.

English: For students without internet at home, this increases the difficulty of keeping up with distance learning.
Kiswahili: Kwa wanafunzi wasio na intaneti nyumbani, hili linazidisha ugumu wa kuendelea kufuatilia mafunzo ya mbali.
Ekegusii: Ase abana batari na internet omoroberio bwebinyoro, buna ekerengo ekiagesa ekero bakorenda amasomo ase chingaki chionsi.

English: For cases with missing onset dates, date of onset was estimated by subtracting 4 days (median interval from symptom onset to specimen collection date among cases with known dates in these data) from the earliest specimen collection.
Kiswahili: Katika visa vilivyokosa tarehe ya kuanza, tarehe ya kuanza ilikadiriwa kwa kuondoa siku 4 (muda wa kati kutoka kuanza kwa dalili hadi kukusanywa kwa data miongoni kwa visa vilivyo na tarehe zinazojulikana kwenye data hizi) kutoka wakati mapema zaidi sampuli ilipokusanywa.
Ekegusii: Kwa visa visivyo na tarehe za kuanza, tarehe ya kuanza ilitathminiwa kwa kuondoa siku 4 (kipindi cha kati kuanzia mwanzo wa dalili hadi tarehe ya ukusanyaji wa sampuli miongoni mwa visa vilivyo na siku zinazojulikana katika data hizi) kutoka kwa ukusanyazi wa kwanza.

English: Practices participating in virology surveillance will opportunistically collect blood samples from patients coming into the practice for a routine blood test.
Kiswahili: Huduma zinazoshiriki katika uchunguzi wa kivairolojia zitakusanya sampuli za damu kutoka kwa wagonjwa wanaokuja katika huduma kwa ajili ya vipimo vya kawaida vya damu.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bakorwania oborendi bw'ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto biobotuki (virology surveillance) nabo bakorageria oboremi bw'amaraso gochia abarwaire baria bagotwara ebinto ebio goikerania obotuki bwao.

English: Communities – especially children – should be educated about the risks of dog bites and prevention including avoiding stray dogs and never leaving a child unattended around any dog.
Ekegusii: Ebinyoro  especially children  should be educated about the risks of dog bites and prevention including avoiding stray dogs and never leaving a child unattended around any dog.

English: We have rapidly converted the established national RCGP RSC influenza surveillance system into one that can test the effectiveness of the COVID-19 containment policy.
Kiswahili: Tumeweza kubadilisha haraka mfumo wa kitaifa wa kufuatilia homa ya mafua wa RCGP RSC ukawa mfumo unaoweza kupima ufaafu wa sera ya kudhibiti COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Twabadilishe kwa haraka mfumo wa kitaifa wa RCGP RSC wa uchunguzi wa homa ya mafua kuwa moja ambayo inaweza kupima ufanisi wa sera ya kudhibiti COVID-19.

English: Hands should be rubbed together with digits interlocking.
Kiswahili: Mikono inapaswa kusuguliwa kwa pamoja kwa kufungamanisha vidole.
Ekegusii: Amaoko goikeranwa gochia ebinto biria bigokwanerana.

English: In settings with organized screening programmes, regular screening is the most effective way to detect colorectal cancer early and prevent the disease through the identification and removal of precancerous lesions.
Ekegusii: Ase ebirengererio biria bigosegeta oboronge bwogokorwa emeremo, okorora emeremo yoboronge ase enchera eyemo endagera eyemo yobochori bwetugo na gotanga oborwari obwo goetera oboremi bwoboronge na goikerania ebinto biria bionsi bigokorerwa emeremo yebirengererio.

English: Likewise, it has been shown that the epidemic MERS-CoV experienced recombination events between different lineages, which occurred in dromedary camels in Saudi Arabia.
Kiswahili: Vilevile, imeonyeshwa kwamba janga la MERS-CoV lilishuhudia matukio ya uunganishaji kati ya vizazi tofauti, uliotokea katika ngamia warefu zaidi nchini Saudi Arabia.
Ekegusii: Kwa namna sawa, imeonyeshwa kuwa janga la MERS-CoV lilipata matukio ya kuunganishwa tena kati ya ukoo tofauti, ambayo ilitokea kwa ngamia wa dromedary nchini Saudi Arabia.

English: Teachers attend in-service training annually.
Kiswahili: Walimu huhudhuria mafunzo ya huduma kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: Abarimu bagendererete amasomo yamasomo ase omwaka.

English: People may also become infected by touching a contaminated surface and then touching their eyes, nose, or mouth.
Kiswahili: Pia watu wanaweza kuambukizwa kwa kugusa eneo lililoambukizwa na kisha kugusa macho, pua, au mdomo wao.
Ekegusii: Watu pia wanaweza kuambukizwa kwa kugusa sehemu iliyochafuliwa na kisha kugusa macho yao, pua, au mdomo.

English: Having studied previous influenza pandemics including the 1918 flu pandemic, the influenza pandemic of 1957 and the 1968 flu pandemic, they reported on the economic and workforce effect school closure would have, particularly with a large percentage of doctors and nurses being women, of whom half had children under the age of 16.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuchunguza janga la homa ya mafua ya hapo awali ikiwemo janga la homa ya mafua ya 1918, janga la homa ya mafua ya 1957 na janga la mafua ya 1968, waliripoti kuhusu athari ya kiuchumi na kikazi ambayo kufungwa kwa shule ingesababisha, hasa na asilimia kubwa ya madaktari na wauguzi kuwa wanawake, ambao nusu kati yao walikuwa na watoto chini ya miaka 16.
Ekegusii: Kwa kuchunguza majanga ya homa ya mafua ya awali ikiwa ni pamoja na janga la homa ya homa mwaka wa 1918, janga kubwa la mafua ya mwaka wa 1957 na jamba kubwa la homa la mafua mwaka wa 1968, waliripoti kuhusu athari ya kiuchumi na nguvu ya kazi ambayo kufungwa kwa shule kutakuwa nayo, hasa kwa asilimia kubwa ya madaktari na wauguzi kuwa ni wanawake, ambao nusu yao walikuwa na watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka 16.

English: In reaction, UNESCO called on countries to support affected students and families and facilitate large-scale inclusive distance learning programmes.
Kiswahili: kwa itikio, UNESCO ilihimiza nchi kusaidia wanafunzi walioathirika na familia na kuwezesha masomo inayojumuisha wote kupitia programu za kimtandao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri (UNESCO) kiaboririe ebinyoro gosegeta abana baria bakorire obotuki na emeremo yabo na gokonya emeroberio emegondo emegumi yamasomo ao.

English: On 6 February 2020, our team had published a rapid advice guideline for diagnosis and treatment of 2019 novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV) infection, and this guideline provided our experience and make well reference for fighting against this pandemic worldwide.
Kiswahili: Mnamo tarehe 6 Februari 2020, timu yetu ilichapisha mwongozo wa ushauri wa haraka wa uchunguzi na matibabu ya maambukizi ya virusi vipya vya korona 2019 (2019-nCoV), na mwongozo ulitoa uzoefu wetu na kuweka marejeleo mema kwa ajili ya kupigana na janga hili kubwa kote duniani.
Ekegusii: Tariki 6 Februari 2020, timu yetu ilichapisha mwongozo wa ushauri wa haraka kwa ajili ya upimaji na matibabu ya maambukizi ya virusi vipya vya korona (2019-nCoV) ya 2019, na mwongozo huu ulitoa uzoefu wetu na kutoa marejeleo mazuri ya kupambana na janga hili duniani kote.

English: MERS-CoV serves as an excellent example of interspecies transmission from bats to dromedary camels and from dromedary camels to humans.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya MERS-CoV vinatumika kama mfano bora wa usambazaji baina ya wanyama kutoka kwa popo hadi kwa ngamia warefu na kutoka kwa ngamia warefu hadi kwa binadamu.
Ekegusii: MERS-CoV ni mfano bora wa usambazaji kati ya aina kutoka kwa popo hadi ngamia na kutoka kwa ngamia hadi kwa binadamu.

English: Whereas civets and other animals in the markets have been found to harbour viruses identical to SARS-CoV, immediate intermediate hosts for SARS-CoV-2 have not been identified.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa ngawa na wanyama wengine sokoni wamepatikana kuwa na virusi vinavyofanana na SARS-CoV, wabebaji wa kati wa karibu wa SARS-CoV-2 hawajatambuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebinyoro n'ebinyoro ebionsi ase chindagera bionsi buna bigosegeta ebirusi biria bigokwanerana na SARS-CoV, abanto baria bakorete ebirasi ebio biria bikorete emeremo yoboremi (SARS-CoV-2) batamanyirwe.

English: Shia shrines in Qom remained open to pilgrims until 16 March 2020.Iran became a centre of the spread of the virus after China during February.
Kiswahili: Hekalu za Shia Qom zilibaki wazi kwa wasafiri hadi 16 Machi 2020.Irani ilikuwa kituo cha kuenea kwa virusi baada ya Uchina mnamo Februari.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene chia Shi'a ase omoroberio o'Qom kiabwatirwe ase abakoreri goika omotienyi 16 chiomotienyi 3 omwaka 2020.Eran yabeire ekerengo ekerengete ekero ekero ekeene ekorwarerete oborwaria nyuma yechinsina omwaka o'Februari.

English: Avoid furrow irrigation in areas prone to root rot and root-knot nematodes and fusarium.
Ekegusii: Renda korwa ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto biogosegeta oboremi bwogokonya ebinto binde biria bikoruta omoroberio bweserikari.

English: The U.S. administration of Donald Trump has referred to the coronavirus as "Chinese virus" or "Wuhan virus" saying that China's "censorship supercharged a virus that has now turned into a global pandemic", which has in turn been criticized by some critics as racism and "distract[ing] from his administration's failure to contain the disease".

Ekegusii: Oboreng'u bwokoruta obokoreri bwebinyoro ase abanto baria batamire chingaki chionsi chiokoruta omoroberio, korwa chindagera chingiya chiria chiria chitamire korwa abanto bakoruta oborendi.

English: The WHO has published several RNA testing protocols for SARS-CoV-2, with the first issued on 17 January.
Kiswahili: WHO imechapisha itifaki nyingi ya kupima RNA ya SARS-CoV-2, na chapisho la kwanza ikitolewa tarehe 17 Januari.

English: While these droplets are produced when breathing out, they usually fall to the ground or onto surfaces rather than being infectious over long distances.
Kiswahili: Ingawa matone haya yanazalishwa unapomua nje, huwa yanaanguka kwenye sakafu au kwenye maeneo kuliko kuambukizana katika umbali wa mita mirefu.

English: However, similar to SARS and MERS, COVID-19 is also associated with high morbidity and mortality in patients with severe cases.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, sawa na SARS na MERS, COVID-19 pia inahusishwa na hali ya juu ya kuweza kupata ugonjwa na viwango vya vifo kwa wagonjwa walio na hali mbaya.
Ekegusii: Hata hivyo, sawa na SARS na MERS, COVID-19 pia inahusishwa na kiwango cha juu cha ugonjwa na vifo kwa wagonjwa walio na hali mbaya.

English: School closures may be effective when enacted promptly.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule huweza kuwa na ufanisi wakati inafanywa mapema.
Ekegusii: Ogochigwa kwa chisukuru goikerania korwa oboremi bwechinsemo.

English: Early research to assess vaccine efficacy using COVID-19-specific animal models, such as ACE2-transgenic mice, other laboratory animals, and non-human primates, indicate a need for biosafety-level 3 containment measures for handling live viruses, and international coordination to ensure standardized safety procedures.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa mapema wa kutathmini ufanisi wa chanjo kwa kutumia mifamo maalum ya covid-19 ya wananyama, kama vile ACE2 yenye jeni kutoka kwa panya, wanyama wengine wa maabara, na chembe zingine zisizo za kibinadamu, unaonyesha hitaji za hatua za uzuizi wa kiwango cha 3 cha usalama wa chembe za kuambukiza, na uratibu wa kimataifa ili kuhakikisha taratibu sanifu za usalama.
Ekegusii: Utafiti wa awali wa kutathmini ufanisi wa chanjo kwa kutumia mifano maalum ya wanyama ya COVID-19, kama vile panya za ACE2-transgenic, wanyama wengine wa maabara, na wanyama wakuu wasio binadamu, unaashiria hitaji la hatua za kuzuia kiwango cha 3 cha usalama wa kibiolojia kwa ajili ya kushughulikia virusi hai, na uratibu wa kimataifa ili kuhakikisha taratibu za kawaida za usalama.

English: Patients who attend their practice for a routine blood test will be asked to provide an additional sample for serology.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa wanaohudhuria huduma zao kwa vipimo vya kawaida vya damu wataulizwa kutoa sampuli ya ziadi kwa ajili ya serolojia.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire baria bakorire oborwaria bwabo ase omoroberio bwogotemwa igoro yamaraso baranyorigwe gosaba emeroberio eyemo yogotumia ebinto biria bigotemwa ase obokoreri bwamaraso.

English: Whether either of these two leads to the same benefit for people who are critically ill is not known.
Kiswahili: Haijulikani ikiwa moja kati ya hizi mbili husababisha faida sawa kwa watu ambao ni wagonjwa sana.
Ekegusii: Haijulikani iwapo yoyote kati ya haya mawili yanaleta faida sawa kwa watu walio wagonjwa sana.

English: Little evidence exists to permit any solid conclusions about the nature of COVID-19 infection in pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Ushahidi mdogo upo wa kudhibitisha hitimisho lolote dhabiti kuhusu asili ya maambukizo ya COVID-19 katika ujauzito.
Ekegusii: Obosemia bwendagera buna buna obwenerete gokeania ebirengererio biria bikoremereria igoro yokoremerwa kwa COVID-19 ase oborito.

English: The emergence of SARS-CoV-2 in central China at the end of 2019 has thrusted CoVs into the spotlight again and surprised us with its high transmissibility but reduced pathogenicity compared to its sister SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Kuibuka kwa SARS-CoV-2 katika China ya kati mwishoni mwa 2019 kumevifanya virusi vya CoVs kuangaziwa kwa mara nyingine na kutushangaza kwa uwezekano wake wa juu wa kuenezwa lakini vikapunguza hali ya kusababisha ugonjwa ikilinganishwa na virusi vinavyofanana nayo vya SARS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Kuibuka kwa SARS-CoV-2 katika China ya kati mwishoni mwa 2019 kumeweka CoVs katika mwangaza tena na kutu mshangao kwa uwezo wake wa juu wa kusambazwa lakini kupunguza uwezekano wa kusababisha magonjwa ikilinganishwa na ndugu yake SARS-COV.

English: The ancestral virus is usually well adapted and non-pathogenic in this host.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya kiukoo kwa kawaida vimezoeleka na havina uwezo wa kusababisha ugonjwa ndani ya mbebaji huyu.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya asili kwa kawaida vimezoeleka vizuri na haviwezi kusababisha ugonjwa katika mbebaji huyu.

English: As of 29 March, nearly 90% of the world's learners were impacted by closures.Even when school closures are temporary, it carries high social and economic costs.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 29 Machi, takriban 90% ya wanafunzi kote ulimwenguni waliathirika na kufungwa kwa shule.Hata ikiwa shule zinafungwa kwa muda, inakuja na gharama ya juu za kijamii na kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Goikera omotienyi 29 omotieny, 90% ya abana baria bakorwa chisukuru chiria chiria chieserikari goikerania baranyare gosigwa.Nao ekero chisukuru chiesikari gose gose chinyomba chingiya, goikera oboremi bwabanto na obokoreri.

English: To estimate baseline susceptibility to COVID-19 in the community and estimate both symptomatic and asymptomatic exposure rates in the population through seroprevalence monitoring
Kiswahili: Kukadiria hali ya kimsingi ya jamii kuwa hatarini kupata COVID-19 na kukadiria viwango vya kuwepo hatarini kwa dalili au bila dalili miongoni mwa watu kupitia ufuatiliaji wa viwango vya virusi kwenye serami
Ekegusii: Goikerania omoroberio bwokoruta COVID-19 ase abanto bonsi na gosegeta oboremi bwogokorerwa emeremo na oboikeranu ase abamenyi goetera obokoreri bwa seroprevalence.

English: There is no known vaccine or specific antiviral treatment.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chanjo inayojulikana au matibabu maalum ya kinzavirusi.
Ekegusii: Hakuna chanjo inayojulikana au matibabu maalum ya kupambana na virusi.

English: Significant research efforts have been focused on elucidating the viral pathogenesis of these animal coronaviruses, especially by virologists interested in veterinary and zoonotic diseases.
Kiswahili: Juhudi muhimu za utafiti umelenga kufafanua wazi asili ya virusi hivi vya korona vya mnyama, haswa na wataalamu wa virusi wanaopendezwa na magonjwa ya mifugo na vinavyosambazwa kutoka kwa mnyama hadi kwa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Obotuki bwogotumia ebinto biria bigosegeta oboremi bwabeene bwabekirwe ase okorwania oborwaria bw'ebinyoro bia korona, mono na mono ase abanto baria babwatire oborwari bwogokonya ebinyoro na oborwaire bw'ebiombe.

English: Early diagnosis can prevent health problems that may result from infection and prevent transmission of the virus.
Ekegusii: Ogoikera buna okobwatia omoroberio bw'obobwenia goikerania obokong'u bwogotumia oborwaria na gosegeta obokoreri bw'ekero.

English: Persons with disabilities must be considered when preventing and responding to health emergencies because they are more likely to be affected, both directly and indirectly.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi bare noboremaru goika baborigwe ekero bakorenda na kobwatia emerengo yobochenu ekero baranyare korwa ebirengererio biria bikoremerwa, goikerania na goetera.

English: They might also account for successful adaptation of these CoVs in humans after interspecies transmission from their animal hosts.
Kiswahili: Vinaweza pia kusababisha ufanisi wa kuzoeleka kwa virusi hivi vya CoV kwa binadamu baada ya kusambazwa baina ya viumbe kutoka kwa wanyama wao wabebaji.
Ekegusii: Na pia huenda zikatoa sababu ya ufanisi wa kuzoeleka kwa virusi hivi vya CoV kwa binadamu baada ya usambazaji kati ya aina kutoka kwa wanyama waliowabeba.

English: A multicenter study on 300 patients researching the use of enoxaparin sodium at prophylaxis and therapeutic dosages was announced in Italy on April 14.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa vituo anuwai kwa wagonjwa 3000, unaochunguza matumizi ya enoxaparin sodium katika prophylaxis na dawa za matibbau ulitangazwa nchini Italia terehe 14 Aprili.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwechinsemo chionsi ase abarwaire 300 baria bakorire oboronge bwogotumia enoxaparin sodium ase oboremi na oborwaria bwogokonya oborwaire bwabeirwe omoroberio omotambe 14 omotienyi 4.

English: While not all infected people develop antibodies, the presence of antibodies may provide information about how many people have been infected.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa sio watu wote walioambukizwa hupata kingamwili, uwepo wa kingamwili unaweza kutoa maelezo ya idadi ya watu ambao wameambukizwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi batamanyete gotanga ebinto biria bigotwara ebinto biobotuki, obotuki bwa ebinto ebio nigo bogotanga obomanyi igoro yobotuki buna abanto batanyete.

English: When minimum standards are achieved, schools can move from one to ultimately three stars.
Kiswahili: Wakati viwango vya chini vimetimizwa, shule zinaweza kusonga kutoka nyota moja hadi mwishowe nyota tatu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete, chisukuru chiabe chiogokinia korwa omoroberio omotano goikerania endagera etato.

English: A small number of studies which have looked at the bacterial transfer from contaminated solid soap have concluded transfer is unlikely as the bacteria are rinsed off with the foam.
Kiswahili: Idadi chache ya utafiti ambao umeshughulikia usambazaji wa bakteria kutoka kwa sabuni mango iliyochafuliwa umehitimisha kuwa usambazaji si rahisi kutokea kwa sababu bakteria huoshwa na kuondolewa kupitia fomu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene getenenerete igoro yogotumia ebinto biria bigokonya ebinto biogosaria ase ebinto binde biogotumia esapuni ekoremerwa, nkorwania ng'a ebinto ebio bigotumia ekero ebio bionsi bikoremerigwa ase ekero ebintobi biria biogosigwa.

English: California Governor Gavin Newsom explained his state's position, saying “We need our child care facilities, our daycare centers, to operate to absorb the impact of these school closures.”
Kiswahili: Gavana wa California, Gavin Newsom alieleza msimamo wa jimbo lake, akisema “Tunataka vituo vya kutunza watoto, vituo vya kutunza watoto nyakati za mchana kuendelea kufanya kazi ili kusheheni athari ya kufungwa kwa shule hizi.”

English: When abnormalities are identified during screening, further tests to establish a definitive diagnosis should follow, as should referral for treatment if cancer is proven to be present.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebinto biria bigotenenwa ase oboronge bwogokorwa emeremo, obokoreri obuya erio gotanga obokonyi bwechinyomba goikerania oborwaria bwechinyagitari goikera oborwari bwechinsemo.

English: Do not overload electrical sockets and always switch off appliances before leaving home to prevent fire accidents.
Kiswahili: Usipakize soketi za umeme zaidi ya kiasi na daima zima vifaa vya umeme kabla ya kuondoka nyumbani ili kuzuia ajali za moto.
Ekegusii: Tosaba ebinto biria bigotumia omoroberio bweserikari na gosira ebinto biao nyuma yobochoki bwesikari erio gotanga obotuki bwa motwe.

English: More research is needed on the health equity dimensions of commercial determinants of health as well as governance considerations, including transparency and accountability, in addition to state capabilities to avoid corruption and steer private sector engagements.
Ekegusii: Oboronge obuya nobwenerete igoro yokorwania oborwaria igoro yobochori bwoborwaria ase oborendi amo na oboronge bwobokoreri, goikerania oboteneneri na obokonyi, korwa obokoreri bwa eserikari gotanga obokorekanu na gosegeta emeroberio yoborendi bweserikari.

English: Using antibiotics only when prescribed and necessary can help prevent disruptions in the body's natural microbiome.
Ekegusii: Kutumia dawa za kuua viini tu inapopendekezwa na inapohitajika kunaweza kusaidia kuzuia usumbufu katika microbiome ya asili ya mwili.

English: Our goal is simple, we want to bend the curve, and disrupt the spread of the virus.
Kiswahili: Lengo letu ni rahisi, tunataka kupinda mpindo, na kutatiza kuenea kwa virusi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete, nigo getenerete gokeania ebirengererio, na gosegeta okogendereria kwa oborwaria.

English: Applicants for passports should book appointments online and carry all required documents to avoid repeat visits.
Kiswahili: Waombaji wa pasipoti wanapaswa kupanga miadi mtandaoni na kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kurudiwa.

English: As of early April 2020, the number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 is approaching one million.

English: Try to do this less, and try to wash your hands before touching your face.
Kiswahili: Jaribu kupunguza kufanya hivi, na ujaribu kunawa mikono yako kabla ya kugusa uso wako.

Ekegusii: Baada ya kuosha na kukausha mikono kwa kutumia mashine ya kukausha hewa ya joto, idadi ya jumla ya bakteria ilipatikana kuongezeka kwa wastani kwenye vitambaa vya vidole kwa 194% na kwenye mikono kwa 254%.

English: Polling stations open in the morning; carry your identification document and follow the guidance of election officials.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupiga kura hufunguliwa asubuhi; beba hati yako ya kitambulisho na ufuate mwongozo wa maafisa wa uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gokora amachiko nigo kegokorerwa omoroberio bwokoruta chibesa (identification document) na korwa oboteneneri bwa baria bakoreta chiserekari.

English: School closures puts a strain on parents and guardians to provide childcare and manage distance learning while children are out of school.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule kunaweza mzigo kwa wazazi na walezi kutoa huduma ya kutunza watoto na kusimamia masomo ya mbali huku watoto wakiwa nje ya shule.
Ekegusii: Ogochigwa kwa chisukuru nigo kogosegeta abaibori na baria bakogendereria chisemi chiabo korenda abana na gosegeta chisemi chiria chiokwegendereria chingaki abana batari chisukuru.

English: Do not share personal items that come into contact with saliva, such as toothbrushes, eating utensils, drinks, water bottles, and towels.
Kiswahili: Usishiriki bidhaa za kibinafsi ambazo zinagusana na mate, kama vile miswaki, vyombo vya kulia, vinywaji, chumba za maji, na taulo.
Ekegusii: Tosaba ebinto biria bigokwana na amache, buna oboroso bw'amache, ebinto bia koria, ebiombe, ebitoba bia amache na etuwa.

English: Do any of the drugs reduce the time a patient is hospitalized?
Kiswahili: Dawa hizo hupunguza muda ambao mgonjwa analazwa hospitalini?

English: However, the Wuhan Institute of Virology, while recommending a daily dose of one gram, notes that twice that dose is highly dangerous and could be lethal.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Taasisi ya Virolojia ya Wuhan, ijapokuwa inapendekeza kipimo cha kila siku cha gramu moja, inabaini kuwa kutumia kiwango hicho mara mbili ni hatari sana na inaweza kusababisha kifo.
Ekegusii: Nere, ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bw'ebinto biria bigokonya ebinto binde biria bikoremerwa (Wuhan Institute of Virology), ekero ekoremereria omoroberio omonene bwogotumia egramu rimwe ase omotienyi omotano, nigo ekoreirie ng'a omoberio obo bwokoremerwa ebinto bionsi biria biria bionchoreria ebinto ebio biranyare obokoreri bwogokonya.

English: Therefore, building a prognosis model for the disease is essential for health-care agencies to prioritize their services, especially in resource-constrained areas.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, kukuza muundo unaotegemea uzoefu wa kimatibabu kwa ajili ya ugonjwa ni muhimu kwa mashirika ya tiba ya afya kuzipa kipaumbele huduma zao, hasa katika maeneo yasiyo na rasilimali za kutosha.
Ekegusii: Kwa hivyo, kujenga mtindo wa utabiri wa ugonjwa ni muhimu kwa mashirika ya huduma ya afya kuweka kipaumbele huduma zao, hasa katika maeneo yenye rasilimali ndogo.

English: Many scientific publishers made scientific papers related to the outbreak available with open access.
Kiswahili: Wachapishaji wengi wa kisayansi waliandika karatasi za kisayansi zinazohusiana na mkurupuko kupatikana na uwezo huru wa ufikiaji.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi abange bechisayansi baboririe ebitabu biesayansi biria bigokwanerana nomoroberio omonene.

English: In addition, practices are now able to code any foreign travel undertaken, including the ability to record visits to multiple countries (implemented February 8, 2020).
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, huduma sasa zinaweza kusimba safari zozote za ng'ambo zilizofanywa, ikiwa ni pamoja na uwezo wa kurekodi safari kuelekea nchi nyingi (ilitekelezwa tarehe 8 Februari 2020).
Ekegusii: Goikerania, ebinyoro ebio nigo bigokonya gokora emeroberio yobochenu bwogotumia chingaki chionsi chiria chiria chiokorwa, goikera obokong'u bwokorika obogendereri bwebinyoro bionsi (binyoretwe omotienyi 8, omwaka 2020).

English: Many organizations are using published genomes to develop possible vaccines against SARS-CoV-2.
Kiswahili: Mashirika mengi yanatumia jenomu zilizochapishwa kutengeneza chanjo zinazowezekana za kuzuia SARS-CoV-2.

English: Use cultivation equipment first in healthy portion of the orchard before use in diseased areas.
Ekegusii: Tumia ebinto biria bigosegeta igoro yoboremi bwao ase ekerasi chioboremi bwogotumia chingaki chionsi chiokwegendereria.

English: This should go without saying, but we’re saying it.
Kiswahili: Hii inapaswa kuwa wazi, lakini tunaisema.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ekiagera goikerania, korwa nigo togokwanerana.

English: Serious complications include pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and multi-organ failure leading to disability or death.
Kiswahili: Matatizo makubwa ni pamoja na nimonia, matatizo sugu ya upumuaji, na kushindikana kwa viungo vingi kunaosababisha ulemavu au kifo.
Ekegusii: Matatizo makubwa ni pamoja na nimonia, ugonjwa mbaya wa kupumua, na kutofaulu kwa viungo vingi kusababisha ulemavu au kifo.

English: Cases refers to the number of people who have been tested for COVID-19, and whose test has been confirmed positive according to official protocols.
Kiswahili: Visa inamaanisha idadi ya watu waliopimwa kwa COVID-19, na kipimo chao kuthibitishwa kuwa chanya kulingana na itifaki rasmi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene nigo ekorwania ng'a abanto baranyorigwe igoro ya COVID-19, na abanto bagosorwa buna bagosegete korwa emeremo yoborendi bweserikari.

English: If safety and efficacy are adequately proved, clinical testing may stop at this step and the NCE advances to the new drug application (NDA) stage to begin marketing.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa usalama na ufanisi umethibitishwa vizuri, vipimo vya kliniki vinaweza kukoma katika hatua hii na NCE kuendendelea na hatua ya matumizi ya dawa mpya ili kuanza uuzaji.
Ekegusii: Ekero oborendi na obokoreri bwebinyoro bigokonyarekana, oborimo bwogokorwa emeremo nobwenerete gokeigwa nyuma yechitariki chionsi, na ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboremi (NCE) nkogendererete ase ekero ekorosia ebinto biria bigokonywa (NDA) erio gochakia obokorosia.

English: The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends active surveillance, with focus of case finding, testing and contact tracing in all transmission scenarios.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) linapendekeza uchunguzi amilifu, ukizingatia utafutaji wa kisa, upimaji na utafutaji wa utangamano katika hali zote za maambukizo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oborwaria (WHO) nkigokurera oborendi bwogokurerwa, na gosegeta omoroberio bwogotumeka, okorigereria na korwa obokoreri bwebinyoro ase ebinyoro bionsi.

English: The hierarchy of hazard controls is a framework widely used in occupational safety and health to group hazard controls by effectiveness.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa viwango ya udhibiti wa hatari ni mfumo unaotumiwa sana katika usalama wa kikazi na afya kuweka katika vikundi udhibiti wa hatari kulingana na ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri bwebinyoro nigo nigo ekero ekoremereria oborendi na oborwaria ase omoroberio bwoborendi gochia ebinyoro.

English: Create communities to ensure regular human interactions, enable social caring measures, and address possible psychosocial challenges that students may face when they are isolated.
Kiswahili: Unda jamii kuhakikisha kutangamana kwa watu mara kwa mara, wezesha hatua za huduma za kijamii, na tatua changamoto zozote za kisaikolojia zinazowezekana ambazo wanafunzi huweza kupata wanapotengwa.

China), aina za wanyama au vikundi vya watu, kulingana na mapendekezo ya kimataifa kuhusu kutoa jina linalolenga kuzuia unyanyapaa. Virusi vinavyosababisha COVID-19 vinaitwa virusi vya korona vya ugonjwa mbaya wa pumu 2 (SARS-CoV-2).

English: On the other hand, it remains to be verified whether the transmissibility of SARS-CoV-2 decreases after passages in humans as in the cases of SARS-CoV and MERS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mwingine, itasalia kuthibitishwa iwapo uwezo wa kusambazwa kwa ugonjwa wa SARS-COV-2 hupungua baada ya kupitishwa kwa binadamu kama ilivyo katika visa vya SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV.
Ekegusii: Kwa upande mwingine, inabaki kuthibitishwa iwapo uwezekano wa kusambazwa kwa SARS-CoV-2 hupungua baada ya kupita kwa binadamu kama ilivyo katika visa vya SARS-COV na MERS-CoV.

English: A New Zealand evacuation flight arrived in Auckland on 5 February; its passengers (including some from Australia and the Pacific) were quarantined at a naval base in Whangaparoa, north of Auckland.
Kiswahili: Ndege ya kuwahamisha raia wa New Zealand ilifika Auckland mnamo 5 Februari; abiria wake (wakiwemo wengine kutoka Australia na Pasifiki) waliwekwa karantini katika kituo cha jeshi la wanamaji Whangaparoa, kaskazini wa Auckland.

English: A comprehensive public health response must address this wide range of older people’s experiences and needs.

Kiswahili: Katika utafiti uliofanywa huko Uchina na Italia, kiwango cha vifo viko juu kwa wanaume.

English: Personal protective equipment (PPE) is considered less effective than engineering and administrative controls, but can help prevent some exposures.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kujikinga kibinafsi (PPE) zinazingatiwa kuwa matokeo duni kuliko udhibiti za uhandisi na utawala, lakini huweza kuzuia baadhi ya matukio ya kuwepo hatarini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborendi (PPE) nkiagendererete korwa ebinto biengencho ase obotekinorochia na oboteneneri, korwa nigo kegokonya gotanga obokoreri obuya.

English: We will also discuss what we have learned so far regarding the prevention and prognosis of the disease as well as some remaining yet urgent questions.
Kiswahili: Pia, tutajadili mambo ambayo tumejifunza kufikia sasa kuhusiana na uzuiaji na chanzo cha ugonjwa pamoja na baadhi ya maswali ambayo bado hayajajibiwa.

Kiswahili: Dalili za kawaida zinajumuisha homa, kukohoa, na matatizo ya kupumua.

Kiswahili: Hii inamaanisha kwamba wataalamu wengi wa matababu hawapo katika vituo ambapo wanahitajika zaidi wakati wa mgogoro wa afya.

English: One issue with antiviral treatment is the development of resistance through mutations that can lead to more severe disease and transmission.
Kiswahili: Suala moja na matibabu ya kuzia virusi ni maedeleo ya upinzani kupitia mabadiliko ambayo yanaweza kusababisha ugonjwa kali na maambukizo.

English: Your voice matters; attend the next public participation forum and tell your leaders what your community needs.

Ekegusii: Gosaba ebirengererio biabo ekero bakorire emeroberio yao.

English: The purpose of hand-washing in the health-care setting is to remove pathogenic microorganisms ("germs") and avoid transmitting them.
Kiswahili: Madhumuni ya kuosha mikono katika sehemu ya huduma za afya ni ili kuondoa viini vya magonjwa ("vijidudu") na kuzuia kuvisambaza.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekorokia amaoko ase oborwaria ng'a gotanga ebinto biria bigotwara oborwaire ("ebinto biogosaria") na gotanga gochia ebinto ebio.

English: These become very high exposure risk if workers perform aerosol-generating procedures on, or collect or handle specimens from, known or suspected COVID-19 patients.
Kiswahili: Kazi hizi zinakuwa zenye hatari kubwa ya kuambukizwa ikiwa wafanyakazi wanatekeleza taratibu za kuzalisha aerosoli, au kukusanya au kushughulikia sampiuli kutoka kwa wagonjwa wanaojulikana au kushukiwa wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Aya nagotoma korwa ase obokoreri bwebinto biria bigosegeta oboremi bwogotumia ebinto biobotuki (aerosol) korwa, gose gokonya gose gokeania ebinto bia abarwaire ba COVID-19 baria babamanyete gose baranyare gose goikerania.

English: It is common that for people who are exposed to a large number of viruses or whose immune functions are compromised, they have higher chance to be infected than others.
Kiswahili: Ni jambo la kawaida kwamba kwa watu waliomo katika hatari ya kupata idadi kubwa ya virusi au ambao kinga zao za mwili ni dhaifu, wana nafasi kubwa zaidi ya kuambukizwa na wengine.

English: On 12 March 2020, India's Health Ministry announced they are working with 11 isolates, and that even on a fast track it would take at least around one-and-a-half to two years to develop a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 12 Machi 2020, Wizara ya Afya ya India ilitangaza kuwa wanafanya kazi na watu 11 waliojitenga, na kwamba hata wakifuatilia haraka itachukua angalau muda wa mwaka mmoja na nusu hadi miaka mbili kutengeneza chanjo.

Kiswahili: Wakati kuna usambazaji mkubwa katika jamii yao, pamoja na mikakati ya kutotangamana na watu, kufungwa kwa shule kwa muda mrefu huweza kuchukuliwa.

Kiswahili: Huku kukiwa madai ya kuficha kiwango cha mkurupuko Irani, zaidi ya nchi kumi zilifuatilia visa vyao kurudi hadi Irani kufikia 28 Februari, kuonyesha kuwa kiwango cha mkurupuko huenda ikawa mbaya zaidi kuliko visa 388 vilivyoripotiwa na serikali ya Irani kufikia tarehe hiyo.

Kiswahili: Tarehe 13 Machi, serikali katika nchi 49 zilitangaza au kutekeleza kufungwa kwa shule, zikiwemo nchi 39 zilizofunga shule kote nchini na nchi 22 zilizofunga shule katika maeneo mengine.

English: As these notifications occurred, doctors in Wuhan were warned by police for "spreading rumours" about the outbreak.

English: It is speculated that the flu pandemic of 1890 may have been caused by this spillover event, and not by the influenza virus, because of the related timing, neurological symptoms, and unknown causative agent of the pandemic.

English: Less commonly, upper respiratory symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose or sore throat may be seen.

Ekegusii: Ogotebweka, ebirengererio biogokonya omoroberio bwogotanga emete buna okorora, okobwateka kw'amabere gose oboremi bw'emete nigo bikomanyekana.
