English: Up to now, no live MERS-CoV can be found in wild bats.
Kiswahili: Kufikia sasa, hakuna virusi hai vya MERS-COV vinavyoweza kupatikana ndani ya popo wa porini.
Ekegusii: Goikerania, gochia MERS-CoV gochia ase okoremerwa ase ebinyinyi biengencho.

English: The physicochemical properties of SARS-CoV-2 are largely not yet known.
Kiswahili: Sifa za kifisio-kemia za SARS-CoV-2 bado hazijulikani pakubwa.
Ekegusii: Sifa za kisaikolojia za SARS-CoV-2 kwa kiasi kikubwa hazijulikani bado.

English: Basic good food hygiene practices, as described in the WHO “ Five keys to safer food ”, can prevent the transmission of pathogens responsible for many foodborne diseases, and also protect against foodborne diseases caused by STEC.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokoruta chingaki chionsi, buna oranyoretwe ase ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboremi (WHO) (Five keys to safer food), nigo kegokonya gotanga oborwaria bw'ebinto biria bigotumia chingaki, na goikerania oborwari bwogokonya chingaki chiria chikoruta chingaka (STEC).

English: The most optimistic estimate is that the outbreak will end by March and the downswing phase will last for 3-4 months.
Kiswahili: Makadirio ya matumaini zaidi ni kwamba mkurupuko huu utakakwisha kufikia Machi na awamu ya athari zake kwake itadumu kwa miezi 3-4.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete ng'a ekero ekero ekeene ekoremerwa nigo ekoragera nyuma yechitariki 3 omotienyi 3 omotambe, na ekero okoremereria ekero koremerwa gose emetienyi 3 - 4.

English: WHO works with countries to prevent Ebola outbreaks by maintaining surveillance and supporting at-risk countries to develop preparedness plans.
Ekegusii: WHO inashirikiana na nchi kuzuia mkurupuko wa Ebola kwa kudumisha ufuatiliaji na kusaidia nchi zilizo hatarini kuendeleza mipango ya maandalizi.

English: Amid a cruise ship outbreak, quarantines and docking are challenging partly due to the large number of people aboard.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mlipuko wa ugonjwa huu katika meli ya abiria, kuna changamoto ya karantini na kutua kwa sababu ya idadi kubwa ya watu melini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekoremereria ekero ekerasi ekorwarantini na okorenta ebinto biria bikoremerwa ase ekero abanto baria bakorete ekeombe ekero bakorwe ase ebinto binde.

English: Apart from the super-spreaders, it was estimated that each case could give rise to approximately two secondary cases, with an incubation period of 4 to 7 days and the peak of viral load appearing on the 10th day of illness.
Kiswahili: Kando na vienezi vikuu, ilikadiriwa kwamba kila kisa kingeibua takriban visa viwili vya pili na kipindi kati ya kuambukizwa na kujitokeza cha siku 4 hadi 7 na upeo wa kiwango cha virusi ukionekana siku ya 10 ya ugonjwa.
Ekegusii: Tenga na ebinto biria bigosegeta enamba eyemo, goikerania ng'a omoroberio oomo nigo ogotwara ebinto ebio biogotwara enamba ebirengererio ebio, buna obotambe bwogokonya enamba 4 gose emetienyi 7 na enamba enene y'ebinto birengererio bigotumia enamba 10 y'oborwaria.

English: Low-molecular-weight heparin is being widely used to treat patients, prompting the Italian Medicines Agency to publish guidelines on its use.
Kiswahili: Heparin yenye uzito wa chini wa molekuli inatumika sana kutibu wagonjwa, ikisababisha Shirika la Dawa huko Italia kuchapisha miongozo ya matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Heparini ya uzito wa chini wa molekuli inatumika sana kutibu wagonjwa, ikisukuma Shirika la Dawa la Italia kuchapisha miongozo kuhusu matumizi yake.

English: Some areas permit small groups; others prohibit all group gatherings.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya maeneo yanaruhusu makundi madogo; mengine yanakataza mikusanyiko yote ya makundi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete abanto abange; ekeombe ekenene ekenene gotanga ebinyoro bionsi.

English: Slowing now won’t hurt later.
Kiswahili: Kupunguza kasi sasa hakutadhuru baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ogochora ebirengererio biao bono, goikerania obotuki bwao nyuma.

English: Currently, virology samples for influenza surveillance are accompanied by a standard request form.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, sampuli za vairilojia za uchunguzi wa homa ya mafua zinaambatana na fomu ya kawaida ya ombi.
Ekegusii: Ase bono, emeroberio y'obobwenia bw'ebinto biria bigokorwa ase oborendi bw'omorwaria omonene (influenza surveillance) nigo egendererete korwa omoroberio omonene.

English: However, our training will include reminders about safe handling of specimens and revision of infection control measures anticipated to be high in our practices.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mafunzo yetu yatajumuisha vikumbusho kuhusu kushughulikia sampuli kwa njia salama na kudurusiwa kwa udhibiti wa maambukizi yanaytrajiwa kuwa ya juu katika huduma zetu.
Ekegusii: Nere, omoroberio bwetugo nigo nogosegeta ogokurerwa igoro yoborendi bwechindagera na gosegeta emeroberio yokorwania oborwaria igoro yokoremerwa.

English: In a study of early cases, the median time from exhibiting initial symptoms to death was 14 days, with a full range of six to 41 days.
Kiswahili: Katika uchunguzi wa hali za mapema, muda wastani wa kuonyesha dalili za mwanzo hadi kifo ulikuwa siku 14, na kiwango kamili cha siku sita hadi 41.
Ekegusii: Ase omoroberio bwemebasekano ya kera, obotambe bwetugo goikerania ebirengererio biao biogotoma goika goikera endagera 14 amo nobotambe bwao bwonsi goika emetienyi 41.

English: Kenyans are urged to reject violence and hate speech before, during and after the elections.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanahimizwa kukataa vurugu na lugha za chuki kabla, wakati na baada ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Kenya baborigwe gotanga obokebago na gosegeta igoro yobochori, kera na nyuma yamatora.

English: If you have no choice, do your research and get up-to-date information about the local situation wherever you are going.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huna chaguo lingine, fanya utafiti wako na upate maelezo mapya kuhusu hali ya kokote unakoenda.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari na ekeene, kora obotuki bwao na korwa obomanyi bwango igoro yobochenu bweserikari goika oranyare.

English: Confirmed case: "A person with laboratory confirmation of COVID-19 infection, irrespective of clinical signs and symptoms".
Kiswahili: Kisa kilichodhibitishwa: "Mtu mwenye uthibitisho wa maabara ya maambukizo ya COVID-19, bila kujali ishara na dalili za kliniki".
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene: "Omonto oranyare obokonyi bw'obobobwenia bwa COVID-19 ase ekeombe keria ekoremereria, goikerania ebimanyererio biobwenerete na ebirengererio biobochenu".

English: Australian authorities evacuated 277 citizens on 3 and 4 February to the Christmas Island Detention Centre, which had been repurposed as a quarantine facility, where they remained for 14 days.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Australia ilihamisha raia 277 mnamo 3 na 4 Februari hadi Kituo cha Kizuizi ya Christmas Island, ambayo ilifanywa kuwa kituo cha karantini, ambako walibaki kwa siku 14.
Ekegusii: Abarendi ba Australia baranyare abanto 277 omotienyi 3 na 4 omotieny 2 goika ekeombe keria ekoremerwa ase ekenyoro kia Christmas Island, ekiagendererete korwa ekeombe ekerenda, korwa bakorire emetienyi 14.

English: Build in extra time for your connections, especially if transferring from an international flight to a domestic flight and especially if your itinerary involves a country that's seriously affected.
Kiswahili: Jipangie muda wa ziada wa kuunganisha safari zako, hasa ikiwa unahamia ndege ya kimataifa hadi ndege ya ndani na hasa ikiwa safari yako inahusisha nchi ambayo imeathiriwa vibaya.
Ekegusii: Kabe nomoroberio omonene ase obokoreri bwao, na gokonya korwa omoroberio bwokoruta chibesa gose omoberio bwoborendi bwogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia chingaki chionsi gose chingaki chiria chiria chikoruta chingaki chiabo.

English: Universities and schools around the country closed.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu na shule kote nchini zilifungwa.
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chiesukuru na chinyomba chiria chionsi chiria chiria chikoreirwe chikoretwe.

English: Overall approval of Trump's management of the crisis has been polarized along partisan lines.
Kiswahili: Kibali ya jumla cha usimamizi wa hali ya hatari imegawanyika kufuatia ufuasi wa vyama.
Ekegusii: Okorwa ase obokoreri bwa Trump igoro yobochenu bwokoruta chinchera chiokoruta chibesa goetera obokebago bwechinkwana.

English: By 26 February, relatively few cases had been reported among youths, with those 19 and under making up 2.4% of cases worldwide.The United Kingdom's chief scientific adviser, Patrick Vallance, estimated that 60% of the British population would need to become infected before effective herd immunity could be achieved.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 26 Februari, angalau visa vichache viliripotiwa katika vijana, wale walio na umri 19 na chini wakiwa hadi 2.4% ya visa ulimwenguni.Mshauri Mkuu wa Kisayansi wa Uingereza, Patrick Vallance, alikadiria kuwa 60% ya idadi ya Uingereza watahitaji kuambukizwa kabla ya kinga fanifu itapatikana kupitia chanjo.
Ekegusii: Kufikia 26 Februari, visa vichache vilikuwa vimeripotiwa miongoni mwa vijana, na wale walio na umri wa miaka 19 na chini wakijumuisha asilimia 2.4% ya visa kote ulimwenguni.Mshauri mkuu wa kisayansi wa Uingereza, Patrick Vallance, alikadiria kuwa 60% ya idadi ya watu wa Uingereza watahitaji kuambukizwa kabla ya kinga bora ya kundi kuweza kupatikana.

English: A survey of domestic and wild animals for antibodies is warranted.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa wanyama wa nyumbani na wa porini kwa ajili ya antibodi unastahiki.
Ekegusii: Okorigia emeremo yebiremwa biria bigokonya korwa ebinto biria bikogendereria oboremi bwebiremwa.

English: We have the option to move to twice weekly surveillance reports with a scope to change this to daily reporting.
Kiswahili: Tuna chaguo la kuhamisha hii hadi ripoti mara mbili za kila wiki la ufuatiliaji kwa lengo la kubadilisha hii kuwa ripoti ya kila siku.
Ekegusii: Nigo togotumia omoroberio bwogotumia emeroberio yoborendi bweserikari gochia ebirengererio biao ebinto ebio biogotwara ebinto biria bigotwara oborendi bwao ase ebinto bionsi, na goikerania eyio goetera oboroberio bwesikari.

English: They also outline controls necessary to address those risks, and contingency plans for situations that may arise as a result of outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Zinaorodhesha pia udhibiti zinazofaa kukabiliana na hatari hizo, na mipango ya dharura kwa hali zinazoweza kutokea kufuatia mkurupuko.
Ekegusii: Bigo biranyorire oborendi obuya bwokorwania oboremi obo, na oboronge bwogokonya korwa emeroberio erio erio korwa ebirengererio biria biranyare korwa obotuki.

English: This will help to prevent inadvertent spread of diseases from plant to plant and movement of infested soil within and outside the field.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ekiagokonya gotanga oborwaria goikerania ebirengererio korwa ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto bioborwaria na gosegeta endagera yobochenu bwetugo goetera ebinto ebio.

English: Some countries have imposed restrictions based on citizenship or residency from severely affected areas.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nchi zimeweka vikwazo kulingana na uraia au makazi kutoka kwa maeneo yaliyoathirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korwa ebinto biria bigosegeta oboronge bwogokorerwa emeremo buna abanto baria bakorire emeremo eyio.

English: The RCGP RSC conducts virology surveillance each influenza season, with 100 GPs participating in the 2019-2020 season (Figure 1).
Kiswahili: RCGP RSC huendesha uchunguzi wa vairolojia kila msimu wa homa ya mafua, wahudumu 100 wakishiriki katika msimu wa 2019-2020 (Picha ya 1).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oborwaria (RCGP RSC) nkiabekire oborendi bw'ebinto biria bigokonya ebinyinyi (virology surveillance) ase omwaka o'gosaba kwa omoroberio bw'omoroberio (influenza), amo na baria bagokonya emeremo (GP) 100 goetera omwaka 2019-2020 (Figure 1).

English: Avoiding scented or harsh personal care products can also help prevent irritation and reduce the risk of yeast infections.
Ekegusii: Goikerania ebinto biria bigokonya oboremi bwogokonya omonto bwomonto na gosegeta obokebago na gotanga obogima bw'obongo.

English: In 2008, a study was conducted by the University of Westminster, London, and sponsored by the paper-towel industry the European Tissue Symposium, to compare the levels of hygiene offered by paper towels, warm-air hand dryers and the more modern jet-air hand dryers.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa 2008, utafiti ulifanywa na Chuo Kikuu cha Westminster, London, na kufadhiliwa na sekta ya watengenezaji taulo za karatasi Maonyesho ya Karatasi Shashi ya Ulaya, ili kulinganisha viwango vya usafi vinavyotolewa na taulo za karatasi, vikausha mikono vya hewa vuguvugu na vikausha mikono vya kisasa zaidi vya hewa aina ya jet-air.
Ekegusii: Omwaka 2008, obokoreri bwabekirwe ase eyunifasiti ya Westminster, London, na gosegetigwa n'eserikari y'ebinto biria bigotumia ebinto biobochori, European Tissue Symposium, erio goikerania omoroberio bw'obosemi bwokoruta ebinto ebio, ebinto bikoruta amaoko ase omochando omonene, na ebinto binde biria biria biogotumia amaoko.

English: If you do touch it, wash your hands immediately afterwards.
Kiswahili: Ukiigusa, nawa mikono yako mara moja baadaye.
Ekegusii: Nere okorigia, yobia amaoko ao nyuma yao.

English: Presentation of coryza, conjunctivitis, fever, and bronchiolitis is common in the disease caused by HCoV-NL63.
Kiswahili: Kuonekana kwa mafua, inflamesheni ya konjaktiva ya jicho, joto jingi na bronkiolitisi ni kawaida katika ugonjwa unaosababishwa na HCoV-NL63.
Ekegusii: Ogoikerania kwa korisa, oboremi bw'obongo, omochando, na obokoreri bw'ebirengererio (bronchiolitis) nigo goikeranie ase oborwaire obuo obotwarigwe na HCoV-NL63.

English: In a 2016 review of 106 drug candidates assessed through clinical trials, the total capital expenditure for a manufacturer having a drug approved through successful Phase III trials was $2.6 billion (in 2013 dollars), an amount increasing at an annual rate of 8.5%.
Kiswahili: Katika ukaguzi mwaka wa 2016 wa dawa 106 zilizoteuliwa na kutathminiwa kupitia vipimo vya kliniki, matumizi ya jumla ya mtaji kwa mtengenezaji mwenye dawa ilidhibitishwa kupitia vipimo vilivyofaulu vya Awamu ya III yalikuwa dola bilioni 2.6 (kwa dola za mwaka wa 2013), kiasi cha fedha kinachoongezeka kwa kiwango cha kila mwaka cha asilimia 8.5.
Ekegusii: Ase omoroberio bwomwaka 2016 bwemebasekano 106 ase ebinto biria bigotemwa goetera ebirengererio biogokorerwa emeremo, oboremi bwogotumia ebinto ebio ase omotugi ogotumia emegerio yechisindani chia 3 buna emeriirioni 2.6 (ng'a emeri ya 2013), emeri egokinia ase emeri 8,5% ase omwaka.

English: Vulnerable populations (such as small children and the elderly) should avoid the consumption of raw or undercooked meat products, raw milk, and products made from raw milk.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi babwenerete korwa obokoreri (ng'a abana abange na abakungu) goikerania gotumia ebinto biria bigotumia endagera engiya, engiya engiya na ebinto bigotoma engiya.

English: People with bipolar disorder need treatment and care across acute episodes of mania and depression and when indicated, longer-term treatment to prevent relapse.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baria bare na oborwaire bwa bipolar baranyare gosegeta oborwaria na oborendi ase ebirengererio biria biranyare oboremi na obokong'u na ekero bigosemigwa, gosegetera oborwari bwa kera erio gotanga obokoreri.

English: Gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea have been observed in varying percentages.
Kiswahili: Dalili kwenye tumbo kama vile kichefuchefu, kutapika, kuhara zimeonekana katika asilimia tofauti.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bw'obongo buna okobwateka, okobwata, na okobura, nabwenerete korwa ebirengererio biengencho.

English: All three indexes ended the week down more than 10%.
Kiswahili: Faharasa zote tatu zilifunga wiki zikiwa chini kwa zaidi ya 10%.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi bwechinsemo chiria chionsi chiria chinyorire omotienyi gose goikerania ebirengo bionsi bitato.

English: Several other countries have also managed the pandemic with aggressive contact tracing, inbound travel restrictions, testing, and quarantining, but with less aggressive lock-downs, such as Iceland and South Korea.
Kiswahili: Nchi nyingine nyingi pia zimedhibiti janga hili kubwa kwa mpango kabambe wa kufuatilia watu waliogusana, vizuizi vya usafiri ndani ya nchi, upimaji na karantini, lakini kwa kiwango cha chini cha kufungia shughuli za kawaida, kama vile Aislandi na Korea Kusini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete obokoreri bwebinyoro na gosegeta oborwaria ase oboronge bwogokwanerana nabo, oborendi bwogotwara ebinyoro, obotambe, na obokorantini, korwa oborendo bwokwerenda, buna Iceland na South Korea.

English: These suckers should be cut off at the ground level to allow the development of the mother plant or until the mother plant reaches 1 m in height, at which time 1 following sucker is selected to continue.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekiagera ekero chinyorete gose ekero ekerete ekero ekeombe ekiagendererete gokeania ekerengo ekerenge ekerengete, gose goika ekerengi ekerengerete ekerengencho ekerenga ekerengancho ekegete 1m ase oboremi, ekero endagera eyemo yokorwania ekerengele ekiagerererete.

English: Treatment is also indicated for patients in whom infection has been reactivated (for example, due to immunosuppression), and during the early chronic phase, including for girls and women of childbearing age (before or after pregnancy) to prevent congenital transmission.
Ekegusii: Oborwaria nabwo bwabekirwe ase abarwaire abwo oborwaria bwabwaterete (bwendagera, ase okorwania oborwaire bw'obongo), na ase obotambe bw'ebirengererio, goikerania abanyaroka na abakungu baria bare ase obokong'u (ng'a na nyuma yobotambe) erio gotanga okorwarerigwa kwa abamenyi.

English: This variability is also likely to be significantly affecting reported case fatality rates, which are likely to be significantly over-estimated in some countries.
Kiswahili: Hali hii ya utofauti pia ina uwezekano wa kuathiri pakubwa visa vya kiwango vya vifo, ambavyo kuna uwezekano mkubwa wa kukadiriwa kupita kiasi katika baadhi ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekerengo ekerengete buna ekero ekerengerete nigo ekorenta ebirengererio biria bigokwanerwa, ebio bikoremerwa koremerwa ase ebinyoro bionsi.

English: SARS-CoV-2 shares 96.2% nucleotide homology with a bat CoV RaTG13 isolated from Rhinolophus affinis bats.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya SARS-CoV-2 vina 96.2% za nukleotidi zinazofanana na virusi vya CoV RaTG13 vya popo vilivyotolewa kwa popo wa asili ya Rhinolophus affinis.
Ekegusii: SARS-CoV-2 inashiriki homolojia ya nucleotide ya 96.2% na CoV ya popo RaTG13 iliyojitenga na popo wa Rhinolophus affinis.

English: The exoribonuclease nonstructural protein, for instance, provides extra fidelity to replication by providing a proofreading function which the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase lacks.One of the main functions of the complex is to replicate the viral genome.
Kiswahili: Protini isiyokuwa na muundo ya exoribonclease, kwa mfano, hutoa uaminifu wa ziada wa urudufishaji kwa kutoa utendaji wa kupitia ambao polyemerase RNA inyotegemea RNA inakosa. Mojawapo ya kazi kuu za uchangamano huu ni kurudufu genomu ya virusi.
Ekegusii: Protini isiyo ya muundo ya exoribonuclease, kwa mfano, hutoa uaminifu wa ziada kwa urudishaji kwa kutoa kazi ya kurekebisha ambayo RNA polymerase inayotegemea RNA haipatikani. Mojawapo ya kazi kuu za kiwanja hicho ni kurudisha jenomu ya virusi.

English: Some U.S. officials and commentators criticized the U.S. reliance on importation of critical materials, including essential medical supplies, from China.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya maafisa wa Marekani na watoa maoni walisuta hatua ya Marekani ya kutegemea ununuzi wa bidhaa muhimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na bidhaa muhimu za kimatibabu kutoka China.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi abange ba America na baria bakorwania obokoreri bwabo bagosoreria buna America igosegeta ebinto biria bigosemia, goika ebinto biogokonya emeremo, korwa China.

English: Seven trials were evaluating repurposed drugs already approved to treat malaria, including four studies on hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine phosphate.
Kiswahili: Majaribio saba yalikuwa yakikagua dawa zilizotumika vingine na zilizoidhinishwa kutibu ugonjwa wa malaria, ikiwemo utafiti nne wa hydroxychloroquine au chloroquine phosphate.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete goikerania ebinto biria bikoremerwa korwa endwari ya Esosera, goika ebinto bine biria bigokorwa igoro ya hydroxychloroquine gose chloroquin phosphate.

English: In China, there are extensive restrictions on transportation and activity, which vary widely by province, city, and even by district or village.
Kiswahili: Nchini Uchina, kuna vikwazo zaidi vya usafiri na shughuli, ambavyo vinatofautiana pakubwa kwa mkoa, jimbo na hata wilaya au kijiji.
Ekegusii: Ase Chinani, goika goikerania ebirengererio na obokoreri, ebio bikorenta buya goetera eserikari, esikari, gose chingaki chiabo.

English: Economist Mohamed El-Erian praised central banks' and states' timely emergency measures.
Kiswahili: Mwanauchumi Mohamed El-Erian amesifu hatua za dhurura zilizochukuliwa kwa wakati ufaao na benki kuu na serikali.
Ekegusii: Omomanyi omonene omonene Mohamed El-Erian oakeeneirie buna ebengi ebinene na ebinto biria bigokonya oboremi bwa kera.

English: These other host plants should be included in the sanitation programme.
Ekegusii: Ebinyoro ebi biria bigosegeta oboremi buna bikoretwe ase omoroberio bwobosemia.

English: We can see that the real-time PCR test for nucleic acid in respiratory tract or blood samples was added to the second (18 January 2020) and third (22 January 2020) editions.
Kiswahili: Tunaweza kuona kwamba kipimo cha muda halisi cha PCR kwa asidi ya kinyuklia kwenye njia ya kupumua au sampuli ya damu kiliongezwa kwenye toleo la pili la (Tarehe 18 Januari 2020) na la tatu (Tarehe 22 Januari 2020).
Ekegusii: Twonerete ng'a oborimo bwa PCR bw'omoroberio omonene bw'esimi ya nucleic acid ase omoroberio bw'obongo gose ebirengererio bi'amaraso, bwabekirwe ase ekero kia abanto 18 omotienyi omotambe omonene omonene (January 18, 2020) na omotieny omotato (Januari 22, 2020).

English: Coronaviruses have been recognized as causing pathological conditions in veterinary medicine since the 1930s.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vimetambuliwa kusababisha hali za kipatholojia katika dawa ya mifugo tangu miaka ya 1930.
Ekegusii: Virusi vya korona vimetambuliwa kama vinavyosababisha hali za kimasa katika dawa ya mifugo tangu miaka ya 1930.

English: After attachment, a protease of the host cell cleaves and activates the receptor-attached spike protein.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuambatisha, protisi ya seli mama hukwamilia na kuamilisha kipokezi kilichoambatishwa kwenye protini ya ncha kazi.
Ekegusii: Baada ya kushikamana, protease ya seli ya mbebaji inashikilia na kuamsha protini ya ncha iliyounganishwa na vipokezi.

English: On 12 April, the government stated that the contact tracing app was in an advanced stage of development, and would be available for deployment within weeks.A similar app is planned in Ireland, and in France ("StopCovid").
Kiswahili: Tarehe 12 Aprili, serikali ilisema kuwa programu ya kutafuta watu waliotangamana ilikuwa katika hatua za juu za maendeleo, na itatumika baada ya majuma machache. Programu sawia inapangwa nchini Ireland, na huko Ufaransa ("StopCovid").

Kiswahili: Kikundi cha wanakanada waliripoti kwamba SARS-CoV-2 iligunduliwa katika vipimo vya mikondo ya hewa na koo vya wagonjwa waliopona na kutoka hospitalini wiki 2 mapema, jambo linaloashiria kwamba virusi vipya vilivyotambuliwa vinaweza kuwa vya vipindi vya kujirudia kama vile homa ya mafua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia Canada nkiabwate ng'a SARS-CoV-2 kiabwenerete korwa ase abarwaire baria bakorire na baria batamire chipatala nyuma yechingiti chionsi, ekiagera nga oborwaire bwebinyoro bwaranyare korwa omoroberio buna oborwaria bw'omoroberio (influenza).

English: Pneumonia is one of the most severe symptoms and can progress rapidly to acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Kiswahili: Nimonia ni mojawapo ya dalili kali zaidi na inaweza kuendelea kukua kwa haraka na kuwa sindromu kali ya matatizo ya kupumua.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bw'obongo nigo enchera eyemo endagera engiya na gosegeta buya goikerania oborwaire bw'okwerwa amabere.

English: The age-adjusted prevalence of COPD among U.S. adults is 5.9%, and in 2018, the U.S. estimated prevalence of current asthma among persons of all ages was 7.9%.
Kiswahili: Maambukizi yaliyorekebishwa kulingana na umri ya COPD miongoni mwa watu wazima nchini Marekani ni 5.9% na mnamo 2018, Marekani ilikadiria maambukizi ya ugonjwa wa pumu miongoni mwa watu wa umri wote ulikuwa 7.9%.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw'obobwenia obuya bw'omwana omonene (COPD) ase abana baria bakwegendererete ase America buna 5.9%, na omwaka wa 2018, America yabaririe buna omoroberio omonene bw'okwegendereria ase abana bonsi buna 7.9%.

English: In late 2019, WHO assigned the emergency ICD-10 disease codes U07.1 for deaths from lab-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and U07.2 for deaths from clinically or epidemiologically diagnosed COVID-19 without lab-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection.The death-to-case ratio reflects the number of deaths divided by the number of diagnosed cases within a given time interval.
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa 2019, WHO ilikabidhi misimbo ya ugonjwa ya dharura ya ICD-10 ambayo ni U07.1 kwa vifo vilivyotokana na maambukizi ya SARS-CoV-2 yaliyothibitishwa kwenye mahabara na U07.2 kwa vifo kutokana na COVID-19 vilivyopimwa kimatibabu au kiepidimiolojia bila maambukizi ya SARS-CoV-2 yaliyothibitishwa kwenye mahabari. Mgao wa vifo kulingana na visa unaakisi idadi ya vifo vikigawanywa na idadi ya visa vilivyopimwa ndani ya kipindi fulani cha wakati.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka 2019, omoroberio bwoborwaria (WHO) bwabekirie emergencies ICD-10 disease codes U07.1 ase oborwaire bwa SARS-CoV-2 obwatemekiire ase ekeombe na U07.2 ase obwaire bwa COVID-19 oranyare obwatetemekiirwe ase ekenyoro gose obotemeki bw'ebirengererio (COVID-19) ataranyare korwa ekero ekeombe ekeene.Oboremi bw'oborwaire bwogokwanerana na ekero abanto batemekiirie ase ekero batem

English: Several measures are commonly used to quantify mortality.
Kiswahili: Hatua kadhaa hutumiwa kwa kawaida ili kupima kiwango cha vifo.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio bionsi bikoremerwa gosegeta oborwaire.

English: Research into a vaccine or specific antiviral drug is underway.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa chanjo au dawa mahsusi ya kuzuia virusi unaendelea.
Ekegusii: Obotuki igoro yobochori gose omoroberio bwogokonya obokoreri bw'ebinto biria bikorwania oboremi bwebinto biogosaria oborwaria.

English: The incubation period for COVID-19 is typically five to six days but may range from two to 14 days.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha kupevuka cha COVID-19 kwa kawaida ni siku tano hadi sita lakini kinaweza kuanzia ya pili au kumi na nne.
Ekegusii: Kipindi cha kuambukizwa kwa COVID-19 kwa kawaida ni siku tano hadi sita lakini kinaweza kuwa kati ya siku mbili hadi 14.

English: This will be followed by 800 samples monthly.
Kiswahili: Hii itafuatwa na sampuli 800 kila mwezi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekiagokorwa ase ebinyoro 800 goetera omotienyi.

English: The IBO stated that it would award candidates their diplomas or certificates based on "their coursework" and "the established assessment expertise, rigor, and quality control already built into the programme."
Kiswahili: IBO ilitaja kwamba ingewapa wanafunzi alama katika diploma zao au vyeti kulingana na "kazi walizofanya darasani" na "utaalamu wa kutahtmini, kazi kuntu na udhibiti wa ubora ambao tayari ulikuwa umekuzwa katika mpango huo."
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi (IBO) kiaanenerete ng'a ekiagera abakoreri obokoreri bwabo gose chitifiketi chiabo igoro yoboronge bwabo na oboronge obuya, oboteneneri, na obotenereri bw'obobobwenerete bwabekirwe ase omoroberio oo.

English: There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the novel coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chanjo au matibabu mahsusi ya virusi hivi vya korona.
Ekegusii: Hakuna chanjo au matibabu maalum ya virusi vipya vya korona.

English: On 5 March 2020, Washington University in St. Louis announced its projects to develop a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 5 Machi 2020, Chuo Kikuu cha St. Louis huko Washington kilitangaza miradi yake ya kukuza chanjo.
Ekegusii: Tarehe 5 Machi 2020, Chuo Kikuu cha Washington mjini St. Louis kiliashiria miradi yake ya kutengeneza chanjo.

English: At least 52 thousand deaths were linked to COVID-19, the disease caused by the coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Angalau vifo elfu 52 vilihusishwa na COVID-19, ugonjwa unaosababishwa na virusi vya korona.
Ekegusii: Angalau vifo elfu 52 viliunganishwa na COVID-19, ugonjwa unaosababishwa na virusi vya korona.

English: Data on admission of COVID-19 cases in a hospital and/or an intensive care unit are currently available at EU/EEA level for only 6% and 1% cases, respectively (data not shown).
Kiswahili: Data kuhusu kulazwa kwa wagonjwa wa visa vya COVID-19 katika hospitali au kitengo cha kushughulikia wagonjwa mahututi kwa sasa zinapatikana kiwango cha EU/EEA kwa 6% na 1% ya visa mtawalia (data haijaonyeshwa).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria bwa COVID-19 ase ekeombe getenenerete na/or ekeombe ekenene gotanga obokoreri obobwenia (ICU/EEA) korwa ebirengererio bieserikari ya Europe (EU) na ekeombe gi'EEA (Ekeombe ekene ekenene) ase ekero ekenene 6% na 1% ase ekenene ekenene.

English: This is especially important for people who handle food or work in the medical field, but also an important practice for the general public.
Kiswahili: Hii ni muhimu hasa kwa watu wanaoshughulikia vyakula au wanaofanya kazi katika uwanja wa kimatibabu, lakini pia ni kitendo muhimu kwa umma kijumla.
Ekegusii: Ogoigo nigo ogoikerania ase abanto baria bakorenta chindagera chiabo gose baria bagokora emeremo yoborwaria, na gosegeta oboremi bwabo ase abamenyi bonsi.

English: The basic reproductive number (R0) was 3.77 (95% CI: 3.51-4.05), and the adjusted R0 was 2.23-4.82.
Kiswahili: Idadi msingi wa kizazi (R0) ilikuwa 3.77 (95% CI: 3.51-4.05), na R0 iliyobadilishwa ilikuwa 2.23-4.82.
Ekegusii: Namba ya msingi ya uzazi (R0) ilikuwa 3.77 (95% CI: 3.51-4.05), na R0 iliyorekebishwa ilikuwa 2.23-4.82.

English: Apply 250 g zinc sulphate for each year of age to a maximum of 4.5 kg/tree.
Ekegusii: Tumia 250 g ya zinki sulfate kwa kila mwaka wa umri hadi kiwango cha juu cha 4.5 kg/mti.

English: After hand-washing is completed, the hands are dried with a sterile cloth and a surgical gown is donned.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda wa kuosha mikono ikukamilika, mikono hupanguswa kwa nguo iliyofishwa vimelea na gauni ya upasuaji kuvaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amaoko nigo ekorigia, amaoko goaka na chinsemo chiria chiria chiakorigia amaoko na goaka ya obokoreri goakwa.

English: The peak and ultimate duration of the outbreak are uncertain and may differ by location.
Kiswahili: Kilele cha na muda hatimaye wa kuzuka kwa ugonjwa huu haijulikani na huenda ikatofautiana na eneo.
Ekegusii: Ogokina na omoroberio bwokoruta omochando obo tibwatebwate na gosaria goikerania korwa endagera eyemo.

English: This can be prevented by taking antiviral medicines to prevent transmission, in addition to the vaccine shortly after birth.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ekiagera ekero ogotumia ebinto biria bigosegeta oborwaria bw'ebinyinyi (antiviral drugs) erio gotanga obokoreri bwebinyinyi, goikerania ebinto ebio nyuma yobotuki.

English: As a transmembrane protein, ACE2 serves as the main entry point into cells for some coronaviruses, including HCoV-NL63; SARS-CoV (the virus that causes SARS); and SARS-CoV-2 (the virus that causes COVID-19).
Kiswahili: Kama protini ya kupitisha utando, ACE2 inatumika kama sehemu kuu ya kuingia kwenye seli za baadhi ya virusi vya korona, ikiwa ni pamoja na HCoV-NL63; SARS CoV (virusi ambavyo vinasababisha SARS); na SARS-CoV-2 (virusi ambavyo vinasababisha COVID-19).
Ekegusii: Kama protini ya transmembrane, ACE2 hutumika kama sehemu kuu ya kuingia kwenye seli kwa baadhi ya virusi vya korona, ikiwa ni pamoja na HCoV-NL63; SARS-CoV (virusi vinavyosababisha SARS); na SARS-COV-2 (viini vinavyoosababisha COVID-19).

English: If diseased leaves cannot be removed from the plot and burnt, they should be deeply buried.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwemebasekano bwebinyoro bwetugo tibwateirwe korwa endagera na gotumigwa, buna goikeranwa goikera ebirengererio.

English: The diversity of bat CoVs provides ample opportunities for the emergence of novel HCoVs.
Kiswahili: Aina mbalimbali za bat CoV hutoa fursa tele za kuibuka kwa HCoV vipya.
Ekegusii: Aina nyingi za virusi vya CoV vya popo hutoa fursa nyingi kwa ajili ya kuibuka kwa virusi vipya vya HCoV.

English: Currently, due to the lack of effective and specific therapy for COVID-19, TCM has become one of the major alternative treatments for patients with light to moderate symptoms or for those who have recovered from severe stages.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, kutokana na ukosefu wa tiba faafu na mahususi kwa COVID-19, TCM imekuwa mojawapo ya tiba kuu mbadala kwa wagonjwa walio na dalili hafifu hadi za wastani au kwa wale ambao wamepona kutoka katika hatua mbaya zaidi.
Ekegusii: Kwa sasa, kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa matibabu yenye ufanisi na maalum ya COVID-19, TCM imekuwa mojawapo ya matibabu muhimu zaidi kwa wagonjwa walio na dalili nyepesi hadi za wastani au kwa wale ambao wamepona kutoka hatua kali.

English: In Hong Kong, Sinophobia, which was already high to begin with, has intensified as a result of the pandemic, with the result that many shops and restaurants are now denying service to mainland Chinese customers and banning Mandarin speakers from their premises (with the exception of Taiwanese).
Kiswahili: Kule Hong Kong, ubaguzi dhidi ya Uchina, ambao ulikuwa juu tayari, umeongezeka kama matokeo ya janga hili, matokeo yake yakisababisha maduka na mikahawa ikiwanyima huduma wateja kutoka China Kuu na kuwapiga marufuku wanenaji wote wa Kimandarini katika majengo yao (isipokuwa Taiwanisi).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia Hong Kong, chinophobia, chiria chiria chiatambokire korwa chinse chinene, chinyorete korwa omoroberio oo, ekiagera ng'a chindagera chingiya chionsi na chinyomba chiokwegendereria korwa abanto baria bakorire chinese chinene na gotanga abanto bonsi baria batemete chineni gochia chinese.

English: 69 (0.004% of the population) have been confirmed to have died from COVID-19.
Kiswahili: 69 (asilimia 0.004 ya idadi ya watu) wamethibitishwa kuwa wamekufa kwa sababu ya COVID-19.
Ekegusii: 69 (0.004% ya idadi ya watu) wamethibitishwa kufa kutokana na COVID-19.

English: Digital learning devices distributed to learners remain government property and must be returned in good condition.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kujifunzia vya kidijitali vilivyogawiwa wanafunzi vinabaki kuwa mali ya serikali na vinapaswa kurudishwa katika hali nzuri.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gochia chisemi chiokwegendereria (digital learning devices) ekiagendererete ase abana baria bakogendereria chikombiuta nigo kegokorerwa ase eserikari na goikeranwa korwa ebirengererio biobochenu.

English: At the very least they can keep you informed about the local situation and notify you about recently introduced travel requirements and restrictions.
Kiswahili: Katika hali ya chini kabisa wanaweza kukufahamisha kuhusu hali ya ndani na kukuarifu kuhusu mahitaji na vikwazo vipya vya kusafiri.
Ekegusii: Bwensi babwenerete komanyeria igoro yobochenu bweserikari na komanyisia igoro yoborendi obuya na ebirengererio.

English: Janssen is co-developing an oral vaccine with its biotechnology partner, Vaxart.
Kiswahili: Janssen inakuza chanjo kwa kushirikiana na washirika wake wa bioteknolojia, Vaxart.
Ekegusii: Janssen nigo egokinia obokoreri bwechindagera ase omoroberio bwogotumia endagera, amo n'omoroberio o'biotechnology, Vaxart.

English: The WHO asserts that the pandemic can be controlled.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani yadai kuwa janga hili kubwa linaweza kudhibitiwa.
Ekegusii: WHO yasema kuwa janga hili linaweza kudhibitiwa.

English: This timeline extension greatly reduces current planning workloads and pressure across the whole organization.
Kiswahili: Kuongezwa kwa muda huu hupunguza pakubwa kazi za sasa za upangaji na shinikizo katika shirika nzima.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa gose omoroberio bw'ebirengererio bigokonya korenta oboremi bwokorosia ebinto na gosegeta obokoreri ase ekeombe keria ekenene.

English: On 17 March, Adam Kucharski of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine stated that SARS-CoV-2 "is going to be circulating, potentially for a year or two".
Kiswahili: Tarehe 17 Machi, Adam Kucharski Taasisi ya London ya Usafi wa Kiafya & Tiba ya Kitropiki alisema kuwa SARS-CoV-2 "itaendelea kuenea, kuna uwezekano wa mwaka moja au mbili".
Ekegusii: Tarehe 17 Machi, Adam Kucharski wa London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine alisema kuwa SARS-CoV-2 "itaenea, labda kwa mwaka mmoja au miwili".

English: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) reportedly "scrambled" after a steep decline in oil prices due to lower demand from China.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Mataifa Yanayouza Mafuta (OPEC) imaripotiwa kuwa "ilitapatapa" baada ya kushuka sana kwa bei za mafuta kutokana na hitaji la chini kutoka China.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amafuta (OPEC) nkiabwateirwe ng'a "kinyorire" nyuma y'okwenyara kwa igoro y'amafuta ekero oboremi bwao bwokoruta amafuta gochia chinese.

English: This case underscores the importance of strengthening surveillance efforts in infants and ensuring effective management of high maternal viral loads during pregnancy and breastfeeding to prevent transmission of resistant HIV strains.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekiagera ekero ekeene giokorenta oborendi bwogokurerwa ase ebinyinyi na gosegeta obokoreri bwa oborwaria bw'ebinyinyi ase oborito na okonyara erio gotanga oboremi bw'ekenyoro kia HIV.

English: Transferring purified and concentrated antibodies produced by the immune systems of those who have recovered from COVID-19 to people who need them is being investigated as a non-vaccine method of passive immunisation.
Kiswahili: Kuhamisha kingamwili zilizochapishwa na zilizokolea zilizozalishwa na mifumo ya kinga ya mwili ya watu waliopona kutokana na COVID-19 kwa watu wanaozihitaji kunachunguzwa kama njia isiyo amilifu ya kinga ya mwili isiyo ya chanjo.
Ekegusii: Kutoa antibodi zilizosafishwa na zilizozingatiwa zinazozalishwa na mfumo wa kinga ya mwili wa wale waliopona kutoka COVID-19 kwa watu wanaohitaji ni kuchunguzwa kama mbinu isiyo ya chanjo ya kinga isiyo na uwezo.

English: Interestingly, the nucleotide analogue Remdesivir is known to suppress CoV replication through inhibition of this exoribonuclease and the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase.
Kiswahili: Jambo la kupendeza ni kuwa, dawa ya nucleotide analogue Remdesivir inafahamika kudidimisha uzalishaji wa CoV kupitia uzuiaji wa eksoribonuklisi na RNA polimerisi inayotegemea RNA.
Ekegusii: Igoro yoboremi, ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (nucleotide analogue) Remdesivir ekiagendererete gosegeta obokoreri bwa CoV goetera okorenda oboremi obuya bwa exoribonuclease na RNA-dependent RNA polymerase.

English: Opportunistic sampling for serology in children younger than 10 years might be limited due to the overall reduced rate of blood tests in children.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua sampuli kifursa kwa ajili ya serolojia kwa watoto walio na umri wa chini ya miaka 10 kunaeza kuwa na vizuizi kutokana na kupungua kwa viwango vya jumla vya vipimo vya damu kwa watoto.
Ekegusii: Ogochora ebirengererio ase oboremi bwechinsemo ase abana abange korwa omwaka 10 goikeranwa ase obotambe bwogokorwa kwerogongo ase obokoreri bw'amaraso ase abana.

English: Practise a 2-3 year crop rotation without legumes.
Ekegusii: Tumia omoroberio bwemebasekano omwaka 2-3.

English: School closures in response to the COVID-19 pandemic have shed a light on numerous issues affecting access to education, as well as broader socio-economic issues.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule kufuatia janga kubwa la COVID-19 kumemulika masula mengi yanayoathiri ufikiaji wa elimu pamoja na masuala pana ya kijamii na kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Ogochigwa kwa chisukuru ase omoroberio bweserikari ya COVID-19 nigo goikeranirie obotuki bwabanto abange baria bakorwania chisemi, amo nobobwenia bwoboremi na obokoreri.

English: Administrative controls are changes in work policy or procedures that require action by the worker or employer.
Kiswahili: Udhibiti wa utawala ni mabadiliko katika sera za kazi au utaratibu zinazohitaji hatua na mfanyakazi au mwajira.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwobokoreri ng'a obokoreri ase omoroberio bwogokora emeremo gose ebikoru biria bigosegeta ogokorwa na omobasikari gose omonyene.

English: IN WITNESS WHEREOF I have hereunto set my hand and caused the Great Seal of the State of California to be affixed this 19th day of March 2020.
Kiswahili: NINASHUHUDIA HAPA KWAMBA nimeweka mkono wangu na kusababisha Muhuri Kuu wa Jimbo la California kuambatishwa siku hii ya 19 ya Machi 2020.
Ekegusii: NCHIYE NA SHAHIDI KWENYE NIMEKO hapa ili kuweka mkono wangu na kusababisha Muhuri Mkuu wa Jimbo la California kuwekwa siku hii ya 19 ya Machi 2020.

English: Scrubbing creates friction, which helps remove germs from skin, and scrubbing for longer periods removes more germs.
Kiswahili: Kusugua husababisha msuguano, ambao husaidia kuondoa vijidudu kwenye ngozi na kusugua kwa muda mrefu zaidi huondoa hata vijidudu vingi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gosaba ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto binde biria bikorenta ebinto biogosaba, na gosaba chingaki chionsi chingaki chikorenda ebinto ebionsi bionsi.

English: Hussein A A, et al studied several candidate compounds which then optimized and analyzed for their skeleton similarity with the highest similar approved drugs in order to accelerate a potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 drug development in his preclinical study to be recommended in a clinical study design.
Kiswahili: Hussein A A, alichuguza dawa kadhaa zilizoteuliwa, kisha akaboresha na kuchambua mfanano wao na mifupa na dawa za kiwango cha juu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuharakisha maendeleo ya dawa inayowezekana ya kuzuia SARS-CoV-2 na uchunguzi wake wa dawa kupendekezwa katika muundo wa uchunguzi wa kliniki.
Ekegusii: Hussein A A, et al alisoma kemikali kadhaa zilizoteuliwa ambazo ziliboresha na kuchambua kwa kufanana kwao kwa mifupa na dawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa kiwango cha juu ili kuharakisha ukuzaji wa dawa yenye nguvu ya kupambana na SARS-CoV-2 katika utafiti wake wa awali ili kupendekezwa katika muundo wa utafiti wa kliniki.

English: On the contrary, HCoVs can also adapt to the intermediate host and even establish long-term endemicity.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mwingine, virusi vya HCoV vinaweza pia kuzoeleka ndani ya mbebaji wake wa kati na hata kuunda hali ya ugonjwa wa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Kinyume chake, virusi vya HCoV pia vinaweza kuzoeleka kwa mbebaji wa kati na hata kuanzisha uwezekano wa muda mrefu wa kuambukizwa.

English: The virus can spread to different organs throughout the chicken.
Kiswahili: Virusi hivyo vinaweza kuenea kwa viungo tofauti ndani ya kuku.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio bionsi biranyare korwa ebinto biria bigokonya korwa enyamoko.

English: The above figures suggest that SARS-CoV-2 has a higher ability to spread than MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV, but it is less lethal than the latter two.
Kiswahili: Takwimu zilizo hapa juu zinaonyesha kwamba SARS-CoV-2 vina uwez wa juu zaidi kuenea kulika MERS-CoV na SARS-CoV lakini makali yake ni ya chini kuliko hivo vingine viwili.
Ekegusii: Amangana aya igoro yabekire ng'a SARS-CoV-2 nigo enchera eyemo yokobwaterana igoro yechinyomba (MERS-CoV) gose e'SARS-CoV, korwa enchera eyio endagera etari korwa ebirengererio ebio.

English: By 13 March, more than forty countries and territories had reported deaths, on every continent except Antarctica.Several measures are commonly used to quantify mortality.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 13 Machi, zaidi ya nchi arobaini walikuwa wameripoti vifo, katika kila bara isipokuwa Antaktika.Hatua kadhaa hutumika kuhesabu vifo.
Ekegusii: Chitariki 13 chiomotienyi 3 omotienyi omotano, ebinyoro biria biria bigokonya abanto goikerania igoro yobogima bwabo, ase chinsemo chiria chionsi chingakio chiria chiria chitari chinyia, korwa Antarctica. Ebirengererio biria bionsi bigotumika korwa obogima bwa abanto.

English: One of three genetic tests in older versions of the test kits caused inconclusive results due to faulty reagents, and a bottleneck of testing at the CDC in Atlanta; this resulted in an average of fewer than 100 samples a day being successfully processed throughout the whole of February 2020.
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya vipimo vitatu vya kijenetiki katika matoleo ya awali ya vifurushi vya upimaji kilisababisha mtokeo yasiyo makilifu kutokana vyombo viovu vya kupimia, na uchangamano wa upimaji katika kituo cha CDC kule Atlanta; hii ilisababisha idadi ya wastani ya chini ya sampuli 100 kupimwa kwa ufanisi katika kipindi kizima cha mwezi Februari 2020.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getari ase ebikoru biogotemwa ebirengererio biogosomia ebinto biria bigotemwa buna ebinto biogosaria, na oboremi bwogosomia ase CDC ase Atlanta; ekiagera ekero ekero chiria chionsi chiria chiria chitari chitariki 100 ase omotienyi ogotemwa ase omwaka omotano omonene omwaka 2020.

English: The concentration of antibodies in the blood is usually low, and the demand for the plasma is large to treat critically ill patients.
Kiswahili: Mrundiko wa antibodi kwenye damu huwa ni wa chini na hitaji la plasma ni la juu ili kutibu wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Ubora bwa antibodi kwenye damu kwa kawaida ni mdogo, na hitaji la plasma ni kubwa kwa ajili ya kutibu wagonjwa wagonjwa.

English: SARS has higher mortality than COVID-19 (10.91% versus 1.44%).
Kiswahili: SARS inasababisha vifo kwa asilimia ya juu kuliko COVID-19 (10.91% dhidi ya 1.44%).

Kiswahili: Virusi vingi vimehusisha maambukizo kali ya ya mfumo wa kupumua.
Ekegusii: Mengi ya haya yamehusisha maambukizi mabaya ya njia ya kupumua.

English: Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) wishes to inform employers, employees, and the general public that the Finance Act, 2025, amended the Income Tax Act, Cap 470 (“the Act”) to mandate employers to apply all relevant tax deductions, reliefs, and exemptions when computing income tax on employee emoluments.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (KRA) nkiagendererete kobamanyia abakori emeremo, abamenyi, na abanto bonsi ng'a omoroberio bweserikari, omwaka 2025, ogosegeta omochiko bwetugo, Cap 470 (omochiko) gosegeta abaonchoreria korigia oboremi bwechinkwana chionsi, obokoreri, na obosibori bwogokwerenta chingaki chiokwerenda.

English: All jewelry should be removed.
Kiswahili: Vito vyote vinafaa kutolewa.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chionsi chibwate.

English: Herein, recombination of SARS-CoV is taken as a typical example, which also showed evidence of positive selection during interspecies transmission events.
Kiswahili: Hapa ndani, kuunganishwa tena kwa SARS-CoV kunazingatiwa kuwa mfano wa kawaida, ambao pia ulionyesha ushahidi wa uteuzi chanya wakati wa matukio ya usambazaji baina ya viumbe.
Ekegusii: Hapa, kuunganishwa tena kwa SARS-CoV kunachukuliwa kama mfano wa kawaida, ambayo pia ilionyesha ushahidi wa uteuzi chanya wakati wa matukio ya usambazaji kati ya aina.

English: Although several countries use chloroquine or hydroxychloroquine for treatment of persons hospitalized with COVID-19, as of March 2020 the drug has not been formally approved through clinical trials in the United States.
Kiswahili: Ingawa nchi kadhaa hutumia chloroquine au hydroxychloroquine kwa matibabu ya watu waliolazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya COVID-19, kuanzia March 2020 dawa hiyo haijaidhinishwa rasmi kupitia majaribu ya kliniki nchini Marekani..
Ekegusii: Ijapokuwa nchi kadhaa zinatumia chloroquine au hydroxychloroquin kwa matibabu ya watu waliolazwa hospitalini na COVID-19, kufikia Machi 2020 dawa hiyo haijaidhinishwa rasmi kupitia majaribio ya kimatibabu nchini Marekani.

English: The Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament's general secretary Kate Hudson criticized the Defender 2020 exercise: "In the current public-health crisis, it jeopardizes the lives not only of the troops from the US and the many European countries participating but the inhabitants of the countries in which they are operating."The Iranian government has been heavily affected by the virus, with around two dozen parliament members infected as well as fifteen other current or former political figures.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Kampeni ya Upunguzaji wa Sila za Vita za Nyuklia Kate Hudson alilaumu shughuli ya Utetezi 2020: "Katika hali ya hatari ya sasa ya afya ya umma, inahatarisha si maisha ya jeshi pekee kutoka Marekani na nchi za Ulaya kadhaa zinazohusika bali pia wakzai wa nchi wanakofanya operesheni."Serikali ya Irani imeathirika sana na virusi, na takriban wabunge ishirini na nne wameambukizwa pamoja na wanasiasa kuni na tano wa sasa au wa kitambo.
Ekegusii: Omominisita omonene bwokoruta ebinto biria bigosaria ebinto biao (Campagne for Nuclear Disarmament) Kate Hudson oanenerete omoroberio o'Defender 2020: "Omoroberio bw'obobwenia bw'oborwaria bweserikari, nigo okorenta obogima bw'abasikari batari bonsi ase America na abanto abange ba'Ekeombe keria ekenene kia Ekeombe ki'Oborayia, korwa ase abanto bonsi baria bakorete ebinto ebio."

English: Seven days later the sequence of the CoV was released.
Kiswahili: Siku saba baadaye, msururu wa CoV ulizinduliwa.
Ekegusii: Machi saba baadaye mfululizo wa CoV ulitolewa.

English: Donors and well-wishers are invited to support school libraries by donating storybooks in English and Kiswahili.
Kiswahili: Wafadhili na wemaaji wanaalikwa kusaidia maktaba za shule kwa kutoa vitabu vya hadithi kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi na abamenyi babwenerete gokonya ebitabu bia chisukuru goetera ebitabu biria bigosomia chingisi na chiswahili.

English: Practise crop rotation: site seedbeds on land not previously under crucifers, and preferably away from old crucifer fields.
Ekegusii: Tumia omoroberio bwokoruta chibesa: gosaba ebinto biria bikoruta chiburaburu ase endagera etari korwa chinsemo chinyinge, na gose korwa ase chinkwana chinyange.

English: Localised school closures place burdens on schools as parents and officials redirect children to schools that are open.
Kiswahili: Kufungwa kwa shule mitaani kunaweka mzigo shuleni kwa vile wazazi na maafisa wanawaelekeza watoto katika shule zilizofunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ogochigwa kwa chisukuru chiria chiria chiesukuru chire omoroberio ase chisukuru ekero abaibori na abakori emeremo bakorire abana goetera chisukuru chiokorenda.

English: Also in March 2020, Deutsche Telekom shared aggregated phone location data with the German federal government agency, Robert Koch Institute, in order to research and prevent the spread of the virus.
Kiswahili: Pia mwezi wa Machi 2020, Deutsche Telekom ilishiriki data ya jumla ya eneo la simu na shirika la serikali ya shirikisho la Ujerumani, Taasisi ya Robert Koch, ili kufanya utafiti na kuzuia virusi hivyo kuenea.
Ekegusii: Nomwaka 2020, omotienyi omotambe omonene omonene (Deutsche Telekom) nigo okobwaterana na omoroberio bweserikari ya Germany, Robert Koch Institute, erio gokora obotuki na gotanga okogendererigwa kw'ekero.

English: William Schaffner of Vanderbilt University stated, "I think it's unlikely that this coronavirus—because it's so readily transmissible—will disappear completely" and it "might turn into a seasonal disease, making a comeback every year".
Kiswahili: William Schaffner wa Chuo Kikuu cha Vanderbilt University alisema, "Nadhani hakuna uwezekano kuwa hii virusi vya korona—kwa sababu inambukizwa kwa urahisi—itapotea kabisa" na huenda ikawa "ikawa ugonjwa wa msimu, ikitokea kila mwaka".
Ekegusii: William Schaffner wa Chuo Kikuu cha Vanderbilt alisema, "Nadhani haiwezekani kwamba virusi hivi vya korona" kwa sababu vinaweza kuambukizwa kwa urahisi sana" vitapotea kabisa" na "viweza kugeuka kuwa ugonjwa wa msimu, na kurudi tena kila mwaka".

English: Invasive procedures like surgery may also be necessary to confirm the diagnosis.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogosegeta buna obokoreri nabo nigo ogotenerwa gosegeta omoroberio oo.

English: Our existing system can be enhanced to twice weekly, but maybe daily or hourly data should be our current approach.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wetu uliopo unaweza kuboresha hadi mara mbili kwa wili, lakini pengine data ya kila siku au kila saa inapaswa kuwa mwelekeo wetu wa sasa.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwetugo nigo ogotenerwa goikeranwa ase ebirengererio bieserikari ebibiri ase eserikari, korwa chingaki chionsi gose chingaki chiria chiria chigoikerania chingaki chingaki.

English: It is not yet known whether the severity or level of control of underlying health conditions affects the risk for severe disease associated with COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Bado haijulikani iwapo uzito au kiwango cha udhibiti wa hali sugu za afya huathiri hatari ya ugonjwa mbaya unaohusiana na COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Haijulikani bado iwapo uzito au kiwango cha udhibiti wa hali za afya zinazohusika huathiri hatari ya ugonjwa mbaya unaohusishwa na COVID-19.

English: People can also become infected with respiratory diseases such as influenza or the common cold, for example, if they do not wash their hands before touching their eyes, nose, or mouth (i.e., mucous membranes).
Kiswahili: Watu pia wanaweza kuambukizwa magonjwa ya kupumua kama vile homa ya mafua au homa ya kawaida, kwa mfano, iwapo hawataosha mikono yao kabla ya kugusa macho yao, pua au mdomo (yaani membreni zilizo na majimaji).
Ekegusii: Watu nao wanaweza kuambukizwa na magonjwa ya kupumua kama vile homa ya mafua au homa ya kawaida, kwa mfano, ikiwa hawaosha mikono yao kabla ya kugusa macho yao, pua, au mdomo (yaani, utando wa ngozi).

English: Beginning on 15 March, many businesses closed or reduced hours throughout the U.S. to try to reduce the spread of the virus.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia 15 Machi, biashara kadhaa zilifungwa au kupunguza masaa ya shughuli kote Marekani kujaribu kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi.
Ekegusii: Ogochakia omotienyi 15 omotieni 3, ebinyoro bionsi mbiregete gose goikerania ebiro biao ase America goetera komenta oborwaria bwokoruta omoroberio oo.

English: This Order is not intended to, and does not, create any rights or benefits, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity, against the State of California, its agencies, departments, entities, officers, employees, or any other person.
Kiswahili: Amri hii haijakusudiwa, na haiundi haki au faida zozote, muhimu au za kiutaratibu, zinazoweza kutekelezwa kisheria au kwa usawa, dhidi ya Jimbo la California, mawakala, idara, mashirika, maafisa, wafanyakazi wake, au mtu mwingine yeyote.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekiagendererete gokora oboronge bwao, na tari gokora ebirengererio bionsi gose obokoreri, buna ebinto biengencho gose ebinto biria bigokorwa ase enchera eyemo, gose ase oboteneneri bwa California, ebinto biao, ebinyoro, ebiombe, abakori emeremo gose omonto onsi.

English: The Government of China denied the possibility of faecal-oral transmission of SARS-CoV-2.The virus is most contagious during the first three days after onset of symptoms, although spread may be possible before symptoms appear and in later stages of the disease.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Uchina ilipinga uwezekano wa kusambazwa kutoka kinyesi hadi mdomoni ya SARS-CoV-2.Virusi hivi huambukizwa sana siku tatu baada ya kuonekana kwa dalili, ingawa kusambazwa inawezekana kabla ya dalili kuonekana na katika hatua za baadaye ya ugonjwa.
Ekegusii: Eserekali ya China yaakanirie igoro yobochori bwa SARS-CoV-2.Oboremaru obobe bwogotambokerania omoroberio omotato omotano nyuma yogotanga ebimanyererio, nonya ng'a okobwaterania goikerania ebinyererio bigotamboka na ase ebinyoro biogotanga ebinyorokererio.

English: Use certified disease-free seeds if using own seeds hot water treat the seeds.
Ekegusii: Tumia mbeu zilizoidhinishwa zisizo na magonjwa ikiwa unatumia maji moto ya mbegu zako mwenyewe kutibu mbegu.

English: Government offices remain committed to serving all Kenyans equally regardless of their tribe, religion or background.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za serikali zinaahidi kuhudumia Wakenya wote kwa usawa bila kujali kabila, dini au asili yao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete gokonya abanto bonsi ase obokoreri bwegechinsemo chiabo, obokonyi bwabo gose obokong'u bwabo.

English: An order signed by the Ministry of Education as a preventative measure aims to prevent the spread of respiratory diseases in connection with the WHO coronavirus pandemic.
Kiswahili: Agizo lilitiwa sahihi na Wizara ya Elimu kama hatua ya kuzuia lililenga kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa ya pumu kuhusiana na janga kubwa la virusi vya korona la WHO.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa kwa omoroberio bweserikari buna ekeombe keria getenerete gotanga oborwaria bwokorwara omochando omonene bwomoroberio o'Oboroso (WHO) goikerania oborwaire bw'esimi ya korona.

English: The CRT will keep these pages updated and all the information in one place.
Kiswahili: CRT itasasisha kurasa hizi na maelezo yote katika mahali pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obokoreri (CRT) nkiagendereria emeroberio eyio na obomanyi bwabo bonsi ase ekeombe ekene.

English: There are three vaccination strategies being investigated.
Kiswahili: Kuna mikakati tatu ya chanjo ambayo inachunguzwa.
Ekegusii: Kuna mikakati mitatu ya chanjo inayochunguzwa.

English: Despite doing so, the United States had a slow start in testing, which obscured the true extent of the outbreak at the time.
Kiswahili: Licha ya kufanya hivyo, Marekani ilikuwa na mwanzo wa polepole kwa vipimo, ambayo ilificha kiwango halisi ya mkurupuko wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Nchini Marekani, licha ya kufanya hivyo, majaribio yalianza polepole, jambo lililoficha ukubwa halisi wa mkurupuko huo wakati huo.

English: A team of researchers at the University of Colorado are trying to modify the drugs to find a compound that will bind with the protease of SARS-CoV-2.There are criticisms within the scientific community about directing resources to repurposing drugs specifically developed for HIV/AIDS.
Kiswahili: Timu ya watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Colorado wanajaribu kubadilisha dawa hiyo ili kupata chembe ambacho kitaunganisha na protease ya SARS-CoV-2. Kuna ukosoaji katika jamii ya kisayansi kuhusu kuelekeza rasimali za kubadilisha dawa zilizoundwa muhususi kutibu HIV/AIDS.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia baria bakorire oboronge ase eyunifasiti ya Colorado nkigendererete korosia ebinto ebio erio goikerania ebinto bia SARS-CoV-2.

English: The avocado oil is cholesterol free, of the monounsaturated type believed to protect against heart disease and certain kinds of cancers.
Ekegusii: Mafuta ya avocado hayana kolesteroli, ya aina isiyokamilika ambayo inadhaniwa kulinda dhidi ya magonjwa ya moyo na aina fulani za saratani.

English: The CDC recommends that if a COVID case is suspected or confirmed at a facility such as an office or day care, all areas such as offices, bathrooms, common areas, shared electronic equipment like tablets, touch screens, keyboards, remote controls, and ATM machines used by the ill persons, should be disinfected.
Kiswahili: CDC inapendekeza kuwa ikiwa kisa cha COVID inashukiwa au imethibitishwa katika jengo kama vile ofisi au shule za kuwatunza watoto, kila sehemu kama ofisi, bafu, sebule, vifaa za elektroniki kama kompyuta bapa, viguso, kibodi, rimoti, na mashine ya ATM zilizotumiwa na watu wagonjwa, yapaswa kusafishwa na dawa za kuua viini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amagenderero (CDC) nkigokurera ng'a ekero ekero okoremerwa korwa COVID gose gokoremerwa ase ekeombe gose ekeombe, ebinyoro bionsi buna ebiombe, chinsemo chinyia, ebinto biengencho, obokoreri bwendagera buna ebinto biria bigotumeka, ebiombe biria bikoremereria korwa emeremo, na ebinto bia ATM biria biakoretwe ase abarwaire, bigokoremerigwa.

English: World Health Organization declares COVID-19 pandemic
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani limetangaza ugonjwa ulioenea sana wa COVID-19
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborwaria (World Health Organization) kiabwatirie ng'a COVID-19 endagera eyemo.

English: Phase II trials are used to establish an initial reading of efficacy and further explore safety in small numbers of people having the disease targeted by the NCE.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya II hutumika kuanzisha usomaji wa kwanza wa ufanisi na kuchunguza zaidi usalama katika idadi ndogo ya watu wenye ugonjwa wanaolengwa na NCE.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene keria ekeene gietenererete goikerania oborwaria bwogokonya omoroberio bwogotoma na korigereria oborendi ase abanto abange baria bakorire oborwaire obo ase ekeombe ekenene getenenerete (NCE).

English: Those infected with the virus may be asymptomatic or develop flu-like symptoms such as fever, cough, fatigue, and shortness of breath.
Kiswahili: Walioambukizwa na virusi hivyo wanaweza kosa kuhusi dalili au kuonyesha dalili kama za mafua kama vile homa, uchovu, na matatizo ya kupumua.
Ekegusii: Abo baranyare omoroberio oyuo nabo nigo bakonyara gose goikerania ebimanyererio buna oborwaria bw'omoroberio buna omochando, oboremi, obotambe, na obosibore bw'okuya.

English: Countries at risk or affected by cholera should strengthen their surveillance systems according to the revised Global Taskforce on Cholera Control (GTFCC) recommendations to quickly detect and respond to outbreaks.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korwa ekolera gose ekero ekoremerwa na ekolera goikerania emeroberio yao yoborendi goetera obokoreri bwebinyoro bia Global Taskforce on Cholera Control (GTFCC) erio gotanga na korwania ebirengererio.

English: These codes will be grouped ontologically into “definite”, “probable”, “possible”, and “not a case” using our standard approach to grouping codes (Table 5), which has been used previously across disease areas.
Kiswahili: Misimbo hii itawekwa kwenye vikundi kiontolojia kuwa “halisi”, “huenda ikawa”, “vinawezekana” na “sio kisa” kwa kutumia mwelekeo wetu wa kawaida wa misimbo ya kuweka visa kwenye vikundi (Jedwali la 5), ambao umetumika awali kote katika maeneo ya ugonjwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekiagokorwa ase ekerengo ekiagera ebirengererio bionsi (Table 5), ekiagendererete korwa ebinyoro biria biranyare korwa oborwaria.

English: Brazilian citizens who went to Wuhan were quarantined at a military base near Brasília.
Kiswahili: Raia wa Brazil walioenda Wuhan waliwekwa karantini katika kituo cha kijeshi karibu na Brasília.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Bresil abwo bakorire ase omoroberio o'Wuhan babwatirwe ase omochando omonene ase abasikari ase Brasília.

English: They replicate robustly without eliciting a strong host immune response.
Kiswahili: Huzalishwa kwa wingi bila kuonyesha makabiliano ya kinga thabiti ya mwili ya mbebaji wake.
Ekegusii: Bigo bionsi bikobwaterana ase obotambe bwogokonya omonyene goikerania oborwaria bw'omonyene.

English: Provide support to teachers and parents on the use of digital tools: Organise brief training or orientation sessions for teachers and parents as well, if monitoring and facilitation are needed.
Kiswahili: Toa msaada kwa walimu na wazazi katika utumizi wa vifaa vya kidijitali: Panga mafunzo fupi au vipindi vya maelekeo ya walimu na wazazi pia, ikiwa ufuatiliaji na usaidizi unahitajika.
Ekegusii: Karwe obokonyi ase abarimu na abaibori igoro yogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia omoroberio bwedichitari: Renda oboremi obuya gose oboronge bwogokonya barimu na abarimu amo, erio gokora emeroberio yoborendi na gosegeta.

English: The National Police Service urges the public to report any suspicious persons or activities to the nearest police station without delay.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Polisi la Kitaifa linahimiza umma kuripoti watu au shughuli zozote zinazoshukiwa katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu bila kuchelewa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari nkiaboririe abanto korwa ase abanto bonsi babwenerete gosoa gose ebikoru biabo goika ase ekambi yabasikari ekero bakwegendereria.

English: Follow-up images after delivery showed no progression of pneumonia.Media reports indicate that over 100 women with COVID-19 might have delivered, and in March 2020, no maternal deaths were reported.
Kiswahili: Picha za kufuatia baada ya kujifungua haukuonyesha maendeleo ya nimonia. Ripoti za vyombo za habari zinaonyesha kuwa zaidi ya wanawake 100 wenye COVID-19 wanaweza kuwa wamejifungua, na mnamo Machi 2020, hakuna vifo vya akina mama walioripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ebionchorerio biogokorwa nyuma yobochorwa nigo bigokonia korwa oborwaria bw'obongo.Ebikombe biabanto biranyare ng'a abakungu 100 baria bare na COVID-19 nabo baranyare korwa obochorwa, na omotienyi 3 omwaka 2020, gotabanerete korwa abana baria bakorete obochwari.

English: Although some people call the disease "Wuhan pneumonia" (武汉(漢)肺炎/武肺), "Wuhan disease", or "Chinese virus", the use of these terms is considered racist in China and by many people of Chinese origin.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa baadhi ya watu wanaita ugonjwa huu "nimonia ya Wuhan" (武汉(漢)肺炎/武肺), "ugonjwa wa Wuhan", au "virusi vya Uchina", matumizi ya maneno haya yanachukuliwa kama ya ubaguzi wa rangi nchini Uchina na watu wengi wa eneo la Uchina.
Ekegusii: Nonya nigo abanto abange baranyare obochenu bwa Wuhan (武汉(漢)肺炎/武肺), "Oborwari bwa Wuhan", gose "Virus ya Chinese", ogotumia kwa ebio goikeranie oboremi ase chinese na ase abanto bebinyoro bia chinese.

English: Do not interplant young trees with pasture because of the high competition for water during the dry season.
Ekegusii: Tobaise korenta emete igoro yoboremi ase enchera eyemo yobochenu ase omoroberio bw'amache.

English: The usual incubation period (the time between infection and symptom onset) ranges from one to 14 days; it is most commonly five days.As an example of uncertainty, the estimate of the fraction of people with COVID-19 who lost their sense of smell was initially 30% and later fell to 15%.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha kawaida ya kuwepo kwa dalili za ugonjwa (kipindi kati ya kuambukizwa na kuonekana kwa dalili) huanzia siku moja hadi 14; kwa kawaida ni siku tano.Kwa mfano wa kutokuwa na hakika, kadirio ya sehemu ya watu walio na COVID-19 waliopoteza hisia yao ya kunusa ilikuwa hapo awali 30% na baadaye ikashuka hadi 15%.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete (omoroberio bwetugo gochia oborwaria bwogokonywa na gosegeta ebirengererio) nkorenta omotienyi omoroberio goika emetienyi 14; nigo ekero ekero etano.Ongo omorero bwokwegendereria, oboremi bwa abanto baria bakorete COVID-19 abwo bakorire obotuki bwabo buna 30% na nyuma gotwara goika 15%.

English: This Order is being issued to protect the public health of Californians.
Kiswahili: Amri hii inatolewa ili kulinda afya ya umma ya wana California.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene ekiagokorwa ase okorenda oborwaria bwabanto ba California.

English: As a precautionary measure, health-care workers caring for patients immediately outside the CCHF outbreak area should also implement standard infection control precautions.
Ekegusii: Korwa omoroberio bwokwerenda, abakori emeremo ya oborwaria baria bakorenta abarwaire batari ase enchera ya CCHF nabo bagotumia emeremo yoborendi bwokorenda ebirengererio.

English: The outcome of the ongoing SARS-CoV-2 outbreak is also discussed in this context.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya mkurupuko unaoendelea wa SAR-CoV-2 pia yamejadiliwa katika muktadha huu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokoruta kwa SARS-CoV-2 nigo ogotenenwa ase enchera eyio.

English: Personal hygiene and a healthy lifestyle and diet have been recommended to improve immunity.
Kiswahili: Usafi wa mwili na kuwa na maisha yenye afya na lishe bora imependekezwa kuboresha kinga.
Ekegusii: Obokebago bwomonto amangana na omoroberio bwobogima na oboremi bwechindagera mbwaranyorigwe gosegeta oborwaria bwebinyoro.

English: Practise proper irrigation, avoid planting in wet, cold soils
Ekegusii: Rora buna ogosegeta ebinto biria bikoremereria amache, erinde kogesa ebinto biogosegeta ase ebinto biao.

English: Many events have been cancelled, and Singapore did start advising residents to stay at home on 28 March, but schools reopened on time after holiday break on 23 March.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengi yamekatishwa na Singapore ilianza kuwashauri wakaazi kukaa nyumbani tarehe 28 Machi, lakini shule zilifunguliwa tena kwa muda ufaao baada ya muda wa likizo tarehe 23 Machi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabekirwe, na Singapore yaatangire gokonya abamenyi korwa ase omotienyi omotano omotani 28 omotieni 3, korwa chisukuru chiaguruke nyuma yamatuko omotieny 23 omotieneti 3.

English: Another possibility is to buy two separate tickets (for instance, a ticket from China to Cambodia and a second ticket from Cambodia to the U.S.), but be careful you won't get quarantined or lose your luggage in between.
Kiswahili: Uwezekano mwingine ni kununua tiketi mbili tofauti (kwa mfano, tiketi kutoka Uchina hadi Kambodia na tiketi ya pili kutoka Kambodia hadi Marekani.), lakini kuwa mwangalifu usiingie karantini au upoteze mizigo yako hapo katikati.

Ekegusii: Omoroberio o'South Korea nigo ogotumeka buna omoroberio omonene ase okorenda oboikeranu bwogotumia chingaki chionsi, nonya ng'a togotumia oborendi bwechindagera.Ekeombe kia South Korea kiabwenerete kobwaterana igoro yoborendi bwa omorai Moon Jae-in ase oboremi bwechinsemo.

English: In collaboration with the Food and Agricultural Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and the Mediterranean Zoonoses Control Programme (MZCP), WHO supports countries in the prevention and management of the disease through the Global Early Warning System for Major Animal Diseases (GLEWS).
Ekegusii: Ase okobwaterana na ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboremi (FAO), ekeombe ekenene giokorwania oborwaria bwetugo (OIE) na omoroberio bwogotumia ebinto biria bikorwania ebinto bionsi (MZCP), WHO yaboririe emeremo ase okwerenda na korenda oborwari obwo goetera ekeombe ekeene ekenene (GLEWS).

English: Nevertheless, the efficacy and safety of TCM still await more well-controlled trials at larger scales and in more centers.
Kiswahili: Licha ya hayo, ufanisi na usalama wa TCM bado unasubiri majaribio yaliyodhibitiwa vyema zaidi katika viwango vikubwa na katika vituo vingi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nonetheless, efficacy and safety of TCM still await more well-controlled trials on larger scales and in more centers.

English: Do not feed livestock old bean straw if manure is to be used on bean fields.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa chibesa chionsi chinyomba chiokwegendereria chingaki chiogotumia chingaki ase chindagera.

English: Pregnant women may be at higher risk for severe infection with COVID-19 based on data from other similar viruses, like SARS and MERS, but data for COVID-19 is lacking.In some people, COVID-19 may affect the lungs causing pneumonia.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanaweza kuwa katika hatari kubwa ya kuambukizwa na COVID-19 kulingana na data ikilinganishwa na virusi vingine sawia, kama vile SARS na MERS, lakini data ya COVID-19 inakosekana. Kwa watu wengine, COVID-19 inaweza kuathiri mapafu na kusababisha nimonia.
Ekegusii: Abakungu baria batamire nigo bakonyare korwa oborwaria bwa COVID-19 goikerania emeroberio yebirusi ebio, buna SARS na MERS, korwa ebirasi ebio biranyare.Abanto abange, COVID-19 nigo egokonya ebirusi biria bigokonya oboremi bw'ebirusi (pneumonia).

English: With lots of flights canceled, warnings issued, and restrictions imposed, flying in the time of coronavirus can be a challenge.
Kiswahili: Ndege nyingi zikiwa zimeghairishwa, maonyo kutolewa, na vikwazo kuwekwa, kusafiri kwa ndege wakati huu wa virusi vya korona kuna changamoto.
Ekegusii: Na ndege nyingi zilizofutwa, maonyo yametolewa, na vikwazo vilivyowekwa, kusafiri kwa ndege wakati wa virusi vya korona kunaweza kuwa changamoto.

English: The outbreak of Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), has thus far killed over 3,000 people and infected over 80,000 in China and elsewhere in the world, resulting in catastrophe for humans.
Kiswahili: Mkurupuko wa ugonjwa wa Virusi vya korona 2019 (COVID-19), unaosababishwa na matatizo mbaya ya pumu yaani severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), hivyo umewauwa zaidi ya watu 3,000 na kuwaambukiza zaidi ya 80,000 nchini China na kwigineko duniani, na kusababisha janga kwa binadamu.
Ekegusii: Ugonjwa wa Virusi vya korona 2019 (COVID-19), unaosababishwa na virusi vya korona vya 2 (SARS-CoV-2), umesababisha vifo zaidi ya 3,000 na kuambukizwa zaidi ya 80,000 nchini China na sehemu zingine duniani, na kusababisha maafa kwa binadamu.

English: Additionally, practices participating in current virology surveillance are now taking samples for COVID-19 surveillance from low-risk patients presenting with LRTIs.
Kiswahili: Isitoshe, huduma zinazoshiriki katika uchunguzi wa sasa wa viarolojia sasa zinachukua sampuli kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa COVID-19 kutoka kwa wagonjwa wenye hatari ya chini wanaoonyesha maambukizi ya njia ya chini ya pumu.
Ekegusii: Goikerania, ebinyoro biria bigokonya oboremi bw'ebinto biria biranyare korwa oborwaria bw'obobobwenia (virology surveillance) nigo bigotumia emeroberio ase oborwari bwa COVID-19 goetera abarwaire baria batari na oboremererio bwogotumia ebinto bioborwari (LRTIs).

English: A similar web-based study to Solidarity, called "Discovery", was initiated in March across seven countries by INSERM (Paris, France).During March, funding for the Solidarity trial reached US$108 million from 203,000 individuals, organizations and governments, with 45 countries involved in financing or trial management.
Kiswahili: Utafiti sawia unaotegemea tovuti wa Umoja, unaojulikana kama "Ugunduzi", ulianzishwa mwezi wa Machi katika nchi saba na INSERM (Paris, Ufaransa). Mwezi wa machi, ufadhili wa jaribo la Umoja ulifikia dola milioni 108 kutoka kwa watu 203,000, mashirika, na serikali, na nchi 45 zilizohusika katika ufhadhili au udhibiti wa jaribio.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogotumia ebinto ebionsi buna obokoreri bwebinyoro (Solidarity), oranyare "Discovery", nabwateirwe omotienyi omotano omoroberio (INSERM) (Paris, France).Omwaka o'March, chibesa chiogokonya ebinyoro bia Solidarity chiabereire emirioni 108 goetera abanto 203,000, ebinto na eserikari, amo na chindagera 45 chiabeire ase oboremi bwokorobererekana.

English: Several compounds that were previously approved for treatment of other viral diseases are being investigated for use in treating COVID-19.

Ekegusii: Amang'ana amangana abwo abwatirwe kera ase oborwaria bw'ebirengererio biria biranyare okoremerwa ase obokoreri bwa COVID-19.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene, abarwaire baranyare korwa omoroberio bwango na gotanga obotuki.

English: Such screening methods allow more analyses at a lower cost, and in case of a positive screening test, confirmation of results must be carried out by more complex chemical analysis.
Ekegusii: Obokoreri obo bwogotumia ebinto biria bigotumia obokoreri buna ebinto bikoremereria ase oboremi bwao, na korwa oboreri bwokoremereria ebinto binde, oborendi bw'ebinto bionsi goikerania ebinto biobokoreri bwa kemia.

Kiswahili: Upitiaji wa kimfumo na uchanganuzi wa meta uliochapishwa tarehe 11 Julai, 2013, ulipata kwamba "matumizi ya vizuizi vya ACE yalihusishwa na upungufu mkubwa wa asilimia 34 katika hatari ya nimonia ikilinganishwa na vidhibiti."

English: An earlier study reported that the R0 of SARS-CoV-2 was as high as 6.47 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 5.71-7.23, whereas the R0 of SARS-CoV only ranged from 2 to 4.

English: Most novel drug candidates (NCEs) fail during drug development, either because they have unacceptable toxicity or because they simply do not prove efficacy on the targeted disease, as shown in Phase II-III clinical trials.
Kiswahili: Dawa nyingi mpya zilizoteuliwa (NCE) huwa hazifaulu wakati wa maendeleo ya dawa, kwa sababu ina sumu isiyokubalika au kwa sababu hazithibitishi ufanisi katika ugonjwa unaolengwa, kama ilivyoonyeshwa katika vipimo vya kliniki vya Awamu ya II-III.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboremi (NCEs) nigo kegokonya ase okorosia ekero ekorosia ebinto ebio, gose gose ekero nigo bikoremereria ebinto biria bigosegeta ebinto biogosegeta oborwaire bwogokonya oborwari bwao, buna ekorokereria ase ekerengo kia II-III.

English: In September 2012, a new type of coronavirus was identified, initially called Novel Coronavirus 2012, and now officially named Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa Septemba 2012, aina mpya ya virusi ya korona vilitambuliwa, hapo awali vilijukana kana virusi vipya vya korona vya 2012, na sasa vinajulikana kama virusi vya korona vya Mashariki ya Kati vya matatizo ya kupumua. (MERS-COv).
Ekegusii: Mnamo Septemba 2012, aina mpya ya virusi vya korona ilipatikana, awali iliitwa Novel Coronavirus 2012, na sasa imepewa jina rasmi la Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).

Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa RT-PCR bwokororwa ase ebinto biria bigokorwa ase omoroberio bwetugo nigo bwokorigia ase ekero ekero ekeene ekorwara.

English: WHO recommends that all blood donations be tested for hepatitis B to ensure blood safety and avoid accidental transmission.

English: Several SARS-like CoVs (SL-CoVs) have also been identified from bats, but none except for one designated WIV1 can be isolated as live virus.
Kiswahili: Virusi kadhaa vya Cov (SL-CoVs) vinavyofanana na SARS pia vimetambuliwa kwenye popo, lakini hakuna kati yavyo isipokuwa WIV1 vinavyoweza kutengwa kama virusi hai.
Ekegusii: Virusi vingi vya CoV vinavyofanana na SARS (SL-CoVs) pia vimetambuliwa kutoka kwa popo, lakini hakuna hata moja isipokuwa moja iliyoainishwa kama WIV1 inayoweza kutengwa kama virusi hai.

English: The Wuhan Laboratory has been promptly followed by Huo-Yan labs in Shenzhen, Tianjin, Beijing, and Shanghai, in a total of 12 cities across China.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete omoroberio bweserikari ya Wuhan nkiagendererete korwa ebikoreri bia Huo-Yan aaria Shenzhen, Tianjin, Beijing, na Shanghai, ase chindagera 12 ase chinse.

English: However, we are at present unsure as to whether the scale of this surveillance provides sufficient data to drive local containment strategies or if reporting infrequently meets the need of our information age.

Ekegusii: Nere, korwa enchera eyemo, togotamanyia buna omoroberio bwokorobererekana buna obokoreri bwechinsemo chionsi buna oboronge bwechinkwana goikerania emeroberio yoborendi bwetugo, gose gose ng'a okoroberereka gose gokonya ebirengererio bionsi goetera oboremi bwechinyomba.

English: As of March 2020, there was one (DNA based) MERS vaccine which completed phase I clinical trials in humans, and three others in progress, all of which are viral-vectored vaccines, two adenoviral-vectored (ChAdOx1-MERS, BVRS-GamVac), and one MVA-vectored (MVA-MERS-S).
Kiswahili: Hadi Machi2020, kulikuwa na chanjo moja ya MERS (inayotegemea DNA) iliyokamilisha majaribio ya awamu ya I ya kliniki kwa wanadamu, na zingine tatu zinaendelea, zote ambazo ni chanjo ya kuzuia virusi, virusi viwili ya DNA (ChAdOx1-MERS, BVRS-GamVac), na MVA-vectored (MVA-MERS-S).
Ekegusii: Kufikia mwezi wa Machi 2020, kulikuwa na chanjo moja ya (DNA inayotegemea) MERS ambayo ilimaliza majaribio ya kliniki ya awamu ya I kwa binadamu, na nyingine tatu zinaendelea, ambazo zote ni chanjo zilizo na virusi, chanjo mbili zilizo na adenovirus (ChAdOx1-MERS, BVRS-GamVac), na moja iliyo na MVA-vector (MVA-MERS-S).

English: The regular RNA assay for SARS-CoV-2 can be negative in some COVID-19 patients.
Kiswahili: Jaribio la kawaida la RNA ya SARS-CoV-2 linaweza kutokea hasi kwa baadhi ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Uchunguzi wa kawaida wa RNA kwa ajili ya SARS-CoV-2 unaweza kuwa hasi kwa baadhi ya wagonjwa wa COVID-19.
